items.prompt: A dramatic sports editorial scene featuring a professional male footballer wearing an all-black kit, reclining confidently on top of an oversized soccer ball. The ball is hyper-detailed with realistic panels and branding, placed on a glossy reflective floor. The athlete’s pose is relaxed yet powerful, with one arm hanging down and legs extended, showcasing strength and elegance. The background is a bold deep blue studio with massive “GOAL” typography in large, subtle shadowed letters. High-contrast studio lighting with sharp highlights and deep shadows sculpting the body. Clean, minimal composition with a luxury sports campaign aesthetic. Shot with an 85mm lens, ultra-realistic, cinematic lighting, crisp details, 8K resolution, Nike/Adidas-style commercial photography.

items.title: 东方茶商业海报设计
items.prompt:
输出一张 4:5 竖版商业海报，不要拼贴，不要多宫格。使用原创虚构品牌，不得模仿现有品牌的包装、标志或广告。文字仅限提示词中明确列出的品牌名、主标题和品类；不得添加价格、奖项、参数、日期、产地或宣传语。画面完成度须达到可供创意总监审核的标准：结构写实、材质可信、排版清晰、无水印。

主题：东方茶品鉴样品。原创品牌“岚虚”，产品“岩茶”（Yancha），主标题“山田入盏”。

一张暖白色宣纸长卷自底部向上折叠为三折高度不一的页面，形似抽象山脊，同时保留真实纸张的厚度、纤维与折痕。最底层放置一把深褐色小茶壶，中层放置一只白瓷茶杯，最高层仅放几片干岩茶叶；物体比例写实且互不重叠。

核心构图：“折页相连—山路层叠—茶烟贯通”。一缕琥珀色茶烟自壶嘴升起，沿着连接茶杯的折叠山路蜿蜒而行，宛如克制的写意水墨笔触，带有局部浓淡变化，但不构成具体文字或龙凤图案。主标题“山田入盏”以现代宋体在右侧留白处竖向排列，顶部小字“岚虚”，底部小字“岩茶”。配色方案：暖白、岩褐、茶汤琥珀色及极少量墨黑。

画面中不得出现人物、古装、真实茶室场景、满屏风景、大幅书法、金色边框、禅意陈词滥调、复杂包装或多图拼贴。
tags: 用于创建极简主义艺术风格的中国茶品牌商业海报的提示词，重点展

items.title: Snowy Sky with Handwritten Japanese Text
items.titleZh: A moody square winter photograph looking straight up at an overcast gray-blue sky during active snowfall, framed on all sides by tall leafless trees with dark bare branches reaching inward from the edges to create a circular canopy. Snowflakes of many sizes are falling across the entire image, with some large soft blurred flakes close to the lens and many smaller sharp flakes scattered deeper in the scene, creating a dreamy atmospheric depth. At the very bottom edge, faint silhouettes of shorter winter trees and a subtle warm amber streetlight glow appear near the lower right, while the rest of the image stays cold, muted, and dim like dusk or early evening. Across the center, overlay large emotionally expressive Japanese handwritten brush-pen style text in white, slightly uneven and natural, reading {argument name="quote" default="また、この季節がやってくる。"}, with a human handwritten feel, soft edges, moderate stroke variation, and casual line breaks spread over the middle of the sky. Emphasize melancholic nostalgia, poetic Japanese winter atmosphere, cinematic minimalism, realistic photography, and authentic hand-drawn lettering integrated cleanly over the snowfall.

items.title: Luxury Dream Home Real Estate Flyer
items.titleZh: Create a polished vertical real-estate promotional flyer in a clean, modern social-media ad style, 4:5 poster composition. Use a bright daytime outdoor theme with a pale blue sky, soft clouds, and leafy green tree branches framing the top left and top right corners. The layout should feel like a premium property investment advertisement with bold typography, glossy marketing design, and a teal, red, white, and gray color palette. At the upper left, place a small uppercase headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="LIVE BETTER. INVEST SMARTER."}. Directly below it, add a very large stacked main headline: {argument name="main headline line 1" default="OWN YOUR"} in deep teal and {argument name="main headline line 2" default="DREAM HOME"} in vivid red, using a bold condensed sans-serif font. Beneath that, add a teal ribbon banner with white uppercase text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="LUXURY LIVING. LASTING VALUE."}. Under the tagline, show exactly 3 circular feature icons arranged horizontally with thin vertical separators between them: a shield icon with the caption "SECURE YOUR FUTURE", a rising bar-chart icon with the caption "HIGH VALUE INVESTMENT", and a house icon with the caption "MODERN & ELEGANT". In the middle left and lower center, feature a large photorealistic contemporary luxury house with 2 stories, white and gray exterior walls, black trim, large glass windows, a balcony, landscaped shrubs, and a paved driveway, shown from a front three-quarter angle. On the right side, place a waist-up adult Black man in a green knit sweater, facing forward and pointing directly at the viewer with an assertive sales-poster pose; his body overlaps the house and extends into the foreground. Near his lower torso, add a glossy red circular badge with a slight 3D effect containing large white uppercase text {argument name="callout text" default="BUY NOW!"}, and attach a small dark teal angled banner across its bottom edge reading "LIMITED UNITS AVAILABLE!". Across the bottom, create a dark teal panel containing exactly 3 rounded rectangular property cards with white borders and equal spacing. Card 1 should show a row of modern townhouses and the label "MODERN TERRACES"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Spacious Rooms" and "24/7 Security". Card 2 should show a luxury villa with a pool and the label "LUXURY VILLAS"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Premium Amenities" and "Prime Locations". Card 3 should show a detached upscale modern home and the label "EXCLUSIVE HOMES"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Registered Title" and "Trusted Developer". At the very bottom, include one large empty white rounded rectangle spanning most of the width as a placeholder area for contact details or footer information. Make the overall image crisp, high-contrast, commercial, aspirational, and professionally designed like a premium real-estate marketing poster.
items.promptZh: 以干净、现代的社交媒体广告风格、4:5 海报构图创建精美的垂直房地产促销传单。使用明亮的白天户外主题，淡蓝色的天空、柔软的云彩和绿叶茂盛的树枝构成左上角和右上角。布局应该感觉像是一个优质的房地产投资广告，具有大胆的排版、光滑的营销设计以及青色、红色、白色和灰色调色板。在左上角放置一个大写小标题：{argument name="headline text" default="LIVE BETTER. INVEST SMARTER."}。在其正下方，添加一个非常大的堆叠主标题：深青色的 {argument name="main title line 1" default="OWN YOUR"} 和鲜红色的 {argument name="main title line 2" default="DREAM HOME"}，使用粗体压缩无衬线字体。在其下方，添加一个青色丝带横幅，上面写有白色大写文本：{argument name="tagline text" default="LUXURY LIVING. LASTING VALUE."}。在标语下方，恰好显示 3 个水平排列的圆形功能图标，它们之间有细小的垂直分隔符：一个标题为“保障您的未来”的盾牌图标，一个标题为“高价值投资”的上升条形图图标，以及一个标题为“现代与优雅”的房屋图标。在左中下中心，有一座大型逼真的当代豪华住宅，有 2 层楼，白色和灰色的外墙，黑色装饰，大玻璃窗，阳台，景观灌木和铺砌的车道，从前面的四分之三角度显示。在右侧，放置一个腰部以上的成年黑人，穿着绿色针织毛衣，面朝前，直接指向观众，摆出自信的销售海报姿势；他的身体与房子重叠并延伸到前景。在他的下躯干附近，添加一个带有轻微 3D 效果的光亮红色圆形徽章，其中包含大型白色大写文本 {argument name="callout text" default="BUY NOW!"}，并在其底部边缘贴上一个小的深青色倾斜横幅，上面写着“LIMITED UNITS AVAILABLE!”。在底部创建一个深青色面板，其中正好包含 3 个带有白色边框和等间距的圆角矩形属性卡。卡 1 应显示一排现代联排别墅和标签“MODERN TERRACES”；在它的下面正好有 2 个小功能：“宽敞的房间”和“24/7 安全”。卡 2 应显示一座带泳池的豪华别墅，并带有“LUXURY VILLAS”标签；在它的下面正好有 2 个小功能：“高级便利设施”和“黄金地点”。卡3应显示独立的高档现代住宅和“EXCLUSIVE HOMES”标签；在它的下面正好有 2 个小功能：“注册标题”和“受信任的开发人员”。在最底部，包括一个大的空白白色圆角矩形，跨越大部分宽度，作为联系人详细信息或页脚信息的占位符区域。使整体图像清晰、高对比度、商业化、有抱负且经过专业设计，就像优质的房地产营销海报一样。

items.title: Ibaraki Travel Guide Cover
items.titleZh: A refined Japanese travel guide magazine cover illustration in a soft watercolor-and-ink editorial style, vertical A4 layout, airy pastel palette, elegant tourism-poster composition. The cover headline is dominated by very large serif blue text reading {argument name="main title" default="IBARAKI"}, with large Japanese title text below reading "茨城県 旅行ガイド" and a pale pink cursive English subtitle reading "Ibaraki Travel Guide". At the top left, include two lines of small Japanese copy about nature, history, scenery, and gourmet travel in Ibaraki, accented with a tiny pink cherry blossom icon. At the top right, place a large circular badge with fine dotted border containing Japanese text and the phrase "完全保存版" in the center with a small ribbon flourish underneath. The main subject is a young Japanese woman shown from the chest up, placed slightly right of center, facing left in three-quarter view. She has a chin-length wavy bob in deep dark brown to black, delicate loose strands, soft natural texture, and a calm neutral expression. She wears a light blue cardigan over a white ruffled blouse with a high gathered neckline, plus a thin beige shoulder bag strap. Her face is intentionally obscured by a plain vertical rectangular gray censor block centered over the face area. Surround her with a collage of iconic Ibaraki scenery blended seamlessly into the cover art: a vast field of blue nemophila flowers across rolling hills in the upper right with a Ferris wheel in the distance and tiny visitors along the ridge; a traditional temple or pavilion among pink cherry blossoms at mid-right; a bright waterfall and landscaped stream at lower right; a torii gate standing in shallow ocean water at sunset in the lower left; and a mountain landscape near the bottom left center. Add abundant blue flowers in the foreground along the bottom edge and soft pink cherry blossoms framing the right side. Along the left side, include exactly 7 vertically stacked destination list entries in Japanese, each with a colored heading line and smaller descriptive subtext: "国営ひたち海浜公園", "偕楽園", "袋田の滝", "大洗磯前神社", "筑波山", "水郷・霞ヶ浦", and "グルメ・カフェ・おみやげ". At the lower left, place a blue circular badge with white Japanese text reading "モデルコース 4" and smaller itinerary copy below. At the lower right, include exactly 3 horizontal white label tabs with Japanese text and small icons: "絶景スポット", "ご当地グルメ", and "おみやげセレクション". Add a pink ribbon banner near the bottom right with small Japanese promotional text. Use a clean white background for the upper left, elegant magazine typography, delicate linework, dreamy spring atmosphere, polished tourism-cover design, high detail, premium print look.

items.title: Bubble Fox Friends Meet in Niseko
items.titleZh: A bright anime-style fantasy travel scene in front of Niseko View Plaza in Hokkaido, with a clear blue sky, scattered white clouds, and a huge snow-capped mountain rising in the background. The setting is a roadside plaza parking area with a modern black-and-wood station building on the left, visible Japanese signage reading "道の駅 ニセコビュープラザ" and "Niseko View Plaza," a vertical banner reading "ようこそ ニセコへ," a tall food sign reading "名物 じゃがいも," and a dark wayfinding sign on the right reading "ニセコ Niseko" with 4 listed icons and labels: "名産品 Local Products," "農産物直売所 Farmer's Market," "レストラン Restaurant," and "情報コーナー Information." In the center, a glamorous fox-eared anime girl sits sideways atop a giant iridescent translucent soap bubble, smiling and gesturing upward with one hand. She has {argument name="hair color" default="shimmering pastel silver-lilac"} very long wavy hair, large fluffy fox ears, and a huge fluffy fox tail with rainbow-reflective highlights. Her outfit is an elaborate sparkling translucent-white and pale blue dress with holographic sheen, layered sleeves, gemstone accents, ribbons, and glossy lace-up ankle boots with bows, giving her a magical bubble-fox idol appearance. Around her float multiple smaller soap bubbles, catching rainbow light. Three fox-girl friends gather around meeting her at the plaza: 1 dark-haired fox-eared girl in a navy jacket with a Niseko patch, holding a vanilla soft-serve ice cream and looking toward the center; 1 khaki-clad fox-eared girl in an outdoor jacket and a dark cap with "HOTEL" lettering, holding a grilled corn cob; and 1 white-haired fox-eared girl in a shiny pearly hooded jacket and beret, holding a takeaway coffee cup and wearing a black backpack. Emphasize a cheerful reunion mood, travel photography composition blended with polished anime illustration, detailed environmental signage, reflective bubble surfaces, soft sunlight, crisp mountain air, and high-detail painterly rendering.

items.title: Origami Dinosaur Pop-Up Book Ad
items.titleZh: A polished children's pop-up book advertisement on a dark studio background, featuring an open hardcover book with thick white pages and a teal-green cover lying on a tabletop. From the center fold, a highly detailed white paper origami T-rex bursts upward in a dynamic roaring pose, mouth wide open with sharp triangular teeth, tiny clawed arms raised, thick folded legs planted in layered paper jungle foliage, and a segmented tail extending backward. The dinosaur should look handcrafted from crisp folded cardstock, with visible geometric paper panels and clean origami seams. Behind it, the right-hand page stands partially upright and catches a dramatic shadow projection of the T-rex profile, creating a large silhouette with open jaws; also include small paper-cut scenery on that page: 3 flying pterosaurs and a simple mountain landscape. Surround the dinosaur base with dense cut-paper plants and grass emerging from both pages. Light the scene with a cinematic warm spotlight from the upper left, leaving the background in deep navy to black, with soft realistic shadows cast across the book and onto the raised page. At the top center, include bold white ad typography in stacked lines reading {argument name="headline text" default="DINOSAURS POP UP ADVENTURE"}, with a white ribbon banner below that reads {argument name="tagline" default="A WORLD OF WONDER IN EVERY PAGE"}. At the bottom center, place 4 evenly spaced circular feature icons with captions in white: an open book icon labeled "AMAZING POP UP DESIGNS", a hand icon labeled "HANDCRAFTED WITH CARE", a shield icon labeled "DURABLE & KID FRIENDLY", and a light bulb icon labeled "INSPIRES IMAGINATION". Premium toy catalog style, cinematic product photography mixed with paper craft illustration, centered composition, high contrast, ultra-clean, whimsical, family-friendly, realistic paper texture.
items.promptZh: 深色工作室背景上的精美儿童立体书广告，桌面上放着一本打开的精装书，厚厚的白页和青绿色的封面。从中间的折痕处，一只高度精细的白色纸折纸霸王龙以动态的咆哮姿势向上爆发，张开嘴，长着锋利的三角形牙齿，举起小爪子手臂，粗大折叠的腿种植在分层的纸丛林树叶中，分段的尾巴向后延伸。恐龙应该看起来是用清晰的折叠卡片手工制作的，具有可见的几何纸面板和干净的折纸接缝。在它后面，右侧页面部分直立，捕捉到霸王龙轮廓的戏剧性阴影投影，形成张开下巴的巨大剪影；该页上还包括小剪纸风景：3只飞翔的翼龙和一个简单的山景。用从两页中长出的茂密的剪纸植物和草包围恐龙基地。用左上角的电影温暖聚光灯照亮场景，使背景为深海军蓝到黑色，柔和逼真的阴影投射在书本和凸起的页面上。在顶部中心，在堆叠行中添加粗体白色广告字体，内容为{argument name="headline text" default="DINOSAURS POP UP ADVENTURE"}，下方有一个白色丝带横幅，内容为{argument name="tagline" default="A WORLD OF WONDER IN EVERY PAGE"}。在底部中心，放置 4 个均匀间隔的圆形功能图标，标题为白色：一个标有“令人惊叹的弹出式设计”的打开的书本图标，一个标有“精心制作”的手形图标，一个标有“耐用且儿童友好”的盾牌图标，以及一个标有“激发想象力”的灯泡图标。高级玩具目录风格，电影产品摄影与纸工艺插图混合，居中构图，高对比度，超干净，异想天开，适合家庭，逼真的纸张纹理。

items.title: Blue Pen Campaign Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic Brazilian political campaign poster in a square social-media format, hyper-stylized and cinematic, with a dark blue and black color grade, intense contrast, gritty textures, and heroic propaganda-poster composition. On the right half, a middle-aged man wearing a bright royal-blue polo shirt faces the camera from the chest up, extending one hand toward the viewer and prominently holding a blue ballpoint pen upright as the central symbolic object. His pose is confident, assertive, and campaign-like, with the pen close to the lens for forced perspective. Behind him, two large waving flags fill the upper background: the Puerto Rico flag on the upper left side behind the subject and the Brazil flag on the upper right side. The lower background shows a dark crowd silhouette and a distant city skyline at sunset with glowing orange light on the horizon, adding a rally atmosphere. On the left side, create a vertical stack of 4 bold campaign statements, each preceded by a large blue X marker. The 4 text blocks must read exactly: "ELE NÃO TEM A MIDIA", "ELE NÃO TEM PROJETOS", "ELE TAMBÉM NÃO TEM O POVO", and "O RESTO ELE VAI DESCOBRIR NA HORA". Use condensed uppercase typography, mixing white and electric blue emphasis words, with each statement separated by thin horizontal blue divider lines. At the bottom, place an oversized distressed headline in uppercase reading "CANETA AZUL", with "CANETA" in weathered white and "AZUL" in vivid blue, spanning almost the full width. Below it, add a secondary subtitle in uppercase blue italic condensed text reading "PARA DEPUTADO", flanked by thin blue horizontal lines. The overall design should feel like a viral meme campaign ad, bold, satirical, aggressive, and highly shareable, with dramatic rim lighting, sharpened details, realistic skin and fabric texture, and polished poster-quality compositing.
items.promptZh: 一张引人注目的巴西政治竞选海报，采用方形社交媒体格式，超风格化和电影化，具有深蓝色和黑色等级、强烈的对比度、坚韧的纹理和英雄式的宣传海报构图。右半部分，一位穿着明亮宝蓝色 Polo 衫的中年男子胸部以上面向镜头，向观众伸出一只手，并突出地举着一支蓝色圆珠笔作为中心象征物。他的姿势自信、果断，就像一场运动，笔靠近镜头，形成强制透视。在他身后，两面飘扬的大旗填满了上方的背景：主体后面左上方的波多黎各国旗和右上方的巴西国旗。较低的背景显示了黑暗的人群轮廓和日落时遥远的城市天际线，地平线上闪烁着橙色的光芒，增添了集会气氛。在左侧，创建 4 个粗体竞选声明的垂直堆栈，每个声明前面都有一个大的蓝色 X 标记。 4 个文本块必须准确读取：“ELE Nó TEM A MIDIA”、“ELE Nó TEM PROJETOS”、“ELE TAMBÉM Nó TEM O POVO”和“O RESTO ELE VAI DESCOBRIR NA HORA”。使用压缩的大写字体，混合白色和电蓝色强调词，每个语句由细水平蓝色分隔线分隔。在底部，放置一个大写的超大仿旧标题，写着“CANETA AZUL”，“CANETA”为风化白色，“AZUL”为鲜蓝色，几乎覆盖整个宽度。在其下方添加第二个副标题，采用大写蓝色斜体压缩文本，内容为“PARA DEPUTADO”，两侧是细蓝色水平线。整体设计应该感觉像一个病毒式的模因活动广告，大胆、讽刺、积极、高度可分享，具有戏剧性的边缘照明、锐化的细节、逼真的皮肤和织物纹理，以及精美的海报质量合成。

items.title: Atmospheric Tea Alley Street Scene
items.titleZh: A photorealistic narrow old alley tea-house scene in a dense East Asian neighborhood, shot at eye level with a slightly telephoto street-photography composition. The lane is cramped, damp, and richly layered with lived-in details: weathered storefronts, aged concrete and brick walls, tangled overhead wires, metal awnings, exposed pipes, hanging signs, and lush green vines and tree branches spilling in from above and along both sides. In the left foreground, place a rustic wooden table set for tea with exactly 1 metal kettle, 1 teapot, 1 tray of small blue-and-white porcelain teacups and small vessels, plus a few extra cups nearby; surround it with potted plants and stacked containers. Above and behind the table, hang exactly 3 illuminated vertical lantern-style signs with black Chinese calligraphy on warm cream paper, the largest reading 茶一味 and the others styled similarly, plus several darker wooden signboards with gold or light lettering. In the center of the alley, show white steam rising dramatically from a pot or food stall, partially obscuring stools and the passageway. On the right side, line up exactly 4 bicycles parked close together beside crates, baskets, and a black trash bin. Deeper in the alley, include exactly 4 visible people sitting or standing casually near tiny tables and stools, adding scale without dominating the image. The stone pavement should look wet and reflective, suggesting recent rain or humid weather. Lighting is soft natural daylight filtering from the bright opening at the far end of the alley, mixed with warm lantern glow, creating a moody cinematic contrast. Emphasize texture, authenticity, atmospheric depth, subtle haze, documentary realism, and a cozy hidden-gem tea-street feeling in {argument name="city style" default="an old Chinese lane"}.

items.title: Automotive poster transformation prompt
items.titleZh:
Ultra-clean automotive poster featuring the exact same car as the photo that will be provided later. The AI must replicate the car from the uploaded photo with identical body shape, proportions, stance, color, trims, wheels, and all visible exterior details.
The car is presented in a front three-quarter angle facing right, matching the perspective of the original reference layout, but now depicted in a subtle {argument name="action" default="drifting action"}. The drift is expressed through realistic weight transfer, slight body lift, controlled smoke plumes from the rear tires, and faint curved tire marks behind the vehicle, without distorting the original car’s geometry.
Headlights follow the exact style from the reference photo of the car, with optional warm fog lights glowing if the provided car has them. All decals, emblems, plates, and window tints must match the car from the uploaded photo.
The car drifts on a glossy white reflective studio-like floor that maintains soft reflections and realistic shadows, enhanced with light drift skid reflections and directional smudges.
Background remains a clean white-to-light-gray gradient with a giant semi-transparent bold typography of the car model name (auto-extracted from the uploaded photo) vertically dominating the background.
At the very top: clean branding text “{argument name="brand name" default="CAR COMPANY NAME"}” (or the brand detected from the uploaded car photo). Under it, spaced-out stylized tracking text containing the same brand and model name.
Below the car: centered title of the exact model name from the uploaded photo.
Under that, a short descriptive paragraph about the car’s character (efficiency, style, reliability).
Bottom section shows a clean grid layout of specifications. If real specs are known from the detected car model, generate accurate values; if not, generate placeholders in the same layout style (4 columns: horsepower, 0–100 km/h, top speed, engine displacement/fuel type).
Entire poster is minimalist, editorial, high-key studio lighting with ultra-sharp reflections, crisp shadows, modern typography, and 4K believability, blending clean design with dynamic drifting energy, Ratio 9:16
items.promptZh:
超干净的汽车海报，其中的汽车与稍后提供的照片完全相同。人工智能必须从上传的照片中复制汽车，使其具有相同的车身形状、比例、姿态、颜色、装饰、车轮以及所有可见的外部细节。
汽车以面向右侧的前四分之三角呈现，与原始参考布局的视角相匹配，但现在以微妙的{argument name="action" default="drifting action"}进行描绘。漂移通过真实的重量转移、轻微的车身升力、后轮胎的受控烟羽以及车辆后面微弱的弯曲轮胎痕迹来表达，而不会扭曲原车的几何形状。
车头灯遵循汽车参考照片中的确切样式，如果提供的汽车有可选的暖雾灯，则会发光。所有贴花、标志、车牌和车窗色调必须与上传照片中的汽车相匹配。
汽车在光滑的白色反光工作室般的地板上漂移，保持柔和的反射和逼真的阴影，并通过光漂移防滑反射和定向污迹增强。
背景仍然是干净的白色到浅灰色渐变，带有巨大的半透明粗体汽车型号名称（从上传的照片中自动提取）垂直主导背景。
最顶部：干净的品牌文本“{argument name="brand name" default="CAR COMPANY NAME"}”（或从上传的汽车照片中检测到的品牌）。在其下方，间隔开的风格化跟踪文本包含相同的品牌和型号名称。
汽车下方：上传照片中确切型号名称的居中标题。
下面是关于汽车特性（效率、风格、可靠性）的简短描述性段落。
底部显示了清晰的规格网格布局。如果从检测到的汽车模型中得知真实规格，则生成准确的值；如果没有，则以相同的布局样式生成占位符（4 列：马力、0–100 km/h、最高速度、发动机排量/燃料类型）。
整张海报采用简约、社论、高调的工作室灯光，具有超锐利的反射、清晰的阴影、现代的排版和 4K 可信度，将干净的设计与动态漂移的能量融为一体，比例 9:16

items.title: Fashion Editorial Outfit Breakdown
items.titleZh: Using REFERENCE_0, extract only the outfit and turn it into a clean fashion magazine product showcase on a light warm-beige background. Remove the person entirely and display the clothing as separate laid-flat items: 1 cropped short-sleeve top centered near the top and 1 pair of shorts centered below it. Preserve the vivid multicolor art print from the reference, but present the garments neatly, as if for an editorial catalog page, with soft studio shadows. Add 1 circular fabric-detail inset at the lower left showing a close-up of the print. Add elegant editorial typography and thin callout lines, with 4 text blocks total: a large headline block at upper left reading “COLORFUL ART SET UP” with small Japanese copy above and below, 1 right-side block labeled “TOPS” with Japanese description, 1 lower-right block labeled “BOTTOMS” with Japanese description, and 1 lower-left block labeled “FABRIC” with short Japanese description. Keep the overall look refined, minimal, premium, and like a clothing introduction page in a magazine.

items.title: Minimalist Literary Novel Cover
items.titleZh: A literary book cover in a refined minimalist editorial style, vertically oriented, with a muted palette of deep black, dark green, sepia, and warm cream. The composition is divided by large flowing curtain-like abstract shapes that create dramatic negative space and diagonal wedges of light. On the right side, show an elderly butler-like man seen from behind, standing upright in a formal black tailcoat or tuxedo jacket, white shirt cuffs visible, hands clasped behind his back, facing a tall softly glowing window with sheer curtains. His posture is reserved, dignified, and solitary. On the lower portion, within a triangular beam of light, place a dim still life on a table: exactly 3 objects, a wine glass, a teapot, and a plate, all partially obscured in shadow. The left side should carry elegant vertical Chinese title typography reading {argument name="title text" default="长日将尽"}, set large in pale gold serif-like characters. Beneath it, include smaller Chinese author and translator lines, and a short Chinese quote in small text. Near the lower left, add small English text reading {argument name="english title" default="The Remains of the Day"} and {argument name="author name" default="Kazuo Ishiguro"}, plus a small publisher line and the year {argument name="year" default="2024"}. The image should feel like an award-winning contemporary literary fiction cover: quiet, melancholic, restrained, cinematic, with paper grain texture, soft vignette, subtle painterly shading, and highly intentional asymmetrical layout. Keep the typography integrated into the design, with generous negative space and no bright colors.

items.title: Japanese AI Creative Manifesto Poster
items.titleZh: A bold Japanese advertising poster on an off-white textured paper background with a slightly worn print grain. Create a full-body fashion-style photo of a young woman standing slightly right of center in a wide, confident stance, legs apart, arms relaxed at her sides, facing forward. Her face is intentionally blurred for anonymity. She has long straight split-dyed hair, one half {argument name="hair color" default="pastel pink"} and the other half {argument name="second hair color" default="pastel blue"}, falling past her chest. She wears a white oversized T-shirt with the black chest print {argument name="shirt text" default="OKIHIRO AI Creative"}, a light pink pleated mini skirt, and chunky white sneakers. Use clean studio lighting with soft shadows under her feet. Fill the left half of the poster with huge distressed black Japanese typography in an energetic diagonal layout reading {argument name="main headline" default="センスない奴は画像とテキストを極めろ"}, with oversized characters stacked and overlapping for maximum impact. Add 2 broad paint-brush swashes behind the lower headline area: 1 pink brush stroke sweeping from the lower left toward center and 1 blue brush stroke sweeping from center-right toward the far right. In the upper right, place a compact vertical block of small black Japanese copy in 4 lines reading: 「AI動画の自動化に 溺れるな。 静止した一枚と、 研ぎ澄まされた言葉が、 最も強い武器になる。」 arranged like a manifesto note. In the lower right, add a small angled English text block in uppercase reading {argument name="tagline text" default="MASTER TEXT & IMAGE. SHAPE PERCEPTION. CONTROL THE OUTCOME."}. In the lower left corner, add a small brand signature reading "OKIHIRO AI CREATIVE MANIFESTO". The overall composition should feel like a modern creative manifesto poster, mixing fashion editorial photography, Japanese street advertising, bold typography, and minimalist graphic design.

items.title: 1960s Art-House Film Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a vertical poster composition on aged cream paper with a handmade analog feel. Use rough ripped paper edges, layered magazine cutouts, photocopy grain, halftone texture, ink bleed, and slightly imperfect screen-print registration. Keep the subject as the main black-and-white photographic portrait, placed prominently in the center or upper center.

Surround the subject with graphic blocks of deep red, cobalt blue, warm yellow, black, and ivory. Add supporting collage fragments such as a rainy European street, film-strip borders, newspaper clippings, urban silhouettes, and cinematic details, arranged like a handmade 1960s art-house movie poster.

Use bold condensed typography with a strong visual hierarchy. Add large headline text: “{argument name="main title" default="[MAIN TITLE]"}”. Add smaller subtitle text: “{argument name="subtitle" default="[SUBTITLE]"}”. Add bottom text: “{argument name="event details" default="[BRAND NAME / EVENT NAME / COMING SOON / DATE]"}”. If needed, include a small top line reading “[TAGLINE]”.

The final result should feel cinematic, intellectual, rebellious, and editorial — like a lost 1960s European film poster with a strong point of view. Keep it raw, tactile, printed, imperfect, and handmade. Avoid a glossy modern finish.

A single adult woman sits on a large dark seaside rock in a three-quarter front pose, one hand resting behind her on the rock and the other relaxed near her side, with one thigh raised prominently toward the camera. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur censor centered over the face. She has very long, rich violet-purple hair with magenta highlights, styled with a thick braid draped over one shoulder and loose windswept strands flowing to the right, decorated with blue flower hair ornaments and gold accessories near one side of the head. She wears an elegant lavender, lilac, and deep purple Raiden Shogun-style cosplay outfit: a low-cut kimono-inspired bodice, translucent flowing sleeves, layered sash and obi with ornate circular gold-and-purple emblem at the waist, a jeweled choker with a purple gem, dangling blue-and-gold earrings, a black armored-looking forearm piece, and sheer purple thigh-high stockings with garter straps and decorative patterns. The lighting is natural golden beach daylight with soft highlights on skin and fabric, shallow depth of field, and a luxurious editorial look. The background is a softly blurred shoreline with pale sand, shimmering water, sea mist, and a distant rocky island or cliff. Compose it as a full magazine cover with elegant fashion typography in dark royal purple. The masthead is huge across the top reading {argument name="magazine title" default="COSPLAY"}, with small top-left text "COSPLAY REALM MAGAZINE" and small top-right text "JANUARY 2024". Add left-side cover lines: "RAIDEN SHOGUN", "COSPLAY BY SAKURA", "BEHIND THE SCENES AT THE BEACH", and "EXCLUSIVE INTERVIEW" followed by smaller text "Sakura talks about her love for Genshin Impact". Add right-side cover lines: "GENSHIN IMPACT" with smaller text "SPECIAL EDITION", and at lower right "TOP COSER OF 2024" with smaller text "Sakura’s rise to stardom". Place a realistic barcode with small pricing text in the bottom-left corner. items.title: Old Shanghai Fusion Poster
items.titleZh: A vertical cultural travel poster on warm off-white textured paper, designed like a handcrafted 3D shadow-box collage that forms the silhouette of the Chinese character for Shanghai. Use a refined old-meets-new Shanghai theme with miniature architecture, street scenes, props, food, and typography, photographed straight-on with soft studio lighting and delicate drop shadows. The composition should feel elegant, editorial, nostalgic, and premium, with muted cream, brass gold, teal green, brick red, jade, and weathered wood tones. At the upper left, build the top section of the character from 1 modern glass skyscraper, 1 tall historic high-rise with a golden crown, 1 domed neoclassical waterfront building, 1 clock-tower civic building, 2 smaller background towers, 2 red vintage Shanghai trams, and 1 rickshaw. Beneath that, create a canal-town section with 2 tall red Oriental Pearl Tower spheres-and-columns motifs, 2 qipao dresses displayed vertically, 4 old shikumen and lane houses, 1 curved waterfront canal, 4 wooden boats on the water, and 2 gramophones placed at the far left and right edges. Across the center, place a large diagonal metallic-gold embossed title reading {argument name="headline text" default="SHANGHAI COLLECTION"} in bold retro 3D lettering. To the right of the upper composition, add hand-lettered vintage script text reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="OLD SHANGHAI FUSION"}. On the lower left, add serif text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="DESIGN POSTER"}. The lower half should form the rest of the character using traditional Chinese architectural miniatures and market objects: 1 large classical Chinese roofed building complex, 4 vertical neon-style shop signs with Chinese characters, 2 square decorative plaques, 1 small green ceramic ewer, 2 shallow food trays, 1 rectangular tray of 6 soup dumplings, 1 long tray with 3 white tanghulu-like skewered sweets, 2 round mooncakes, and 1 small sauce dish, 1 rectangular display shelf containing 4 steamed buns, 1 bowl of noodles, 2 golden pastries, 1 plate of white flower-shaped sweets, 1 small doll figurine, and 2 painted opera masks, plus 2 hanging newspapers at the lower right. Keep the background spacious and minimal, with the collage and text arranged diagonally for a sophisticated poster layout. Make the whole image look like a meticulously assembled handmade paper-and-wood diorama, combining Art Deco Shanghai glamour, Republican-era nostalgia, Jiangnan water-town charm, and traditional Chinese market culture.

items.title: Beijing Cultural Heritage Poster
items.titleZh: A refined vertical cultural exhibition poster on a warm ivory textured paper background, designed with abundant negative space and an elegant museum-catalog aesthetic. The centerpiece is one monumental piece of Chinese calligraphy formed as sculptural 3D architectural typography, reading {argument name="main Chinese character" default="北京"} as two large interconnected characters built entirely from miniature Beijing heritage landmarks and traditional decorative elements. The strokes are constructed like carved lacquer and wood architectural fragments in rich vermilion red, aged gold, jade green, turquoise blue, stone gray, and ivory, with exquisite relief detail, soft shadows, and a handcrafted collectible feel. Across the calligraphy, integrate iconic Beijing imagery: palace roofs with glazed tiles, temple pavilions, stairways, carved balustrades, watchtowers, a winding section of the Great Wall, ornamental clouds, guardian lion sculptures, small old trees, golden ginkgo branches and leaves, hanging red lanterns, a Beijing opera mask, a skewer of glossy candied hawthorn, the Temple of Heaven, and a plated roast duck tucked into one lower stroke. Make the composition feel like a cultural miniature world embedded inside each brushstroke, with realistic depth, crisp surface detail, and subtle museum lighting from the upper left. Add sparse typography around the main artwork in a sophisticated editorial layout: at upper left, a tiny emblem and the words "BEIJING CHINA", beneath it "2024" and "CITY CULTURE SERIES" in small thin serif capitals; at upper right, a vertical Chinese title reading "北京 一座城的壮阔史诗" with several smaller vertical lines of Chinese copy and a red seal stamp; at lower left, large elegant serif text reading {argument name="city name in English" default="BEIJING"} and beneath it {argument name="subtitle" default="ETERNAL GLORY"}, followed by smaller text "EXHIBITION POSTER", "NO.2024-001", and tiny heritage-themed footer copy; at lower right, tiny small-cap text reading {argument name="tagline" default="TIMELESS HERITAGE"} and "CULTURAL LEGACY OF A THOUSAND YEARS". Keep the overall style luxurious, poetic, highly detailed, and premium, blending Chinese traditional culture, architectural miniature art, and contemporary poster design.

items.title: Anime Folding Bike Event Poster
items.titleZh:
A bright, cheerful anime-style promotional poster for a folding bike cycling event, designed like a polished Japanese advertisement with dense typography, stickers, callouts, and event info panels. The scene shows a sunny riverside promenade under a vivid blue sky with fluffy clouds, green tree branches framing the top right, flower beds, bunting, drifting petals, and a distant modern city skyline across the water. In the foreground, a cute teen/young adult anime girl with {argument name="hair color" default="light chestnut brown"} shoulder-length wavy hair, side-swept bangs, and two colorful hairpins smiles directly at the viewer and winks with one eye. She is posed in dynamic perspective, reaching one hand toward the camera as if inviting the viewer to join her. She wears a yellow hooded windbreaker, a white T-shirt printed with colorful bicycle lettering, dark blue shorts, black thigh-high stockings, and a light blue backpack. Beside her is a mint-green compact folding bicycle labeled "FOLDY," shown unfolded and parked on the promenade with visible small wheels, frame hinge, handlebars, saddle, pedals, and kickstand, emphasizing portability and urban leisure cycling. Use a glossy, high-saturation anime poster aesthetic with clean linework, soft facial rendering, energetic lighting, and playful graphic decoration.

Fill the poster with Japanese ad-style layout elements. At the top left, a huge multicolored headline reads "Let’s FOLDING RIDE!" in oversized playful bubble and block lettering, with a smaller curved Japanese line above it reading "さあ、いっしょに出かけよう！" and a blue ribbon-like subtitle below reading "フォールディングバイクで、もっと自由に、もっと遠くへ！". At the upper right, place a yellow burst badge with a tiny flag icon containing the text "フォールディングバイク サイクリングイベント 開催！". Add a white speech bubble near the girl’s face with pink outline and handwritten-feel Japanese text: "ねえ、キミ！ 折りたたみは どこへでも行けるよ♪ 一緒に 行こっ！". Near the bicycle, include a small angled sticker with text "コンパクトにたためて 持ち運びラクラク♪". Near the lower center-left, add a section label "イベントの楽しみポイント♪" followed by exactly 4 round icon features in pastel circles: 1) a pink bicycle icon with text "折りたたみで 持ち運び自由！" 2) a blue camera icon with text "フォトスポットで 思い出を残そう！" 3) a yellow drink icon with text "カフェタイムで ほっとひと息♪" 4) a purple gift icon with text "オリジナルグッズ プレゼント！".

On the lower right, add a rounded white information card with green accents titled "FOLDING BIKE サイクリングイベント" and large pink date text "6.15(日)". Inside the card, present exactly 4 event detail rows with colored circular icons: 1) calendar row: "開催日 2025. ※雨天時は6.22(日)に順延" 2) location row: "集合所 みなとみらい 臨港パーク" with smaller note "(神奈川県横浜市)" 3) course row: "コース みなとみらい〜湾沿いの気持ちいいルートを走ります" with smaller note "(約20km、初心者安心！)" 4) fee row: "参加費 3,000円" with smaller note "(保険・記念品付き) ※レンタルバイクあり（要予約）". At the bottom of this card, add a pink strip reading "初心者歓迎！ひとり参加も大歓迎！". Along the very bottom of the poster, create a wide pink banner with large Japanese copy "さあ、次の休日は一緒に走ろう！" and smaller text on the left "お申し込み・詳細は公式サイトへ！". In the center-bottom place a search-bar style box containing {argument name="search text" default="フォールディングライド 2025"}. To its right, add a black-and-white QR code and a pink label reading "エントリーはこちらから！". In the bottom-right corner, include a small inset photo-style illustration of two cyclists riding together with a handwritten note "たのしいかも♡". Maintain a lively, magazine-quality event poster composition with exactly 1 main character, 1 folding bike, 1 large event info card, 1 speech bubble, 1 yellow burst badge, 1 angled portability sticker, 4 feature icons, 1 QR code, and 1 inset image.

Across the lower middle are 3 younger schoolgirls in matching uniforms: short-sleeve pale blue shirts with navy ribbon ties and dark blue skirts. The left girl points upward excitedly with one arm raised and wears a small shoulder bag; the center girl holds an exhibition booklet upright; the right girl drinks from a clear water bottle while looking toward the scene. Give all 4 girls lively anime-style faces, glossy hair, soft shading, and energetic museum-outing body language. Fill the poster with dense Japanese typography and decorative graphic shapes. Place a large bold main headline on the left reading {argument name="headline text" default="国宝を見に行こう!"}, with oversized gold and black calligraphy-style characters and one red-highlighted character. Above it, add smaller text: "千手観音、祈りの宇宙". Add a red circular callout near the top left that says "はじめての美術館にもおすすめ!" and a white cloud-shaped speech bubble near the top right that says "いっしょに新しい発見をしよう!". Add a gold ribbon banner under the main headline reading "アスキー美術館 GW開催". Include a pale blue circular information box on the left with 5 lines of Japanese copy describing the statue: "国宝 千手観音立像", "千の手が、千年の祈りを", "伝える", "圧巻のスケールを、", "その目で感じてみて。". In the lower left, place a dark rectangular exhibition plaque with gold trim and 5 text lines: "アスキー美術館 GW特別展", the large title "国宝展", then "千手観音、祈りの宇宙", then the date line {argument name="event dates" default="2026.4.26 SAT - 6.15 SUN"}. Along the bottom center, add the museum name in large text: {argument name="museum name" default="アスキー美術館"}, followed by a smaller address line and nearest-station access text in Japanese. Add a red-and-black slogan along the bottom right: "心に残る体験が、きっとここに。". Overall mood: inviting, educational, elegant, and exciting, combining sacred cultural grandeur with cheerful youthful discovery, like a fictional premium museum advertisement generated as a complete poster with integrated typography.

items.title: French New Wave Torn Poster Collage
items.titleZh: A vintage 1960s French New Wave cinema poster collage on aged beige paper, designed like a torn-paper art-house one-sheet with analog grain, distressed print texture, rough ripped edges, ink wear, halftone imperfections, and slight misregistration. Center the composition around a large black-and-white portrait of a woman with messy dark hair, hand raised to her face, holding a cigarette, cropped from the chest up, with her face obscured by a rectangular blur block. Use a layered collage layout with exactly 8 major paper elements: 1) a top-left black text block reading "LES FILMS DU CARREFOUR présentent" above the large stacked name "ANNA KARINA" and smaller text "dans un film de JEAN-LUC GODARD"; 2) a red torn quote panel on the left reading "Il faut essayer d’être jeune comme on peut. - GODARD"; 3) a blue torn panel in the upper right with a black label reading "PRIX JEAN VIGO 1962"; 4) a narrow torn newspaper clipping on the upper right reading "l’amour est plus fort que la mort"; 5) a yellow torn panel on the mid-right showing a black silhouette of a man in a hat facing a woman, beside a vertical black filmstrip border with white sprocket holes; 6) a bottom-left black-and-white Paris street photo with wet pavement, a lamppost, pedestrians, and a visible sign reading "HOTEL DU NORD"; 7) a small bottom-left review text block reading '"LE FILM QUI A CHANGÉ LE CINÉMA" - CAHIERS DU CINÉMA'; 8) a bottom-right cropped black-and-white portrait of a man in a suit with his face obscured by a rectangular blur block, partially covered by a red torn paper shape. Across the lower middle, place the huge torn-paper title in bold condensed uppercase: "À BOUT DE" in black and "SOUFFLE" in red, slightly angled and spanning most of the width. Under the title, add a blue torn strip with white uppercase text "UNE HISTOIRE D’AMOUR ET DE LIBERTÉ". At the bottom center, add "COMING SOON" in black uppercase and below it "LES FILMS DU CARREFOUR". Limit the palette to faded cream, black, deep ultramarine blue, muted poster red, and mustard yellow. The overall mood is rebellious, romantic, and cinematic, like an iconic French New Wave poster made from ripped magazines, street photography, and bold typography.
items.promptZh: 复古 1960 年代法国新浪潮电影海报拼贴画，采用旧米色纸制成，设计类似于撕碎的艺术单页纸，具有模拟纹理、仿旧的印刷纹理、粗糙的撕裂边缘、墨水磨损、半色调缺陷和轻微的套准不准。构图以一幅大型黑白肖像为中心，该肖像是一位有着凌乱黑发的女性，手举到脸上，手里拿着一支香烟，从胸部向上剪裁，她的脸被矩形模糊块遮挡。使用具有 8 个主要纸张元素的分层拼贴布局：1) 左上角的黑色文本块，上面写着“LES FILMS DU CARREFOUR présentent”，上面是大的堆叠名称“ANNA KARINA”和较小的文本“dans un film de JEAN-LUC GODARD”； 2) 左侧有一个红色撕破的引文板，上面写着“Il faut essayer d’être jeune comme on peut. - GODARD”； 3) 右上角有一块蓝色撕破的面板，上面有黑色标签，上面写着“PRIX JEAN VIGO 1962”； 4）右上角有一张撕破的窄剪报，上面写着“l'amour est plus fort que la mort”； 5) 右中角有一个黄色撕裂的面板，显示一个戴着帽子的男人面对着一个女人的黑色剪影，旁边是带有白色链轮孔的垂直黑色胶片边框； 6) 左下角的黑白巴黎街头照片，上面有湿漉漉的人行道、路灯柱、行人以及写着“HOTEL DU NORD”的明显标志； 7) 左下角的一个小评论文本块，上面写着“LE FILM QUI A CHANGÉ LE CINÉMA” - CAHIERS DU CINÉMA”； 8）右下角裁剪的一个穿着西装的男人的黑白肖像，他的脸被矩形模糊块遮挡，部分被红色撕纸形状覆盖。在中下方，将巨大的撕纸标题以粗体压缩大写形式放置：黑色的“À BOUT DE”和红色的“SOUFFLE”，稍微倾斜并跨越大部分宽度。在标题下添加一条蓝色撕裂条，上面写有白色大写文字“UNE HISTOIRE D’AMOUR ET DE LIBERTÉ”。在底部中心添加黑色大写的“COMING SOON”，并在其下方添加“LES FILMS DU CARREFOUR”。将调色板限制为褪色奶油色、黑色、深群青蓝、柔和的海报红和芥末黄。整体气氛是叛逆、浪漫和电影化的，就像一张由撕破的杂志、街头摄影和大胆的排版制成的标志性法国新浪潮海报。

items.title: French New Wave Protest Film Poster
items.titleZh: Create a vintage French New Wave political cinema poster as a torn-paper collage, vertical one-sheet composition, aged and distressed like a weathered 1968 street poster pasted on a wall. Use a limited palette of cream paper, faded black, deep red, mustard yellow, and muted cobalt blue, with heavy analog film grain, halftone print texture, ink bleed, fold creases, scratches, rough paper fibers, ripped edges, glue stains, and slightly misregistered letterpress typography. In the center, place a large black-and-white portrait of a brooding young man in a dark coat, seen in three-quarter profile, cropped from chest up, with curly dark hair and his face partially obscured by a rectangular censor-like paper block, giving the image a mysterious art-house feel. Surround the portrait with torn collage fragments: at upper left, a red paper panel with a black silhouette of a running protester; beneath it, a narrow off-white text strip reading “PARIS, MAI 68” and smaller French copy “LES MURS ONT DES OREILLES, L’AVENIR AUSSI.”; along the far left edge, a vertical black film-strip border with “36 KODAK TRI-X PAN FILM” in white; at lower left, a mustard-yellow torn panel with a cropped dark silhouette portrait; at upper right, a blue torn panel containing the quote “UN FILM COUP DE POING ET DE POÉSIE.” with “— CAHIERS DU CINÉMA” below; directly below that, a tall black-and-white photo fragment of a lone figure walking down a wet Paris street at night under lampposts; near the middle-right, a small torn newsprint block with the French slogan “LA BEAUTÉ EST DANS LA RUE” above a crowd scene; at lower right, a red torn panel with a black silhouette of a domed Paris landmark. Across the very top, centered in narrow black capitals, add the tagline “NOT EVERY REVOLUTION IS TELEVISED.” Near the lower middle, in small black condensed type, add “A FILM BY {argument name="director name" default="JEAN-PIERRE LEMAIRE"}”. Make the main title dominate the lower half in huge condensed red uppercase letters over torn cream paper: “{argument name="French title" default="L’HOMME QUI RÊVAIT"}”. Directly underneath, in smaller blue condensed capitals, add the English subtitle “{argument name="English subtitle" default="THE MAN WHO DREAMED"}”. At the bottom center, place a black strip with large white condensed capitals reading “COMING SOON”, and below it smaller text “ÉTÉ 1968”. In the bottom left corner, include a Cannes-style laurel mark with “SÉLECTION OFFICIELLE FESTIVAL DE CANNES 1968”. In the bottom right corner, add tiny production credits in French, including “UNE PRODUCTION LES FILMS DU SOLEIL DISTRIBUTION”. Keep the whole design asymmetrical, raw, rebellious, and elegant, evoking Godard, Truffaut, May 1968 protest graphics, and handmade French art-house poster collage.
items.promptZh: 创建一张老式的法国新浪潮政治电影海报，采用撕纸拼贴画、垂直单页构图，陈旧且破旧，就像一张贴在墙上的 1968 年风化街头海报。使用有限的奶油色纸、褪色黑色、深红色、芥末黄和柔和的钴蓝色调色板，并带有厚重的模拟胶片颗粒、半色调打印纹理、墨水渗色、折叠折痕、划痕、粗糙的纸纤维、撕裂的边缘、胶水污渍和轻微套准不准的凸版印刷。在中心，放置了一幅巨大的黑白肖像，画的是一位穿着深色外套、沉思的年轻人，四分之三的侧面轮廓，从胸部向上剪裁，有一头卷曲的深色头发，他的脸部分被矩形检查器状的纸块遮住，给图像带来了一种神秘的艺术之家的感觉。肖像周围布满了撕碎的拼贴碎片：左上角是一个红色纸面板，上面有一个奔跑的抗议者的黑色剪影；其下方是一条狭窄的灰白色文字条，上面写着“PARIS, MAI 68”和较小的法文文字“LES MURS ONT DES OREILLES, L’AVENIR AUSSI。”；沿着最左边缘，有一个垂直的黑色胶片条边框，上面写着白色的“36 KODAK TRI-X PAN FILM”；左下角是一块芥末黄色的撕破的面板，上面有一张剪裁过的深色剪影肖像；右上角是一块蓝色撕破的面板，上面写着“UN FILM COUP DE POING ET DE POÉSIE”。下面有“—电影手册”；正下方是一张高大的黑白照片片段，照片上是一个孤独的身影在夜间在潮湿的巴黎街道上的灯柱下行走；靠近中右翼的地方，人群场景上方有一个撕破的小新闻纸块，上面写着法语口号“LA BEAUTÉ EST DANS LA RUE”；右下角是一块红色撕裂的面板，上面有巴黎圆顶地标的黑色轮廓。在最顶部，以狭窄的黑色大写字母为中心，添加标语“并非所有革命都会电视转播”。靠近中下部分，以黑色小字体添加“A FILM BY {argument name="director name" default="JEAN-PIERRE LEMAIRE"}”。使主标题在撕破的奶油色纸上以巨大的压缩红色大写字母占据下半部分：“{argument name =“French title”default =“L'HOMME QUI RÊVAIT”}”。在正下方，用较小的蓝色压缩大写字母添加英文副标题“{argument name="English subtitle" default="THE MAN WHO DREAMED"}”。在底部中心放置一条黑色条带，上面写有大号白色浓缩大写字母“COMING SOON”，下方是较小的文字“ÉTÉ 1968”。在左下角，包括一个戛纳风格的桂冠标记，上面写着“SÉLECTION OFFICIELLE FESTIVAL DE CANNES 1968”。在右下角，用法语添加微小的制作人员名单，包括“UNE PRODUCTION LES FILMS DU SOLEIL DISTRIBUTION”。保持整个设计不对称、原始、叛逆和优雅，让人想起戈达尔、特吕弗、1968 年 5 月的抗议图形和手工制作的法国艺术海报拼贴画。

Use a limited palette of cream paper, faded black, deep red, mustard yellow, and muted cobalt blue, with heavy analog film grain, halftone print texture, ink bleed, fold creases, scratches, rough paper fibers, ripped edges, glue stains, and slightly misregistered letterpress typography. In the center, place a large black-and-white portrait of a brooding young man in a dark coat, seen in three-quarter profile, cropped from chest up, with curly dark hair and his face partially obscured by a rectangular censor-like paper block, giving the image a mysterious art-house feel. Surround the portrait with torn collage fragments: at upper left, a red paper panel with a black silhouette of a running protester; beneath it, a narrow off-white text strip reading “PARIS, MAI 68” and smaller French copy “LES MURS ONT DES OREILLES, L’AVENIR AUSSI.”; along the far left edge, a vertical black film-strip border with “36 KODAK TRI-X PAN FILM” in white; at lower left, a mustard-yellow torn panel with a cropped dark silhouette portrait; at upper right, a blue torn panel containing the quote “UN FILM COUP DE POING ET DE POÉSIE.” with “— CAHIERS DU CINÉMA” below; directly below that, a tall black-and-white photo fragment of a lone figure walking down a wet Paris street at night under lampposts; near the middle-right, a small torn newsprint block with the French slogan “LA BEAUTÉ EST DANS LA RUE” above a crowd scene; at lower right, a red torn panel with a black silhouette of a domed Paris landmark. Across the very top, centered in narrow black capitals, add the tagline “NOT EVERY REVOLUTION IS TELEVISED.” Near the lower middle, in small black condensed type, add “A FILM BY {argument name="director name" default="JEAN-PIERRE LEMAIRE"}”. Make the main title dominate the lower half in huge condensed red uppercase letters over torn cream paper: “{argument name="French title" default="L’HOMME QUI RÊVAIT"}”. Directly underneath, in smaller blue condensed capitals, add the English subtitle “{argument name="English subtitle" default="THE MAN WHO DREAMED"}”. At the bottom center, place a black strip with large white condensed capitals reading “COMING SOON”, and below it smaller text “ÉTÉ 1968”. In the bottom left corner, include a Cannes-style laurel mark with “SÉLECTION OFFICIELLE FESTIVAL DE CANNES 1968”. In the bottom right corner, add tiny production credits in French, including “UNE PRODUCTION LES FILMS DU SOLEIL DISTRIBUTION”. Keep the whole design asymmetrical, raw, rebellious, and elegant, evoking Godard, Truffaut, May 1968 protest graphics, and handmade French art-house poster collage.

items.titleZh: A clean, warm, minimalist promotional poster for a coding study meetup, in a soft lifestyle-photography plus editorial design style. Show 3 young adults seated around a light wooden table in a bright neutral room, collaborating with laptops and notebooks. The group consists of 2 men and 1 woman, all casually dressed in muted colors; the person on the left wears a dark navy sweater, the woman in the center-right wears an off-white knit top, and the person on the far right wears a light gray hoodie in side profile. Their faces are softly obscured and not detailed. Place 2 open silver laptops on the table, 2 ceramic mugs, 2 notebooks, 1 smartphone, and 1 pen visible near the right person’s hand. Compose the people on the right half of the image, with a large pale sage-green organic blob shape behind them as a graphic backdrop. Keep the lighting soft, natural, airy, and slightly warm, with lots of negative space on the left. On the left side, add large elegant headline typography reading {argument name="headline text" default="Claude Code"} on one line and {argument name="subheadline text" default="勉強会"} below it in large Japanese characters. Under the headline, add a thin dotted horizontal divider line, then 2 lines of smaller Japanese body text reading {argument name="body text" default="集まって、学んで、つくって、\n一緒にスキルをアップデートしよう。"}. Use an off-white background, restrained Japanese cafe-meets-tech branding, balanced whitespace, and a polished social-media event flyer aesthetic with a 16:9 horizontal composition.

items.title: Retro AI Creative Brand Poster
items.titleZh: Create a retro cinematic personal-brand poster in a distressed 1970s propaganda-meets-film-advertising style, landscape orientation, with a thick worn black border and heavy paper grain, ink bleed, halftone texture, scuffed edges, and aged print imperfections. Use a bold limited palette of deep black, warm cream, saturated poster red, and mustard yellow. The composition is a single unified poster with a large cropped portrait of {argument name="character name" default="HOSSEIN"} on the left half, shown from chest up, wearing dark sunglasses, a dark shirt, a chain necklace, and a mustard yellow jacket, with short dark hair styled up; the face is intentionally obscured by a centered rectangular block in muted taupe-gray, creating an editorial anonymized look. On the far left, place a vertical black panel containing 2 stacked “AI” blocks and 1 subtitle: top block reads “AI”, beneath it the subtitle reads “CREATIVE AGENT”, lower down another large “AI” sits over a gold circuit-board graphic. Across the center-right, place the main diagonal cream title band with huge black condensed lettering for the name {argument name="main name text" default="HOSSEIN"} and an oversized red “AI” at the far right of the band. Beneath the large name, add a small stretched subtitle line reading “AI CINEMATOGRAPHER · ADVERTIVE FOR BRAND”. In the top-right corner, add a 3-line stacked headline reading {argument name="top right headline" default="AI CINEMATOGRAPHER ADVERTIVE FOR BRAND"} in bold cream text on red. On the red field below the title band, include exactly 4 stacked black label boxes with cream text: “CINEMATOGRAPHER”, “AI CREATOR”, “VISUAL ARTIST”, and “BRAND ADVISOR”. Near the right side, add a handwritten white script note with exactly 3 lines: “Visual Storyteller”, “Brand Builder”, and “AI Explore”. In the lower area, arrange exactly 6 creative-tech objects: 1 circular orange graphic icon, 1 white audio waveform/equalizer graphic, 1 black film clapperboard labeled with “AI”, 1 open silver laptop, 1 pair of black headphones, and 1 large professional cinema camera body with visible “RED” marking; also include the edge of a music keyboard/controller at the bottom right. In the bottom-right corner, place a small dark terminal-style text block with tiny white monospace lines suggesting AI-generated visuals and analytics. Keep the whole design bold, gritty, and highly graphic, like a premium personal branding poster for an AI creative director and visual storyteller.
items.promptZh: 以 1970 年代宣传与电影广告相结合的仿旧风格、横向制作复古电影个人品牌海报，具有厚重的磨损黑色边框和厚重的纸纹、墨水渗色、半色调纹理、磨损的边缘和老化的印刷缺陷。使用深黑色、暖奶油色、饱和的海报红和芥末黄等大胆的有限调色板。构图是一张统一的海报，左半部分是一张大幅裁剪的{argument name="character name" default="HOSSEIN"}肖像，从胸部向上显示，戴着深色墨镜，穿着深色衬衫、项链和芥末黄色夹克，深色短发盘起；脸部被有意地用柔和的灰褐色矩形块遮挡，营造出编辑匿名的外观。在最左边，放置一个垂直的黑色面板，其中包含 2 个堆叠的“AI”块和 1 个字幕：顶部块写着“AI”，其下方的副标题写着“CREATIVE AGENT”，下方另一个大“AI”位于金色电路板图形上方。在中间偏右的位置，放置主对角线奶油色标题带，并在带子的最右侧放置一个巨大的黑色压缩字体{argument name =“main name text”default =“HOSSEIN”}，并在带子的最右侧放置一个超大的红色“AI”。在大名字下面，添加一个小的拉长副标题行，写着“AI CINEMATOGRAPHER·ADVERTIVE FOR BRAND”。在右上角，添加一个 3 行堆叠标题，内容为红色粗体奶油色文本：{argument name="top right title" default="AI CINEMATOGRAPHER ADVERTIVE FOR BRAND"}。在标题带下方的红色字段中，恰好包含 4 个带有奶油色文本的堆叠黑色标签框：“电影摄影师”、“AI 创造者”、“视觉艺术家”和“品牌顾问”。在右侧附近，添加一个手写的白色脚本注释，其中只有 3 行：“Visual Storyteller”、“Brand Builder”和“AI Explore”。在下部区域，正好排列了6个创意科技物品：1个圆形橙色图形图标、1个白色音频波形/均衡器图形、1个标有“AI”的黑色电影拍板、1台打开的银色笔记本电脑、1副黑色耳机、1个带有可见“RED”标记的大型专业电影摄影机机身；还包括右下角音乐键盘/控制器的边缘。在右下角，放置一个小的深色终端样式文本块，其中带有微小的白色等宽线，建议人工智能生成的视觉效果和分析。保持整个设计大胆、坚韧和高度图形化，就像人工智能创意总监和视觉故事讲述者的优质个人品牌海报一样。

items.titleZh: Create a high-contrast urban {argument name="style" default="streetwear poster"} featuring a {argument name="subject" default="young man"} sitting casually on the ground against a dark textured background. The subject wears a charcoal oversized hoodie, black cargo pants, and monochrome sneakers, with messy hair and minimal accessories. Add soft cinematic lighting with subtle shadows to highlight facial structure and outfit details. Typography should be bold, modern, and oversized, integrated into the background layout. Use a mix of white and electric blue accents. Main text (large, broken layout): “{argument name="main text" default="UNWIND"}” Secondary text: “Silence the noise, find your pace.” Small caption text: “Less rush, more presence.” Add abstract geometric elements like thin lines, circles, and glitch textures. Include subtle grain and noise for a raw editorial feel. Composition should feel like a fashion magazine cover mixed with a streetwear campaign. Color palette: Black, white, deep grey, electric blue highlights. Style: Minimalist, cinematic, edgy, modern editorial, slightly futuristic.

The setting is an older concrete apartment building interior with glossy reflective floor tiles, stained off-white walls, multiple apartment doors on both sides, and a cold fluorescent ceiling light receding into the distance. One apartment door on the right side is slightly open, emitting a vivid supernatural purple glow that spills into the hallway and creates rippling light patterns across the wall and floor. On the left foreground, include 2 beverage vending machines with illuminated rows of drinks. At the lower right, place a small magazine rack or stand holding several pamphlets, with the front magazine showing Japanese text including "月刊オカルト". items.title: Absurd Tabloid Panther Newspaper Front Page
items.titleZh:
A realistic, slightly humorous tabloid newspaper front page photographed from above on a wooden table, designed to look like a printed broadsheet with subtle paper texture, fold marks, and mild lens distortion. The masthead at top left reads “The Daily Metro”, the date line near the top center reads “Friday, April 22, 2005”, and the top-right section marker reads “CITY NEWS | 05”. A red banner near the upper left says “EXCLUSIVE STORY”. The dominant oversized black headline spans multiple lines: “Zoo Panther Caught Living Double Life – As a Charming Bar Hopping Casanova!” Below it, a large subheadline reads: ““Marquise” the Panther Escapes Zoo at Night, Spends Eveningsvlenlars, Becomes Heartthrob Among Lonely Women”. The page layout should mimic a sensational tabloid with 1 huge headline area, 1 large main photo on the upper right, 1 small inset photo under the main text on the left, 3 narrow text columns with dense newspaper copy in the center-left, 1 pull-quote box in the middle, 1 lower-left secondary story block with a panther portrait, 3 small bottom photo thumbnails in a row, and 1 right-side sidebar box titled “What’s Next For Mamquiss?”. Keep most body text tiny and partly nonsensical or pseudo-legible like AI-generated newspaper filler, but preserve the major visible headlines exactly.

The main photo on the upper right shows the back view of a glamorous blonde woman in a silky champagne-colored dress standing at a bar beside a large black panther upright on a stool or standing with forepaws elevated near the counter. The bar background contains many liquor bottles and glassware on shelves, warmly lit. The woman’s face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur/block. The panther is sleek, glossy, and realistically rendered. The inset photo under the headline at left shows the black panther near a zoo exit or pathway sign at night. The lower-left portrait shows a close-up of the panther’s face. The 3 bottom thumbnails show nightlife scenes: the panther moving through a bar interior, the panther seated near two women at a small round table, and the panther lounging in dim warm light.

Use an early-2000s tabloid aesthetic, high-contrast black headline typography, off-white newsprint, red accent rules, narrow columns, and slightly messy authentic newspaper composition. The overall tone is deadpan absurdist journalism, realistic enough to glance as a real newspaper, with the page filling most of the frame and photographed in natural indoor light.
items.promptZh:
一张写实、略带幽默的小报头版，从上方在木桌上拍摄，设计看起来像印刷大报，具有微妙的纸张纹理、折叠痕迹和轻微的镜头畸变。左上角的报头写着“The Daily Metro”，靠近顶部中心的日期线写着“Friday, April 22, 2005”，右上角的部分标记写着“CITY NEWS | 05”。左上角附近的红色横幅上写着“独家故事”。占主导地位的超大黑色标题跨越多行：“动物园黑豹过着双重生活——作为一个迷人的酒吧跳卡萨诺瓦！”其下方有一个大副标题：“黑豹“侯爵夫人”夜间逃离动物园，共度夜晚，成为孤独女性中的万人迷”。页面布局应模仿耸人听闻的小报，其中有 1 个巨大的标题区域，右上角有 1 张大的主照片，左侧主文本下方有 1 个小插图照片，中间左侧有 3 个狭窄的文本列，其中有密集的报纸副本，中间有 1 个引文框，1 个左下带有黑豹肖像的次要故事块，3 个连续的小底部照片缩略图，以及 1 个标题为“下一步是什么”的右侧边栏框曼奎斯？保持大部分正文文字很小，部分无意义或伪清晰，就像人工智能生成的报纸填充物一样，但要准确保留主要的可见标题。

右上角的主照片显示了一位迷人的金发女郎的后视图，她穿着丝绸般的香槟色连衣裙，站在酒吧里，旁边是一只直立在凳子上的大黑豹，或者站在柜台附近，前爪举高。酒吧背景架子上摆着许多酒瓶和玻璃器皿，灯光温暖。女人的脸故意被矩形模糊/块遮挡。黑豹造型时尚、有光泽、渲染逼真。左侧标题下的插图显示夜间动物园出口或道路标志附近的黑豹。左下肖像显示了黑豹脸部的特写。底部的 3 个缩略图显示了夜生活场景：黑豹在酒吧内部移动，黑豹坐在小圆桌旁边的两个女人旁边，黑豹懒洋洋地躺在昏暗的温暖灯光下。

使用 2000 年代初期的小报美学、高对比度黑色标题排版、灰白色新闻纸、红色重音规则、狭窄的栏目和略显凌乱的正宗报纸构图。整体基调是冷漠荒诞的新闻主义，足够逼真，看起来就像一份真正的报纸，页面占据了大部分画面，并在室内自然光下拍摄。

items.title: Autumn in New York Travel Poster
items.titleZh: A vertical editorial-style travel poster in Spanish for a {argument name="trip type" default="III viaje fotográfico"} titled “OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK,” designed with a sophisticated urban autumn mood and a premium photography-workshop aesthetic. Use a tall mobile-friendly poster layout with a warm off-white, beige, charcoal, and burnt orange palette. The composition is dominated by oversized condensed black sans-serif typography on the left: small text at the top reading “III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO,” then the huge stacked headline “OTOÑO” on top, a smaller “EN” with short horizontal orange lines on both sides, and below it the huge stacked words “NUEVA YORK.” On the right side, place a narrow informational column with exactly 4 short benefit lines in uppercase: “7 NOCHES”, “GRUPO REDUCIDO”, “GUÍAS EXPERTOS”, and “MILES DE FOTOS” with the last line in orange. Below that, add the dates in large orange numbers “17-24” and beneath in black uppercase “DE OCTUBRE” and “DE 2026.” Add a thin vertical line near the far right edge and a tiny orange dot at the top. Integrate a moody New York street photo collage into the lower half and through the typography, centered on the Manhattan Bridge framed by dark brick buildings, wet streets, a few cars, steam rising from the roadway, and a lone photographer seen from behind in the foreground wearing a rust-orange beanie and a backpack, holding a camera toward the bridge. Let giant cropped letterforms from “NYC” or similarly bold graphic shapes blend with the city imagery across the bottom half, creating a layered double-exposure poster effect. Add distressed paper textures, rough torn-edge overlays, brushy white paint textures, and subtle grunge for a handcrafted editorial finish. On the left lower-mid area, place a circular orange stamp containing a small Statue of Liberty torch icon and the curved text “III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO · OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK.” Along the bottom, create a dark band with 2 presenter credits, one left and one right, separated by a thin vertical orange line: left “CARLOS SÁNCHEZ” with “@CHOCUTUTS” in orange below, right “JON TARAFA” with “@JONTCPHOTO” in orange below. Centered at the very bottom, add the website “VIAJENY.COM” in spaced orange uppercase letters. Include 2 partially cropped grayscale portrait cutouts in the bottom corners, one on the left and one on the right, blending into the dark footer area. Overall style: cinematic travel advertisement, contemporary magazine poster, bold typographic hierarchy, layered collage, gritty New York autumn atmosphere, high contrast, elegant and dramatic.
items.promptZh: 标题为“OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK”的{argument name="trip type" default="III viaje fotográfico"}的西班牙语垂直编辑风格旅行海报，设计具有精致的都市秋季氛围和高级摄影工作室美学。使用适合移动设备的高大海报布局，并采用温暖的灰白色、米色、木炭色和焦橙色调色板。构图以左侧超大的压缩黑色无衬线字体为主：顶部的小文字写着“III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO”，然后顶部是巨大的堆叠标题“OTOÑO”，两侧有一个较小的“EN”，两侧有短水平橙色线，下面是巨大的堆叠文字“NUEVA YORK”。在右侧，放置一个狭窄的信息栏，其中包含 4 个大写的短福利行：“7 NOCHES”、“GRUPO REDUCIDO”、“GUÍAS EXPERTOS”和“MILES DE FOTOS”，最后一行为橙色。在其下方添加大橙色数字“17-24”的日期，并在下方添加黑色大写字母“DE OCTUBRE”和“DE 2026”。在最右边缘附近添加一条细垂直线，并在顶部添加一个橙色小点。将喜怒无常的纽约街头照片拼贴画融入下半部分并通过排版，以曼哈顿大桥为中心，周围是黑暗的砖砌建筑、潮湿的街道、几辆汽车、道路上升起的蒸汽，以及前景中一个孤独的摄影师，他戴着铁锈橙色无檐小便帽，背着背包，拿着相机对着桥。让“NYC”的巨型裁剪字体或类似的大胆图形形状与下半部分的城市图像融合，创造出分层的双曝光海报效果。添加仿旧纸张纹理、粗糙的撕裂边缘覆盖层、毛茸茸的白色油漆纹理和微妙的垃圾纹理，以实现手工制作的编辑效果。在左中下区域，放置一个圆形橙色印章，其中包含一个小自由女神像火炬图标和弯曲文本“III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO · OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK”。沿着底部，创建一条暗带，其中有 2 个演示者名单，一左一右，由一条垂直的橙色细线分隔：左侧为“CARLOS SÁNCHEZ”，下方为橙色“@CHOCUTUTS”，右侧为“JON TARAFA”，下方为橙色“@JONTCPHOTO”。在最底部居中，以橙色大写字母间隔添加网站“VIAJENY.COM”。在底角包括 2 个部分裁剪的灰度肖像切口，一个在左侧，一个在右侧，混合到深色页脚区域。整体风格：电影化的旅游广告，当代的杂志海报，大胆的排版层次，层次分明的拼贴，坚韧的纽约秋季氛围，高对比度，优雅而戏剧化。

The composition is dominated by oversized condensed black sans-serif typography on the left: small text at the top reading “III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO,” then the huge stacked headline “OTOÑO” on top, a smaller “EN” with short horizontal orange lines on both sides, and below it the huge stacked words “NUEVA YORK.” On the right side, place a narrow informational column with exactly 4 short benefit lines in uppercase: “7 NOCHES”, “GRUPO REDUCIDO”, “GUÍAS EXPERTOS”, and “MILES DE FOTOS” with the last line in orange. Below that, add the dates in large orange numbers “17-24” and beneath in black uppercase “DE OCTUBRE” and “DE 2026.” Add a thin vertical line near the far right edge and a tiny orange dot at the top. Integrate a moody New York street photo collage into the lower half and through the typography, centered on the Manhattan Bridge framed by dark brick buildings, wet streets, a few cars, steam rising from the roadway, and a lone photographer seen from behind in the foreground wearing a rust-orange beanie and a backpack, holding a camera toward the bridge. Let giant cropped letterforms from “NYC” or similarly bold graphic shapes blend with the city imagery across the bottom half, creating a layered double-exposure poster effect. Add distressed paper textures, rough torn-edge overlays, brushy white paint textures, and subtle grunge for a handcrafted editorial finish. On the left lower-mid area, place a circular orange stamp containing a small Statue of Liberty torch icon and the curved text “III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO · OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK.” Along the bottom, create a dark band with 2 presenter credits, one left and one right, separated by a thin vertical orange line: left “CARLOS SÁNCHEZ” with “@CHOCUTUTS” in orange below, right “JON TARAFA” with “@JONTCPHOTO” in orange below. Centered at the very bottom, add the website “VIAJENY.COM” in spaced orange uppercase letters. Include 2 partially cropped grayscale portrait cutouts in the bottom corners, one on the left and one on the right, blending into the dark footer area. items.title: Chaotic Fourth Crusade Parody Poster
items.titleZh: A chaotic fictional Japanese movie poster themed around world history, designed like a glossy blockbuster comedy-action epic about the Fourth Crusade getting completely lost and attacking Constantinople instead of reaching Jerusalem. The composition is dense, loud, and satirical, with a dramatic historical battlefield collage under a bright blue sky, flames, smoke, medieval ships, domes, city walls, and crusader armies. In the center foreground, a full-body medieval crusader in a dirty white tunic with a large red cross points directly toward the viewer, surrounded by four other medieval figures in ornate robes, hoods, helmets, and merchant-like clothing; their faces are obscured by soft rectangular blurs, making the poster look like a parody cast reveal. Across the top, huge hot-pink Japanese brush lettering reads {argument name="headline text" default="方向性、完全に迷子。"}, with smaller black Japanese tagline text above and below it. A torn vertical caption on the left side in bold yellow Japanese text explains that they meant to head for Jerusalem but somehow crush the Byzantine Empire. Two large parchment banners cross the upper middle area: one says that the original destination was Jerusalem, and the larger center banner declares in bold red Japanese text that the destination is Jerusalem, followed by smaller black text saying that was supposed to be the plan. On the upper right, a pinned parchment itinerary board contains a 5-step comedic route list with icons and arrows: departure, no money, bowing to Venice, lightly attacking Zara, then Constantinople, ending with a red line implying they somehow arrived there. Around the characters are exactly 8 speech balloons and callout labels: one saying “Eh, huh?”, one saying “No money…”, one saying “By order, let’s go.”, one saying “Slight detour.”, one saying “I failed, lol.”, one saying “Zara? We passed there!”, one label for a “contract” with a note that it is kind of expensive, and one pointing to Venice as a sponsor-like label. Additional wooden or parchment location signs label exactly 3 places: Zara, Venice, and Constantinople, with Japanese side notes identifying them as Christian or Byzantine cities. The lower half becomes darker and more catastrophic, showing a burning Byzantine-style city with a large domed church resembling Hagia Sophia, naval combat, collapsing architecture, orange firelight, and black smoke. At the bottom center, enormous distressed Japanese title typography in yellow and white announces the film as the Fourth Crusade and says Constantinople burns due to getting lost, with gritty texture, heavy drop shadows, and explosive blockbuster poster styling. On the right side of the title area, a red stamped burst says in Japanese that it begins around 1204. Along the very bottom is a narrow cast strip with exactly 6 small cast thumbnails labeled in Japanese, plus tiny fake credits running across the footer. In the bottom right corner, place a bright pink starburst badge with yellow and white Japanese text reading {argument name="badge text" default="史実です。信じられないけど。"}. Overall style: absurd historical parody, cinematic key art, Japanese theatrical poster, high detail, photobashed realism mixed with exaggerated graphic design, weathered paper textures, bold manga-like captions, comedic educational tone, epic war-movie energy.

Design a modern graphic poster titled “{argument name="title" default="Chill-out"}.”
The man wears a {argument name="clothing" default="red hoodie"}, black cuffed joggers, red and white Air Jordan high-top sneakers, dark sunglasses, and silver rings. He sits in a relaxed reclined pose leaning against oversized typography, one leg bent and the other slightly extended toward the viewer. His body angles right while his face turns toward the camera in a confident three-quarter view. Background is matte textured black.
Large bold white sans-serif text “chill” and “out” forms a bench-like structure, with “chill” underlined. Add orange circles, squares, thin white grid lines, and phrases: “Life is so much easier when you just chill-out” and “Less stress, more chill.”

items.title: Pastel Japanese Mobile Game Ad
items.titleZh: Create a cute Japanese mobile game advertisement poster split vertically into 2 equal halves, with a soft pastel watercolor background and glossy translucent bubbles scattered around the canvas. The left half has a mint green to pale yellow wash, and the right half has a cream to blush pink wash. At the top left, place a large rounded Japanese headline in bold teal green: {argument name="left headline text" default="見つけて、ひらめいて、にゃ。"}, with a smaller subtitle beneath it in muted brown-gray: {argument name="left subtitle text" default="やさしいヒントで誰でも遊べる"}. At the top right, place a large rounded Japanese headline in bold raspberry pink: {argument name="right headline text" default="ミニゲームも、たっぷり。"}, with a smaller subtitle beneath it in muted mauve-gray: {argument name="right subtitle text" default="記憶・パズル・スライドで遊びほうだい"}. Centered in each half is a black-bezel smartphone mockup shown straight-on. The left phone displays a hidden-object style game screen inside a bright greenhouse sunroom with lush tropical plants, a cream hammock stretched diagonally across the middle, pink tiled floor, warm sunlight through glass panels, hanging pastel glass orbs, lemons in the lower left foreground, and tiny cute character accents hidden in the scene; a Japanese room title appears at the top inside the phone UI: {argument name="left game screen title" default="おひるねサンルーム"}. The right phone displays a memory minigame screen on a pale pink interface with a back arrow, a centered Japanese title at the top reading "マカロン記憶ゲーム", a 3-step indicator showing 1 highlighted and 2 and 3 faded, small instruction text "よく見てにゃ…", and exactly 4 macarons arranged in a 2 by 2 grid: pink top left, blue top right, yellow bottom left, white bottom right, each on a soft circular shadow. Add small sparkling star icons and two decorative macarons at the bottom right outside the phone, plus tiny heart doodles nearby. The overall style is polished app-promo key art, kawaii, airy, elegant, soft-focus, with rounded typography, gentle gradients, subtle floral details, and a premium casual game advertisement look.

items.title: Sustainable T-Shirt Plantable Tag Ad
items.titleZh: A premium eco-conscious fashion advertisement, shot as a refined editorial product photo. A single off-white or natural cream crew-neck T-shirt hangs on a smooth wooden hanger with a black metal hook, placed against a lush wall of dense green leaves and climbing vines. The hanger has a small minimalist brand monogram engraved near the neck. The shirt is shown from the upper torso down to part of the hem, slightly angled, with soft natural folds and high-quality cotton texture. Printed inside the collar is a minimalist brand mark and the text "JUGGERKNOT ORIGINALS". Hanging from the neckline is 1 rectangular recycled-paper seed tag tied with rustic brown twine; the tag reads "Tulsi" and "Plantable Seed Tag" with a tiny sprouting seed detail near the bottom. From the tag, 1 real tulsi plant stem grows upward across the front of the shirt, with several fresh green leaves, visually demonstrating that the tag is plantable. Add a small fine-label annotation near the tag reading "TULSI PLANTABLE SEED TAG". On the right side, large elegant white serif typography says {argument name="headline text" default="Plant it."}. Beneath it, place 3 stacked lines of narrow uppercase sans-serif copy: "WEAR IT.", "PLANT IT.", and "GROW WITH IT.". At the lower left, add the brand name in spaced uppercase serif text: {argument name="brand name" default="JUGGERKNOT ORIGINALS"}, with a thin horizontal line above it. At the lower right, add 3 lines of small uppercase sans-serif text: "FSC® CERTIFIED PACKAGING.", "ZERO SYNTHETIC FIBRE", and "BACKED BY ZERODHA.". Use soft diffused daylight, shallow depth of field, moody green-and-cream color grading, luxury sustainable-brand aesthetics, clean composition, vertical poster layout, subtle shadows, and a calm organic atmosphere. Keep the design minimal, premium, and photorealistic, with the shirt occupying the left half and the typography balanced on the right.
items.promptZh: 优质的环保时尚广告，以精致的编辑产品照片形式拍摄。一件灰白色或天然奶油色圆领 T 恤挂在一个带有黑色金属挂钩的光滑木衣架上，衣架靠着茂密的绿叶和攀爬藤蔓的茂盛墙壁。衣架的颈部附近刻有一个小型简约品牌字母组合。衬衫从上身一直到下摆部分呈现，略带角度，具有柔和自然的褶皱和优质棉质的质感。衣领内侧印有简约的品牌标志和文字“JUGGERKNOT ORIGINALS”。领口悬挂着 1 个长方形再生纸种子标签，用质朴的棕色麻线绑住；标签上写着“图尔西”和“可种植种子标签”，底部附近有一个微小的发芽种子细节。从标签上，1根真正的图尔西植物茎向上生长，穿过衬衫的正面，并带有几片新鲜的绿叶，直观地表明标签是可种植的。在标签附近添加一个小的精细标签注释，上面写着“TULSI PLANTABLE SEED TAG”。在右侧，大而优雅的白色衬线字体写着{argument name =“headline text”default =“Plant it.”}。在其下方，放置 3 行堆叠的窄大写无衬线文本：“WEAR IT.”、“PLANT IT.”和“GROW WITH IT.”。在左下角，以间隔大写衬线文本添加品牌名称：{argument name="brand name" default="JUGGERKNOT ORIGINALS"}，其上方有一条细水平线。在右下角添加 3 行小的大写无衬线文本：“FSC® CERTIFIED PACKAGING.”、“ZERO SYNTHETIC FIBRE”和“BACKED BY ZERODHA.”。使用柔和的漫射日光、浅景深、喜怒无常的绿色和奶油色分级、奢华的可持续品牌美学、干净的构图、垂直的海报布局、微妙的阴影和平静的有机氛围。保持设计简约、优质且逼真，衬衫占据左半部分，右半部分的版式保持平衡。

items.title: Brutal Red-Kimono Manga Fight Page
items.titleZh: A gritty black-and-white manga action page with selective red color on the heroine’s clothing, arranged as 6 comic panels with dynamic diagonal borders on a white page. The central and largest panel shows a fierce young woman with long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair and blunt bangs, wearing a short red kimono-style robe with a wide golden obi sash, barefoot, delivering a high vertical kick into a burly man’s face; her face is obscured by a soft square blur, and the impact explodes with ink splatter and debris. In the top-left panel, the same woman crouches low in a feral fighting stance on cracked ground, one hand touching the earth, hair streaming outward, robe open enough to show powerful legs. A narrow close-up panel shows only her intense eyes under straight bangs, cold and focused. In the bottom-left panel, she drives a straight punch into an attacker with a dramatic burst effect at the point of contact. In the bottom-center panel, she performs a rising kick or sweeping upward strike against another large male opponent, with speed lines and hair flowing. In the bottom-right panel, shown from behind, she stands calmly amid defeated men lying on the ground with smoke or dust rising around them, her long hair cascading down her back and the red robe hanging loosely. Use rough ink brushwork, heavy speed lines, splattered impact effects, high-contrast manga shading, violent kinetic composition, and bold Japanese sound effect lettering in black. The mood is brutal, cinematic, and relentless, like a seinen revenge manga. Keep the page mostly monochrome except for the woman’s red robe and subtle warm sash accents.
items.promptZh: 坚韧的黑白漫画动作页面，女主角的衣服上有选择性的红色，在白色页面上排列为 6 个带有动态对角边框的漫画面板。中央和最大的面板展示了一位凶猛的年轻女子，留着长直发和钝刘海，穿着红色和服风格的短袍，系着宽大的金色腰带，赤着脚，向一个魁梧男人的脸发出一记高高的垂直踢击；她的脸被柔和的方形模糊物遮住了，冲击力随着墨水飞溅和碎片而爆炸。在左上角的面板中，同一个女人以一种狂野的战斗姿势低蹲在裂开的地面上，一只手接触地面，头发向外飘逸，长袍敞开，足以展示强有力的双腿。一个狭窄的特写镜头只能看到她直刘海下的一双锐利的眼睛，冷酷而专注。在左下面板中，她向攻击者发起一记直拳，并在接触点产生戏剧性的爆发效果。在底部中心面板中，她对另一个体型较大的男性对手进行上升踢或向上扫击，速度线和头发飘逸。在右下角的画作中，从后面看，她平静地站在倒在地上的失败者中间，周围烟雾或灰尘升起，她的长发从背上垂下来，红色长袍松松垮垮地垂下来。使用粗犷的水墨笔触、粗犷的速度线条、飞溅的冲击效果、高对比度的漫画阴影、暴力的动感构图以及大胆的黑色日式音效刻字。气氛是残酷的、电影般的、无情的，就像一部少年复仇漫画。除了女人的红色长袍和微妙的温暖腰带装饰之外，保持页面大部分为单色。

items.title: Art Deco Gotham Tram Poster
items.titleZh: A vintage Art Deco travel poster in a clean flat 2D 1950s-inspired illustration style, showing an elevated tram entering {argument name="city name" default="Gotham City"} at sunset. Use a tall vertical poster composition with strong geometric symmetry, sharp stepped deco framing, and no 3D relief or realistic textures. At the top, place a large angular Art Deco border in glowing peach-gold lines, with exactly 3 small circular dots centered near the top inside the frame. Inside this frame, set the headline {argument name="headline text" default="WELCOME TO GOTHAM CITY !"} in large elegant Art Deco lettering, stacked across 4 lines reading exactly: “WELCOME”, “TO”, “GOTHAM”, “CITY !”. Keep the typography crisp, centered, and integrated into the poster design. Below, create a stylized skyline of {argument name="city skyline style" default="futuristic Gotham skyscrapers"} with tall narrow towers, stepped crowns, spires, and simplified window slits; count 12 visible building masses across the skyline. Behind the buildings, place a large glowing half-sun low on the horizon. In the foreground, show 1 long streamlined elevated tram stretching diagonally from the lower left toward the lower right, with the front car prominent on the right side. The tram should have glowing cream windows, rounded front corners, exactly 3 circular lights on the front face, and overhead electric lines with elegant sweeping cables crossing the composition. Use exactly 2 visible rail tracks curving toward the viewer at the bottom. Palette: deep indigo, violet, plum, black, peach, amber, and warm cream gradients. Mood: nostalgic, sleek, cinematic, airy, optimistic retro-futurism. Make it look like a polished mid-century flat graphic poster for urban transit tourism.

A minimalist product advertisement with a {argument name="product" default="fried chicken bucket"} placed on a clean white podium.

Typography (center): “{argument name="headline" default="PURE CRUNCH"}”
