items.promptZh:
简约的产品广告，在干净的白色讲台上放置了一个{argument name="product" default="炸鸡桶"}。

In the top right corner, design a magazine issue block with the words "FEATURE", a very large outlined "01", "VOL.", "MEMMODE", "2024 SPRING", and small Japanese text "創刊号" stacked in a clean editorial layout. The background should be dense with electric magenta, hot pink, cyan, blue, and black abstract streaks, halftone dots, glitch textures, floating plus signs, diagonal slashes, and light flares, giving a loud next-generation visual-culture feel. Show exactly 5 characters: 1) upper left panel, a handsome androgynous anime boy with messy layered silver hair, pale skin, black clothing with straps, zippers, layered necklaces, and a cool dark streetwear look; 2) upper right panel, a cute anime girl with light lavender-pink hair in twin braids, large magenta-violet eyes, a black cap labeled {argument name="cap text" default="MEMMODE"}, black X-shaped hairpins, and a black-purple outfit; 3) center panel, the main featured chibi-faced character with short white hair tipped with cyan and pink, one bright blue eye and one pink eye, wearing a glossy black cap and futuristic black outfit, looking directly at the viewer; 4) lower left panel, a serious anime boy with black hair and a bold white forelock, golden amber eyes, earrings, black hoodie and jacket layers, and blue neon rim lighting; 5) lower right panel, a softer feminine character with wavy blond hair under a dark cap, wearing a choker and holding a silver microphone near the chest, styled in pink-purple lighting. items.title: Bold Potato Chips Advertising Poster
items.titleZh: Create a bold, high-impact commercial poster for a bag of potato chips in a bright warm orange-to-golden-yellow gradient background, with a dynamic snack-advertising layout and crisp studio lighting. The composition features one large open bag of chips in the lower right corner, tilted upward, overflowing with ridged golden potato chips, while exactly 9 clearly visible chips float around the upper and middle right area in midair with many small crumbs and seasoning flecks suspended for energy and motion. Use oversized distressed display typography stacked vertically on the left side reading exactly: “CRISPY.” on the top in dark reddish brown, “CRUNCHY.” in very large white letters, and “IRRESISTIBLE.” in saturated red-orange. Beneath that, place a dark brown brushstroke banner with handwritten cream script reading “Snack Happy!”. In the lower left corner, add one circular badge in red-orange with rough edges containing the text “MADE WITH REAL POTATOES” and smaller text “NO ARTIFICIAL FLAVORS”, plus 2 small potatoes illustrated at the bottom of the badge. Along the bottom edge, include exactly 3 simple white icon-and-text feature callouts separated evenly: “REAL POTATOES”, “NO ARTIFICIAL FLAVORS”, and “MADE FOR SNACK LOVERS”. The chip bag should be glossy metallic yellow with a large black irregular label shape on the front; inside it place the product name in big distressed white letters “{argument name="brand name" default="ZESTY"}” and below it a red banner with white text “{argument name="product type" default="POTATO CHIPS"}”, then smaller black text near the bottom right reading “{argument name="tagline text" default="BOLD FLAVOR. PERFECT CRUNCH."}”. Add a small rounded brand label in the upper left corner with the text “{argument name="headline brand" default="Pollo AI"}” and “GPT Image 2” beneath it. Emphasize appetizing texture, crunchy edges, realistic salt and seasoning specks, strong contrast, subtle grunge texture on the typography, and a polished modern supermarket-poster aesthetic ready for print or social promotion.

Black and white portrait photography with a clean off white studio background. Outfit includes a dark turtleneck layered under a textured tailored plaid blazer. Lighting is soft yet dramatic, creating sculpted facial shadows and elegant contrast. Magazine layout design with oversized serif masthead text at the top reading “{argument name="masthead text" default="VOGUE"}”, partially hidden behind the subject’s head. Minimal premium typography across the page. Add side text “FASHION”, issue date “{argument name="issue date" default="2026 MAY"}”, left side headline “27 DIFFERENT STYLES”, and bold bottom right cover line “LOOK FAMOUS”. Include a small red translucent square overlay on one eye area with the word “CATCHY”. Style should feel premium, modern, cinematic, clean composition, sharp focus, ultra realistic skin texture, editorial luxury aesthetic, balanced negative space, timeless fashion cover design. Vertical magazine ratio, high resolution.

items.title: Japanese Streetwear Editorial Poster
items.titleZh: A moody editorial street-fashion poster shot in a narrow urban alley, featuring a young woman in a dark navy oversized tracksuit with white double side stripes, sitting crouched on the sidewalk and leaning against a black metal roll-up shutter beside a sticker-covered utility pole. She has dark hair tied in a messy top bun with loose bangs, and wears chunky black, white, and gray sneakers. The pose is relaxed and introspective, with both knees drawn up and the body turned slightly left. Use soft natural late-afternoon sunlight coming from the right, creating warm highlights and long shadows, with a shallow depth of field that blurs the alley background. The overall look is cinematic, slightly grainy, and realistic, like a Japanese youth fashion magazine cover. Place clean white typography in the top left reading: "youth vibes", then smaller text "2025 spring", then two lines of Japanese text: "ゆるくて、かっこよくて、" and "わたしらしい日々。" Add large handwritten white Japanese copy on the upper right in four stacked lines: "お気に入りの", "スウェットで、", "今日も", "自由にいこ。" with a casual hand-drawn underline arrow beneath it. Add bold oversized white sans-serif title text in the lower left: "street" on one line and "note." below it. Beneath that, add smaller white text: "wear your mood." and "live your youth." In the bottom left corner add tiny white text: "vol.07" and "soft groove". Portrait orientation, full-body fashion composition, gritty urban backdrop, premium magazine layout, understated cool-girl energy.

items.title: Retro Fake Anime Movie Poster
items.titleZh: A retro Japanese movie poster for a fictional anime film, designed like an overdramatic 1980s to 1990s theatrical poster with intentionally tacky but charming pulp energy. The scene shows a teenage girl manga artist in a dim wooden Japanese room at night, seated on the floor beside a low desk covered with scattered manuscript pages, pens, ink, books, and drawing tools. She has messy dark shoulder-length hair blown by supernatural force, a cream-beige long-sleeve blouse with loose ruffles, and a dark plaid skirt. Her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur. She stretches one arm upward, holding a glowing {argument name="device type" default="smartphone"} toward a shattered window as a blinding explosion of light and lightning bursts through the glass, illuminating the whole room with gold-white energy. Outside the window is deep blue night with stormlike streaks and electric cracks. The composition is dynamic and diagonal, with the raised arm and device pointing into the central blast. Use painterly anime key art styling, dramatic rim light, textured film-poster shading, rich teal, navy, amber, and crimson colors, and a nostalgic hand-painted cinema-poster feel. Fill the poster with bold Japanese promotional copy in multiple blocks on the left side, including exaggerated red and yellow emphasis marks and three small cartoon reaction faces of a classic manga boy character. Add a vertical Japanese tagline on the right side. Place an enormous stylized Japanese title across the lower middle in red and blue metallic gradient lettering with sharp highlights and heavy shadow, reading {argument name="title text" default="トキヲ描ける少女"}. Include a cream starburst badge near the lower right with more Japanese text and a small manga face. At the lower left, add a large release date block in Japanese with bright yellow numerals and white text, defaulting to {argument name="release date" default="2025年 7月18日(金)"}. Along the bottom edge, add exactly 6 small rectangular film-strip preview stills from the movie. Add small production credits in Japanese and English across the bottom center, including {argument name="studio name" default="Building Fictions"}. Make the whole layout feel like a fake time-travel comedy anime poster set in 1935, loud, nostalgic, cinematic, and slightly cheesy in the best possible way.

She has long, wavy {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"} hair falling over her shoulders, and wears contemporary casual clothing instead of period costume: a fitted long-sleeve {argument name="top color" default="deep burgundy"} shirt, dark blue skinny jeans, and black ankle boots. The throne is massive, jagged, and forged from overlapping weathered swords, filling most of the background. The setting is a dim, moody royal hall with warm firelight, soft glowing candles, faint sparks or embers in the air, and two vertical banners in the distant background bearing a red three-headed dragon-style sigil. items.title: Corporate Cash Private Jet Satire
items.titleZh: A photorealistic satirical airport tarmac scene in daylight, shot vertically, showing a sleek white private jet parked with its door open and stairs visible on the left. On the side of the jet, large clean corporate lettering reads “Google | ANTHROPIC”. In the foreground, 2 adult male executives in dark navy business suits embrace in a celebratory hug, centered slightly left. The man facing camera-left has curly dark hair and wears a charcoal suit; the other man, with short dark hair and a white dress shirt under a navy suit, holds a thick fan of U.S. $100 bills in one hand while hugging. Their expressions should feel triumphant and conspiratorial. In the midground and right side, 2 additional adult men in dark suits push 2 metal airport luggage carts overflowing with tightly bundled stacks of cash. The left cart has a black front panel labeled “Google” in multicolor corporate-style lettering, and the right cart has a black front panel labeled “Deep Pockets Division” in white sans-serif text. Count exactly 2 carts and show both piled high with money bricks wrapped in bank bands. The private jet extends across most of the background, with oval windows, a visible rear engine on the right, and a partly cloudy blue sky above. The ground is wet and reflective, adding glossy reflections under the people and carts. Editorial photojournalism style, ultra-realistic lighting, sharp focus, subtle depth of field, luxury wealth satire, corporate power imagery, high-detail textures on suits, aircraft metal, and cash bundles.

The background should blend futuristic digital imagery and nostalgic school-life drama: faint glowing circuit-board patterns, a stage or concert venue with cyan and magenta glow sticks on the left, and a classroom interior with desks and large sunset windows in the center. Use rich cinematic contrast, luminous rim light, dreamy haze, and a bittersweet, heartfelt atmosphere. Add large ornate Japanese title typography on the left and center reading "AIニケちゃんの 長い長い夢" in gold with soft glow and dark outline. Add a smaller tagline beneath it reading "記憶と心が紡ぐ、たった一つの物語。" Add a square badge in the upper right with gold frame and dark blue background reading "予告 公開中". Add a large release line across the bottom reading "全国の劇場にて 202X年 夏、公開" with elegant gold serif lettering. Include small production-credit text at the very bottom in Japanese, such as "[製作] NIKE Production / [監督] 未来 奏 / [主演] AIニケちゃん". items.title: Pink Office Transfer Announcement Poster
items.titleZh: A glossy, feminine scrapbook-style office announcement poster inspired by a sitcom workplace promo, in a vertical 2:3 composition. The scene shows 1 central woman standing in front of a group of 7 office coworkers inside a warm beige office with venetian blinds, desks, and a visible Dunder Mifflin-style wall sign in the background. The central woman has blonde hair in a messy high bun, a light pink floral V-neck dress, folded arms, and a confident, celebratory pose. Behind her, the 7 coworkers are arranged in a loose semicircle, wearing office attire in muted blues, browns, black, and lavender. Build the image as a mixed-media collage with torn paper, taped notes, brush-lettered headlines, glitter textures, flowers, and pink-and-gold accents. At the top left, place a pink rectangular company card with a white office icon and the text “DUNDER MIFFLIN, INC” and “PAPER COMPANY”. Across the upper center, place a large torn-paper headline reading “TRANSFER CONFIRMED” in expressive brush lettering, with “TRANSFER” in hot pink and “CONFIRMED” in black, plus pink underline strokes and a hand-drawn heart. At the top right, pin a small off-white note card with a pink pushpin and pink tape reading “NEW CHAPTER. NEW SCRANTON.” Near the lower center, layer a bold title made of 4 stacked text strips: “{argument name="character name" default="PENNY"}” on a pink paint-stroke banner, “IS” on a small white strip with 2 tiny hearts, “JOINING” on a gold brush-stroke banner, and “THE OFFICE” on a pale pink strip. On the lower left, hang a tall pink transfer tag clipped with a gold paperclip, reading “FROM DUNDER MIFFLIN, INC PAPER COMPANY / SCRANTON, PA / EST. 1949” and below that “TO THE OFFICE / SCRANTON, PA”, with a pink women-and-desk restroom-style icon at the bottom. On the lower right, place a pink note card with 3 labeled sections: “NEW ROLE” with “{argument name="job title" default="Sales Representative"}”, “NEW TEAM” with “{argument name="team text" default="Same Paper"}”, and “NEW MEMORIES” with “{argument name="memories text" default="Let’s make some!"}”, each accented with small pink hearts. Along the bottom center, add a pink ribbon strip reading “DUNDER MIFFLIN, INC. WELCOMES {argument name="character name" default="PENNY"}♡”. Beneath that, include 3 small icon-and-text items in one row: sparkle icon with “NEW JOB”, group icon with “NEW TEAM”, and heart icon with “NEW MEMORIES”. At the bottom right, add large handwritten pink script saying “LET’S GO!”. items.title: Dark Electro Album Cover
items.titleZh: Square Japanese dark electro pop album cover, cinematic and ethereal, set at night in a rainy empty urban alley with wet reflective pavement and deep blue-black shadows. Center a ghostly elegant woman standing directly in front of a glowing vending machine filled with visible drink cans, the machine casting icy blue-white light around her while small red indicator lights glow on the right side. She has extremely long flowing silver-lavender hair, pale skin, and an enigmatic faceless or obscured-face treatment with the face hidden in shadow or a smooth blurred void. She wears an off-shoulder translucent {argument name="dress style" default="shimmering gray tulle gown"} with delicate sparkle texture, sheer draped sleeves, and ornate crystal jewelry at the neck and chest. Her pose is solemn and prayer-like, one hand raised holding a coin near her lips, the other hand gently clasping her wrist. Add 2 glowing red stigmata-like cross marks, one on the wrist and one on the hand, emitting subtle light. The mood is melancholic, mystical, futuristic, sacred, and slightly gothic. Use a high-contrast palette of cold neon blue, silver, black, and crimson accents, with mist, drizzle, soft bloom, fine film grain, and dramatic backlighting from the vending machine. Integrate ornate vintage border decorations in all 4 corners and a thin frame line around the cover. At the top center, place the artist name {argument name="artist name" default="AYANO YUKIMURA"} in elegant serif capitals with a smaller Japanese line beneath: {argument name="artist name in Japanese" default="アヤノ ユキムラ"}. Along the left side, create a vertical black panel with 3 text areas: the artist name at the top, a long vertical Japanese quote in white in the middle, and at the bottom the stacked genre text {argument name="genre text" default="JAPANESE DARK ELECTRO POP ALBUM"}. Across the bottom center, place the album title {argument name="album title" default="VENDING MACHINE STIGMATA"} in very large luminous cracked silver serif typography spanning 2 lines, with subtle star-like sparkles and ornamental flourishes. Premium fantasy-photoreal key art, ultra-detailed, polished CD jacket design.
items.promptZh: 方形的日本黑暗电子流行专辑封面，电影般的空灵，背景设定在夜晚的雨天空荡荡的城市小巷，潮湿的反光路面和深蓝黑色的阴影。一位幽灵般优雅的女士正站在一台发光的自动售货机前，售货机里装满了可见的饮料罐，机器在她周围投射冰冷的蓝白光，而右侧的小红色指示灯则发光。她有一头飘逸的银色淡紫色长发，苍白的皮肤，神秘的无脸或模糊脸部处理，脸部隐藏在阴影或光滑模糊的虚空中。她身着一件露肩半透明{argument name="dress style" default="shimmering grey tulle dress"}，质地精致，带有透明垂坠袖子，颈部和胸部饰有华丽的水晶珠宝。她的姿势庄严而祈祷，一只手举起，将一枚硬币放在嘴唇附近，另一只手轻轻地扣住手腕。添加2个发光的红色圣痕状十字标记，一个在手腕上，一个在手上，散发出微妙的光芒。情绪是忧郁的、神秘的、未来的、神圣的、略带哥特式的。使用冷霓虹蓝、银色、黑色和深红色调的高对比度调色板，搭配薄雾、细雨、柔和的花朵、精细的胶片颗粒和自动售货机的戏剧性背光。在所有 4 个角上融入华丽的复古边框装饰，并在封面周围采用细框线。在顶部中心，将艺术家姓名 {argument name="artist name" default="AYANO YUKIMURA"} 置于优雅的衬线大写字母中，下方有一条较小的日文线条：{argument name="artist name in Japanese" default="アヤノ ユキムラ"}。沿着左侧创建一个具有 3 个文本区域的垂直黑色面板：顶部是艺术家姓名，中间是白色的长垂直日语引言，底部是堆叠的流派文本 {argument name="genre text" default="JAPANESE DARK ELECTRO POP ALBUM"}。在底部中心，将专辑标题 {argument name="album title" default="VENDING MACHINE STIGMATA"} 放置在跨越 2 行的非常大的发光裂纹银色衬线字体中，带有微妙的星星般的闪光和装饰性的华丽。优质奇幻真实的关键艺术，超详细、抛光的 CD 封面设计。

Center the full-body figure of a tall slim East Asian businesswoman walking confidently down the aisle between desks as if on a runway, shoulders back, arms relaxed, gaze forward. She wears a fitted ribbed knit short-sleeve top in {argument name="top color" default="powder blue"}, tucked into a long high-waisted ribbed mermaid skirt in {argument name="skirt color" default="white"}, with clean white pointed heels. Her hair is dark brown to black, styled in a high ponytail. The office around her is bright, elegant, and contemporary, with rows of desks on both sides, flat computer monitors, ergonomic white-and-gray office chairs, glass meeting room walls, warm wood panels, ceiling strip lights, and several blurred office workers seated and working, plus one suited figure standing in the background. Compose it like a premium fashion magazine cover with the woman dominating the center frame and the office receding in perspective behind her. Add large masthead text across the very top in oversized pale blue serif letters reading {argument name="magazine title" default="OFFICESTYLE"}. Add small white cover line text near the upper left: {argument name="issue text" default="SUMMER 2024"}, and near the upper right: "FASHION & INSPIRATION". On the left side, place a large white serif headline broken over three lines: "Grace in Motion", with 2 smaller Japanese teaser blocks beneath it. On the lower left, add a blue serif subheadline: "Blue & White" with 2 lines of smaller Japanese text below. On the right side, add a white serif headline: "Modern Elegance" with 2 lines of smaller Japanese text below. items.title: Filmmaking Eras Typographic Grid
items.titleZh:
Create a clean 2x2 grid on a pure white studio background featuring 4 large 3D typographic sculptures, each a single character built entirely from filmmaking equipment from a different era. The four glyphs are exactly 4 characters: top-left letter A, top-right number 5, bottom-left letter X, bottom-right number 9. Each character should be front-facing, centered in its quadrant, legible but formed from a dense pile of realistic cinema tools and on-set props, with believable occlusion, weight, and construction logic. Use high-end Cinema 4D product visualization, subtle ambient occlusion, soft three-point studio lighting with a softbox overhead, crisp shadows, realistic materials, and isolated composition.

Top-left: the letter A made from early cinema and silent-era equipment, assembled from vintage wooden tripods, hand-cranked film cameras, brass lenses, reels, megaphones, bell-shaped horns, matte black metal parts, leather straps, and aged wood. Surface qualities should include worn varnished wood, black crackle paint, brass tarnish, scuffed metal, and dusty antique patina. The silhouette should feel chaotic but readable, with tripod legs and old camera bodies defining the A shape.

Top-right: the number 5 made from mid-century analog filmmaking gear, assembled from classic film cameras, magazine reels, metal canisters, brown leather cases, audio accessories, silver fabric packs, director chairs, cylindrical lenses, grips, and vintage production bags. Materials should emphasize brushed aluminum, leather, canvas, rubber, and weathered industrial finishes. The 5 should be chunky and balanced, with stacked props tightly packed into the glyph.

Bottom-left: the letter X made from late 20th century video and broadcast equipment, assembled from shoulder-mount camcorders, portable recorders, battery packs, coiled cables, cassette-like modules, control panels, worn blue and gray plastic housings, and rugged field electronics. Include visible wiring and taped components. Materials should feel utilitarian and slightly battered, with dark plastic, anodized metal, stickers, rubber grips, and yellow accent details. The crossing diagonals of the X must be clear and substantial.

Bottom-right: the number 9 made from contemporary digital cinema and virtual production gear, assembled from modern cinema cameras, compact monitors, LED light panels, drones, gimbals, matte boxes, black modular accessories, and a vivid green chroma screen wrap forming part of the numeral. Include sleek vents, carbon fiber textures, matte black metal, polished glass, and bright green screen fabric as the dominant accent color. The 9 should feel the most modern and refined, with modular precision and clean industrial design.

Keep the background plain and uncluttered, no extra text, no floating objects, no flat typography, no 2D rendering. The sculptures should look like physical objects at realistic scale, highly detailed, photorealistic, and suitable as a graphic design asset.
items.promptZh:
在纯白色工作室背景上创建一个干净的 2x2 网格，其中包含 4 个大型 3D 印刷雕塑，每个雕塑都是完全由不同时代的电影制作设备构建的单个角色。这四个字形恰好是 4 个字符：左上角的字母 A、右上角的数字 5、左下角的字母 X、右下角的数字 9。每个字符都应该朝前，位于其象限的中心，清晰易读，但由密集的现实电影工具和现场道具组成，具有可信的遮挡、重量和构造逻辑。使用高端 Cinema 4D 产品可视化、微妙的环境光遮挡、带有头顶柔光箱的柔和三点工作室照明、清晰的阴影、逼真的材质和独立的构图。

左上：由早期电影和默片时代设备制成的字母 A，由老式木制三脚架、手摇胶片相机、黄铜镜头、卷轴、扩音器、钟形喇叭、哑光黑色金属部件、皮带和陈旧木材组装而成。表面质量应包括磨损的清漆木材、黑色裂纹漆、黄铜失去光泽、磨损的金属和布满灰尘的古董铜锈。剪影应该感觉混乱但可读，三脚架腿和旧相机机身定义了 A 形。

右上：5号由中世纪模拟电影制作设备制成，由经典胶片相机、杂志卷轴、金属罐、棕色皮套、音响配件、银色织物包、导演椅、柱面镜头、手柄和复古制作包组装而成。材料应强调拉丝铝、皮革、帆布、橡胶和风化工业饰面。 5 应该是厚实且平衡的，堆叠的道具紧密地封装在字形中。

左下：由 20 世纪末视频和广播设备制成的字母 X，由肩扛式摄像机、便携式录像机、电池组、卷绕电缆、盒式模块、控制面板、磨损的蓝色和灰色塑料外壳以及坚固耐用的现场电子设备组装而成。包括可见的接线和胶带组件。材料应该感觉实用且略有磨损，包括深色塑料、阳极氧化金属、贴纸、橡胶握把和黄色强调细节。 X 的交叉对角线必须清晰且实质性。

右下：数字 9 由当代数字电影和虚拟制作设备制成，由现代电影摄影机、紧凑型监视器、LED 灯板、无人机、万向节、遮光盒、黑色模块化配件以及构成数字一部分的生动绿色色度屏幕包裹组装而成。包括时尚的通风口、碳纤维纹理、哑光黑色金属、抛光玻璃和亮绿色屏幕织物作为主要强调色。 9应该是最现代、最精致的，具有模块化精度和简洁的工业设计。

保持背景简洁、无多余文本、无浮动对象、无平面排版、无 2D 渲染。雕塑应该看起来像真实比例的物理物体，高度详细，逼真，并且适合作为图形设计资产。

items.title: Filmmaking Eras Typographic Grid
items.titleZh: Create a clean 2x2 grid of four front-facing 3D typographic sculptures on a light gray seamless studio background, separated by thin white dividers. Each quadrant features a single giant letter built entirely from dense, realistic filmmaking equipment and on-set props from a different cinematic era, with the letterform chaotic but clearly legible. Use high-end Cinema 4D product-render aesthetics, ambient occlusion, realistic scale relationships, intricate kit-bashing, subtle wear, metallic reflections, and three-point studio lighting with a soft overhead source. Top-left: the letter S, representing early silent-era or proto-cinema filmmaking, constructed from antique brass-and-wood cameras, exposed gears, film reels, projector parts, bellows, tripod wood legs, and vintage optical housings; warm bronze and copper tones; include 3 extra props at the base: a black megaphone labeled "DIRECTOR", a clapboard, and a short stack of film canisters; one projector-like lens at the upper right glows brightly. Top-right: the letter C, representing classical Hollywood film production, built from black metal film cameras, studio lenses, magazines, matte boxes, dolly components, control boxes, and analog set hardware; mostly black, steel, and gunmetal with subtle brass accents; include 4 extra props integrated around the base and inner right side: a clapperboard, a boxy side module, a film magazine marked "35", and a small cylindrical canister; a large forward-facing lamp or lens glows at the upper right. Bottom-left: the letter N, representing modern analog or late-20th-century cinema, assembled from Arriflex-style cameras, long cine zoom lenses, support rigs, rails, cables, a slate, and a field recorder; predominantly matte black with silver hardware and a few red accent rings; include 3 clearly visible base elements: a clapperboard section, a labeled director strip, and a rectangular audio recorder/control unit at the bottom. Bottom-right: the letter D, representing digital and virtual production, built from RED-style digital cinema cameras, monitors, battery packs, wireless transmitters, drones, LED panels, green-screen fabric inserts, and modular rig components; black technical bodies with vivid green accents and screen graphics; include 4 notable integrated device types: drone arms/propellers at the top, a rectangular LED light panel, multiple monitors, and a large camera lens at the lower left. Keep all objects grounded and physically connected, no floating pieces, no flat typography, no handwriting, no paper look, no messy background. Ultra-detailed, sharp, 8k, polished graphic design asset for a poster or visual comparison of filmmaking eras.
items.promptZh: 在浅灰色无缝工作室背景上创建一个由四个正面 3D 印刷雕塑组成的干净 2x2 网格，并由白色细隔板隔开。每个象限都有一个巨大的字母，完全由来自不同电影时代的密集、逼真的电影制作设备和现场道具制成，字母形式混乱但清晰易读。使用高端 Cinema 4D 产品渲染美学、环境光遮蔽、真实比例关系、复杂的套件攻击、细微磨损、金属反射以及带有柔和头顶光源的三点工作室照明。左上：字母S，代表早期默片时代或原始电影电影制作，由古董黄铜和木头相机、外露齿轮、胶片卷轴、投影仪部件、波纹管、三脚架木腿和老式光学外壳构成；温暖的青铜色和古铜色；底座上包括 3 个额外道具：一个标有“导演”的黑色扩音器、一块隔板和一小叠胶片罐；右上角的一个类似投影仪的镜头发出明亮的光。右上：字母C，代表经典的好莱坞电影制作，由黑色金属胶片摄影机、演播室镜头、杂志、遮光盒、摄影车组件、控制盒和模拟布景硬件制成；大部分为黑色、钢色和炮铜色，带有微妙的黄铜装饰；包括 4 个额外的道具，集成在底座和右侧内部：一个场记板、一个四四方方的侧面模块、一个标有“35”的电影杂志和一个小圆柱形罐；一个大的前向灯或透镜在右上角发光。左下：字母 N，代表现代模拟或 20 世纪末电影，由 Arriflex 式摄像机、长电影变焦镜头、支撑装置、导轨、电缆、石板和现场录音机组装而成；以哑光黑色为主，搭配银色硬件和一些红色装饰环；包括 3 个清晰可见的基本元素：场记板部分、带标签的导演条和底部的矩形录音机/控制单元。右下：字母 D，代表数字和虚拟制作，由 RED 风格的数字电影摄影机、监视器、电池组、无线发射器、无人机、LED 面板、绿幕织物插入物和模块化装备组件构建而成；黑色技术机身，带有生动的绿色点缀和屏幕图形；包括 4 种值得注意的集成设备类型：顶部的无人机臂/螺旋桨、矩形 LED 灯板、多个监视器和左下角的大型相机镜头。保持所有对象接地并物理连接，没有浮动碎片，没有平面排版，没有手写，没有纸张外观，没有凌乱的背景。超详细、锐利、8k、精美的图形设计资源，用于海报或电影制作时代的视觉比较。

items.title: Vintage Little Prince Space Postcard
items.titleZh: Create a vintage illustrated postcard designed as a whimsical collaboration between {argument name="franchise name" default="The Little Prince"} and {argument name="space company name" default="SPACEX"}, shown as the front and back of the postcard side by side on one canvas. Use warm aged paper with slightly worn edges, subtle grain, faint stains, and a nostalgic mid-century print feel. The left half is the postcard image: a deep midnight blue starry sky with small golden stars and a tiny ringed planet, a large white rocket standing upright on a launch pad with bright exhaust at liftoff, and a small blond child in a green outfit with a long golden scarf sitting on a rocky hill beside an orange fox, both seen from behind and looking toward the rocket. Add elegant hand-lettered quote text in the sky that reads {argument name="quote" default="To the stars, what matters is invisible."}, with smaller serif and script attribution beneath: "ANTOINE DE SAINT-EXUPÉRY" and "The Little Prince". Along the bottom of the left panel, include 2 brand names: "The Little Prince" in blue script on the left and "SPACEX" in bold blue futuristic capitals on the right, separated by a small gold star and a thin divider line. Beneath that, add the slogan in spaced small caps: {argument name="tagline" default="EXPLORING WORLDS. CARING FOR WHAT MATTERS."}. The right half is the postcard back on the same aged paper, with a centered heading "POST CARD" near the top and a small gold star ornament below it. Add a circular postmark near the upper center-right with 4 visible text parts arranged inside the stamp: "PLANET EARTH", "MAY 23", "2024", and "BEYOND". In the top-right corner, place a blue postage stamp with perforated edges showing the Little Prince standing on a tiny planet under stars, with 4 readable text elements: "1943", "Le Petit Prince", "SPACE", and a small star symbol. The right side should have 2 writing columns divided by a vertical line. In the left writing area, place a handwritten-style message beginning with "Dear friend," followed by this text in neat cursive line breaks: "One day, we'll leave Earth not to escape it, but to understand it better. The universe is vast, but kindness is our compass. Let's take care of our home, as we reach for the stars." Then sign it on 3 lines: "The Little Prince", "and", "SPACEX". In the right address area, write "To you," on the first line, then "Somewhere wonderful" and "In the Universe" on the next lines with horizontal guide lines. Add small gold star doodles and, at the bottom-right corner, a simple line drawing of a tiny round planet with little flowers sprouting from it. Keep the palette limited to cream, navy, soft gold, muted green, warm orange, and blue-gray, with crisp but painterly illustration, accurate decorative typography, and a magical, hopeful, literary-meets-space-exploration tone.
items.promptZh: 创建一张复古插图明信片，设计为 {argument name="franchise name" default="The Little Prince"} 和 {argument name="space company name" default="SPACEX"} 之间异想天开的合作，将明信片的正面和背面并排显示在一张画布上。使用边缘稍有磨损、有细微纹理、淡淡污渍和怀旧中世纪印刷感觉的温暖老化纸张。左半部分是明信片的图像：深蓝色的星空，点缀着金色的小星星和一颗小小的环形行星，一枚巨大的白色火箭直立在发射台上，升空时排出明亮的废气，一个穿着绿色衣服、戴着长长的金色围巾的金发小孩子坐在岩石山上，旁边是一只橙色的狐狸，两人都是从后面看向火箭。在天空中添加优雅的手写引文文本，内容为 {argument name="quote" default="To the Stars, What important is无形。"}，下方带有较小的衬线和脚本归属：“ANTOINE DE SAINT-EXUPÉRY”和“The Little Prince”。沿着左侧面板的底部，包括 2 个品牌名称：左侧为蓝色字体的“The Little Prince”，右侧为粗体蓝色未来派大写字母“SPACEX”，由一颗小金色星星和一条细分隔线分隔开。在其下方，添加间隔小写大写的口号：{argument name="tagline" default="EXPLORING WORLDS. CARING FOR WHAT MATTERS."}。右半部分是明信片背面，采用同样旧的纸张，顶部附近居中标题“明信片”，下方有一个小金星装饰。在右上角附近添加圆形邮戳，邮票内排列有 4 个可见文本部分：“PLANET EARTH”、“MAY 23”、“2024”和“BEYOND”。在右上角放置一张带有穿孔边缘的蓝色邮票，展示小王子站在星空下的一颗小行星上，并附有 4 个可读文本元素：“1943”、“小王子”、“太空”和一个小星星符号。右侧应有 2 个由垂直线分隔的书写栏。在左侧的书写区域中，放置一条手写风格的信息，以“亲爱的朋友”开头，然后是用整齐的草书换行符写成的文字：“有一天，我们离开地球不是为了逃避它，而是为了更好地理解它。宇宙浩瀚，但善良是我们的指南针。让我们在到达星星的同时照顾好我们的家园。”然后在上面签名 3 行：“小王子”、“和”、“太空”。在右侧地址区域，在第一行写“致你”，然后在接下来的几行用水平引导线写“美妙的地方”和“在宇宙中”。添加小金色星星涂鸦，并在右下角添加一个简单的线条画，画出一个微小的圆形行星，上面长满了小花。将调色板限制在奶油色、海军蓝、柔和的金色、柔和的绿色、温暖的橙色和蓝灰色，搭配清晰但绘画性的插图、准确的装饰版式，以及神奇、充满希望、文学与空间探索的基调。

Use warm aged paper with slightly worn edges, subtle grain, faint stains, and a nostalgic mid-century print feel. The left half is the postcard image: a deep midnight blue starry sky with small golden stars and a tiny ringed planet, a large white rocket standing upright on a launch pad with bright exhaust at liftoff, and a small blond child in a green outfit with a long golden scarf sitting on a rocky hill beside an orange fox, both seen from behind and looking toward the rocket. Add elegant hand-lettered quote text in the sky that reads {argument name="quote" default="To the stars, what matters is invisible."}, with smaller serif and script attribution beneath: "ANTOINE DE SAINT-EXUPÉRY" and "The Little Prince". Along the bottom of the left panel, include 2 brand names: "The Little Prince" in blue script on the left and "SPACEX" in bold blue futuristic capitals on the right, separated by a small gold star and a thin divider line. Beneath that, add the slogan in spaced small caps: {argument name="tagline" default="EXPLORING WORLDS. CARING FOR WHAT MATTERS."}. The right half is the postcard back on the same aged paper, with a centered heading "POST CARD" near the top and a small gold star ornament below it. Add a circular postmark near the upper center-right with 4 visible text parts arranged inside the stamp: "PLANET EARTH", "MAY 23", "2024", and "BEYOND". In the top-right corner, place a blue postage stamp with perforated edges showing the Little Prince standing on a tiny planet under stars, with 4 readable text elements: "1943", "Le Petit Prince", "SPACE", and a small star symbol. The right side should have 2 writing columns divided by a vertical line. In the left writing area, place a handwritten-style message beginning with "Dear friend," followed by this text in neat cursive line breaks: "One day, we'll leave Earth not to escape it, but to understand it better. The universe is vast, but kindness is our compass. Let's take care of our home, as we reach for the stars." Then sign it on 3 lines: "The Little Prince", "and", "SPACEX". In the right address area, write "To you," on the first line, then "Somewhere wonderful" and "In the Universe" on the next lines with horizontal guide lines. Add small gold star doodles and, at the bottom-right corner, a simple line drawing of a tiny round planet with little flowers sprouting from it. Keep the palette limited to cream, navy, soft gold, muted green, warm orange, and blue-gray, with crisp but painterly illustration, accurate decorative typography, and a magical, hopeful, literary-meets-space-exploration tone.

items.title: Japanese Fashion Cover with Koinobori Dresses
items.titleZh: A fashion magazine cover styled like a luxurious Japanese women's magazine, photographed in soft natural daylight against a pale blue sky with a faint city skyline blurred in the background. The masthead is huge and elegant across the top, reading {argument name="magazine title" default="Lumiére"} in oversized soft pink serif lettering, with small Japanese cover text above and around it, plus a small issue marker on the upper right reading "5", "May 2026", and "No.218". Center the cover on exactly 2 young adult Japanese women standing close together from about thigh-up, facing camera in a poised editorial pose, with their faces intentionally obscured by smooth soft rectangular blur blocks. The woman on the left wears a flowing pale blue dress inspired by koinobori carp streamers: high Mandarin-style collar, sleeveless inner dress, long sheer cape panels draping from the shoulders, elaborate layered metallic and satin fish-scale appliqué across the bodice, a large stylized fish eye motif on the chest, more scale detailing and fin-shaped ornamentation at the hip, and a cinched waist with decorative jeweled clasp. Her dark hair is in an elegant updo with loose wisps, and she wears dangling earrings. The woman on the right wears the same design concept in pale pink and white, also with a high collar, translucent cape-like side panels, layered fish-scale bodice, a visible fish eye motif near the waist sash, soft pleated skirt, tassel ornament at the belt, and matching dangling earrings; her dark hair is also swept into a refined updo with a few loose strands. The overall styling is airy, graceful, feminine, and sophisticated, mixing traditional Japanese elegance with modern couture. Use a pastel palette dominated by baby blue, blush pink, white, and subtle gold trim, with bright but diffused lighting and a premium glossy magazine editorial finish. Include visible Japanese cover lines arranged like a real magazine layout: one left-side block introducing the cover girls, one large main headline block across the lower half, one right-side vertical cluster of smaller teaser text, and exactly 2 pale blue circular callout badges on the right side containing Japanese text; the upper badge advertises a special appendix gift set and includes exactly 2 small product images of pouch-like accessories, and the lower badge contains a shopping-plan checklist with exactly 3 checkbox lines. Add a small pink ribbon-like label above the main headline. The composition should feel clean, aspirational, and seasonally themed around Golden Week and koinobori fashion.
items.promptZh: 时尚杂志封面的风格就像一本豪华的日本女性杂志，在柔和的自然光下拍摄，背景是淡蓝色的天空，背景是模糊的城市天际线。报头巨大而优雅，顶部用超大的柔和粉色衬线字体写着{argument name="magazine title" default="Lumiére"}，上方和周围有小日文封面文字，右上角还有一个小问题标记，写着“5”、“2026 年 5 月”和“No.218”。封面的中心恰好是两名年轻的日本成年女性，她们大腿以上并排站着，以一种泰然自若的编辑姿势面对镜头，她们的脸被光滑的软矩形模糊块故意遮挡。左边的女士穿着一件飘逸的淡蓝色连衣裙，其灵感源自鲤鱼旗：高领、无袖内裙、长长的透明斗篷镶片从肩部垂下，上身饰有精致的分层金属和缎面鱼鳞贴花，胸前有大型风格化鱼眼图案，臀部有更多鳞片细节和鳍形装饰，腰部饰有装饰性宝石扣。她的黑发盘成优雅的髻，一缕缕松散，戴着垂坠的耳环。右边的女士穿着同样的设计理念，浅粉色和白色，同样是高领、半透明斗篷式侧幅、分层的鱼鳞衣身、腰间可见的鱼眼图案、柔软的百褶裙、腰带上的流苏装饰和配套的垂坠耳环；她的深色头发也被梳成了精致的髻，有几缕松散的发丝。整体风格轻盈、优雅、女性化、精致，将传统日本优雅与现代时装融为一体。使用以淡蓝色、腮红、白色和微妙的金色装饰为主的柔和色调，搭配明亮但漫射的灯光和优质光泽的杂志编辑效果。包括像真实杂志布局一样排列的可见日文封面线：一个介绍封面女郎的左侧块，一个横跨下半部分的大标题块，一个较小的预告文本的右侧垂直簇，以及右侧包含日语文本的 2 个淡蓝色圆形标注徽章；上面的徽章宣传的是一种特殊的附录礼品套装，并且正好包含 2 个袋状配件的小产品图像，下面的徽章包含一个购物计划清单，其中正好有 3 个复选框行。在主标题上方添加一个类似粉红色丝带的小标签。构图应该感觉干净、令人向往，并且以黄金周和鲤鱼旗时尚为主题。

items.title: Shiba Inu Space Dream Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic Japanese motivational movie-poster style illustration set at dusk, mixing corporate burnout and hopeful space-dream fantasy. In the center foreground, an anthropomorphic Shiba Inu with warm tan fur smiles confidently at the viewer, wearing a sharp navy business suit, white dress shirt, and blue striped tie. The dog holds a black e-reader in the left paw with the screen text “kindle” and a black-and-gold fountain pen in the right paw. Behind the character, the background is split into two thematic halves that blend together: on the left, a dense Tokyo-like city skyline at sunset with Tokyo Tower glowing orange, dark office buildings, and exhausted salary workers at desks under a stressful atmosphere; on the right, a deep starry cosmos with blue nebulae, a rocket launching upward, 3 airplanes, a winding glowing golden trajectory line, 1 small planet, 2 floating paw prints, 2 packaged breads labeled “カンパン,” and 1 round biscuit labeled “南部せんべい.” Near the right lower background, show a family of 4 from behind walking toward the bright horizon with a dog, symbolizing hope and future dreams. Add 3 black signboards floating in the left midground with the Japanese words “残業,” “プレッシャー,” and “会議 満員電車.” In the foreground on a wooden desk, place exactly 3 prominently displayed books standing upright: book 1 on the left is white and blue with the title “忙しい社会人のやり直し英語勉強法” and a small illustrated author portrait; book 2 in the center is dark blue and gold with the large title “『あたりまえ』を続けることは 最強の生存戦略である”; book 3 on the right is white and blue with the title “『すぐやる』は最速の仕事術” and a large “5” plus a circular “5 MIN” icon. Also on the desk, include 1 black coffee mug with the text “未来は 5分で変わる,” 1 spiral notebook opened flat with a handwritten to-do list in Japanese reading “今日やること ① ブログを書く（5分） ② 家族と過ごす（大切） ③ 未来を信じる（ワクワク）” plus a paw-print doodle, 1 black fountain pen lying beside it, 1 globe on a stand at the far right, 1 plate of crackers, 1 extra packaged “カンパン,” and small framed photos at the lower left edge. At the top, large luxurious gold Japanese headline text reads “{argument name="headline text" default="5分で宇宙へ！"}” with a smaller gold subtitle beneath: “〜たかお柴犬のサイドFIRE物語〜”. Below that, centered white copy reads “忙しい毎日に、たった5分。 犬だけど、夢は本気で掴んだ。” At the bottom center, add a cinematic English tagline: “Based on a true story of たかお柴犬” and beneath it “A heartwarming comedy-drama about taking small steps to big dreams”. Use ultra-detailed glossy poster rendering, warm orange sunset versus cool blue space contrast, inspirational commercial key art, sharp typography, rich cinematic lighting, whimsical but sincere tone, highly polished social-media poster composition, vertical format.

items.title: Luxury Lavender Skincare Ad
items.titleZh:
Luxury feminine skincare advertisement, vertical 9:16 composition, ultra-realistic studio beauty product shot with dreamy soft focus and warm golden morning sunlight. Center a single elegant pump bottle serum in the foreground on a fluffy lavender-purple faux fur surface. The bottle is translucent pastel lavender glass with a shiny metallic gold pump and collar, premium glossy reflections, soft shadows, and subtle sparkle in the liquid. The front label reads {argument name="brand name" default="LUMIÈRE"} in gold serif lettering, with smaller text below reading {argument name="product name" default="RADIANCE ELIXIR"}, then “NOURISH • HYDRATE • GLOW” and “FOR SOFT, SMOOTH & GLOWING SKIN,” plus tiny size text at the bottom. Surround the bottle with a luxurious vanity setup: an ornate vintage mirror in the background, 1 ribbed glass candle jar with a lit flame on the lower left, 1 faceted glass perfume bottle with a gold neck on the right, strings of cream pearls draped across the surface, and airy white baby’s breath flowers framing both sides and the lower right foreground. Use a soft beige and blush background with creamy bokeh and a cozy high-end beauty branding mood.

Add cute white and purple hand-drawn doodle elements: exactly 3 heart doodles, 2 sparkle/star doodles, 1 small zigzag doodle, 1 curved arrow pointing toward the bottle, and 2 short accent line clusters above the headline. Add exactly 4 handwritten paper-note stickers with torn edges and taped scrapbook styling: left note says “Self care ♡ Everyday”, upper-right note says “For Soft, Smooth & Glowing Skin.♡”, lower-right note says “Radiant Confident You ♡”, and a purple heart-shaped sticker near the candle says “Glow is my favorite color ♡”. Place large hand-lettered headline text across the upper half reading {argument name="headline text" default="Glowy Skin In A Bottle"} in white brush-script with a soft lavender outline or glow. Beneath it, place a horizontal lavender paint-stroke banner with the subheading {argument name="tagline text" default="Nourish • Hydrate • Glow"} in white handwritten lettering. Clean composition, premium soft feminine branding, Instagram/TikTok-friendly viral beauty ad style, polished editorial product photography, pastel purple and gold color palette, cozy glamorous atmosphere.
items.promptZh:
奢华女性护肤广告，垂直9:16构图，超现实工作室美容产品拍摄，梦幻柔焦和温暖的金色早晨阳光。将一个优雅的泵瓶精华液放在蓬松的薰衣草紫色人造毛皮表面的前景中央。瓶子采用半透明淡紫色玻璃制成，带有闪亮的金属金色泵和瓶口，具有优质的光泽反射、柔和的阴影和液体中微妙的闪光。正面标签上的金色衬线字体为{argument name="brand name" default="LUMIÈRE"}，下方较小的文字为{argument name="product name" default="RADIANCE ELIXIR"}，然后是“NOURISH • HYDRATE • GLOW”和“FOR SOFT, SMOOTH & GLOWING SKIN”，底部还有小字号文字。瓶子周围装饰着奢华的梳妆台：背景是一面华丽的复古镜子，左下角有 1 个带点燃火焰的棱纹玻璃蜡烛罐，右侧有 1 个带有金色瓶颈的刻面玻璃香水瓶，表面垂挂着一串奶油珍珠，两侧和右下前景是轻盈的白色满天星花。使用柔和的米色和腮红背景，搭配奶油色散景和舒适的高端美容品牌氛围。

添加可爱的白色和紫色手绘涂鸦元素：正好 3 个心形涂鸦、2 个闪光/星星涂鸦、1 个小锯齿形涂鸦、1 个指向瓶子的弯曲箭头以及标题上方的 2 个短强调线簇。添加正好 4 个边缘撕破的手写纸条贴纸，并粘贴剪贴簿样式：左边的贴纸写着“自我护理 ♡ 日常”，右上角的贴纸写着“柔软、光滑和发光的皮肤。♡”，右下的贴纸写着“辐射自信的你 ♡”，蜡烛附近的紫心形贴纸写着“发光是我最喜欢的颜色 ♡”。在上半部分放置大号手写标题文本，阅读{argument name="headline text" default="Glowy Skin In A Bottle"}，采用白色画笔脚本，带有柔和的淡紫色轮廓或发光效果。在其下方放置一个水平的淡紫色画笔横幅，其副标题为白色手写字体{argument name="tagline text" default="Nourish • Hydrate • Glow"}。简洁的构图、优质的柔和女性品牌、Instagram/TikTok 友好的病毒式美容广告风格、精美的编辑产品摄影、柔和的紫色和金色调色板、舒适迷人的氛围。

items.title: Dreamy Anime Sayori Banner
items.titleZh: A wide anime banner illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Sayori"} in a bright dreamy classroom, rendered in a polished, high-end visual novel style with soft painterly lighting, warm pastel colors, and sparkling atmosphere. Show a cheerful teenage schoolgirl with short fluffy coral-pink hair, messy bob layers, and a large red bow on the right side of her head, wearing a Japanese school uniform with a light brown blazer, white shirt, red ribbon tie, brown sweater vest, and pleated navy skirt. She stands slightly left of center with arms open wide in an inviting, joyful pose, as if welcoming the viewer, with dynamic perspective and gentle motion in her hair and clothes. Her face is intentionally obscured by a flat rectangular skin-tone censor block. Behind her, tall classroom windows reveal a vivid blue sky with soft white clouds and warm sunlight streaming in. The right half of the image features a large decorative handwritten script reading {argument name="headline text" default="Sayori"}, cream-white lettering with a soft orange-gold outline and glow, integrated into a scrapbook-like wall background. Surround the scene with hanging photo prints clipped to string, including sky photos and a sunflower photo, plus hand-drawn doodles of clouds, stars, hearts, and a sun. Add blue and yellow paper stars, ribbons, floating confetti, a blue paper airplane, notebook pages, a spiral sketchbook, and scattered stationery elements. Keep the curry recognizable as the same dish, but restyle it as a premium food photograph served in a rustic ceramic bowl on a wooden tabletop, with richer gloss, deeper color contrast, and more appetizing texture. Create a full editorial layout with 3 main content areas: 1) a large hero section at the top featuring the plated curry on the right and Japanese promotional copy on the left, including a small top banner label and a large headline; 2) a bottom-left chef profile area with 1 portrait of a chef in dark workwear and apron, arms crossed in a restaurant kitchen, plus vertical Japanese copy and a handwritten-style name caption; 3) a bottom-right information area containing 1 quote block and 1 framed “secret of deliciousness” panel with exactly 3 numbered steps, each paired with a food or cooking image. Add warm ambient lighting, shallow depth of field, spices and garlic props around the hero dish, and an upscale traditional restaurant branding feel. Include Japanese text throughout, with the main headline emphasizing slow-cooked, exquisite curry, and use elegant Mincho-style typography in brown, cream, and gold tones. The final composition should look like a high-end restaurant feature article or promotional brochure page.

items.title: Gritty Evangelion Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic vintage anime poster in the style of a gritty sci-fi mecha key visual, featuring three teenage pilots standing back-to-back in the foreground and a towering purple biomechanical robot looming directly behind them. The center pilot is a slim teenage boy in a dark navy and black plug suit with white shoulder panels and a glowing red circular core on the chest, standing front-facing with a serious expression. On the left is a pale teenage girl with short icy blue bob-cut hair and a white futuristic bodysuit, turned slightly away in profile. On the right is a teenage girl with long auburn hair flowing to the side, wearing a vivid red plug suit, looking outward with determination. Behind all three, the giant mecha head dominates the composition, centered and symmetrical, with a single horn, glowing orange eyes, angular armor, and massive shoulder structures rising like black wings. The background is outer space with 2 visible celestial bodies: 1 huge cratered moon directly behind the mecha’s head and 1 smaller planet at the right side. The bottom of the poster shows a ruined futuristic cityscape with broken buildings, rubble, sparks, and debris. At the very bottom center, include 2 tiny human silhouettes running forward through destruction, framed by pink energy streaks arcing left and right. Use a dark indigo, black, purple, rust red, and ash gray palette with heavy film grain, distressed ink texture, weathered paper wear, paint splatter, scratched print damage, and a rough screen-printed poster finish. Compose it as a full theatrical one-sheet with dense typography integrated into the edges: large vertical English title text on the left reading "NEON GENESIS EVANGELION", smaller vertical red text beside it reading "HIRANO OF EVANGELION", a red NERV insignia and the word "NERV" near the lower left, a boxed label at bottom left reading "TOKYO-3" and "JAPAN", a red warning box at the upper right reading "ANGEL ATTACK" with Japanese characters beneath, and multiple vertical Japanese taglines along the left and right borders. Cinematic, moody, apocalyptic, highly detailed, iconic 1990s anime poster design with premium modern illustration quality.
items.promptZh: 一张戏剧性的复古动漫海报，采用坚韧的科幻机甲主视觉风格，三名青少年飞行员背靠背站在前景中，一个高耸的紫色生物力学机器人隐约出现在他们身后。中间的飞行员是一名身材苗条的十几岁男孩，身穿深海军蓝和黑色插头套装，肩部镶有白色，胸前有一个发光的红色圆形核心，面朝前方站立，表情严肃。左边是一个面色苍白的少女，留着冰蓝色的鲍勃短发，穿着白色的未来派紧身衣，侧面稍微转过身。右边是一名赤褐色长发披散在侧的少女，穿着鲜艳的红色塞子套装，目光坚定地看着外面。在这三个人的身后，巨大的机甲头部占据了构图的主导地位，居中且对称，有一个角，发光的橙色眼睛，棱角分明的装甲，以及像黑色翅膀一样升起的巨大肩部结构。背景是外太空，有 2 个可见的天体：机甲头部正后方有 1 个巨大的陨石坑月亮，右侧有 1 个较小的行星。海报的底部展示了一个被毁坏的未来城市景观，其中有破碎的建筑物、瓦砾、火花和碎片。在最底部的中心，有两个微小的人类轮廓在毁灭中向前奔跑，周围是左右弧形的粉红色能量条纹。使用深靛蓝、黑色、紫色、铁锈红和灰灰色调色板，具有厚重的胶片颗粒、仿旧的墨水纹理、风化的纸张磨损、油漆飞溅、划痕的印刷损坏和粗糙的丝网印刷海报表面。将其组成完整的戏剧单页，边缘集成密集的排版：左侧较大的垂直英文标题文字为“NEON GENESIS EVANGELION”，旁边较小的垂直红色文字为“HIRANO OF EVANGELION”，红色 NERV 徽章和左下角附近的“NERV”一词，左下角的盒装标签为“TOKYO-3”和“JAPAN”，右上角的红色警告框为“ANGEL”攻击”下方有日语字符，左右边框上有多个垂直的日语标语。电影般的、喜怒无常的、世界末日般的、高度详细的、标志性的 20 世纪 90 年代动漫海报设计，具有优质的现代插图质量。

items.title: Dark Chinese Crime Drama Poster
items.titleZh: A dark, gritty Chinese crime-thriller movie poster in a vertical one-sheet layout, with a moody neo-noir aesthetic and heavy cinematic contrast. The composition centers on a half-length portrait of a menacing middle-aged East Asian man with wavy black hair, wearing a dark textured overcoat over a black shirt, his face mostly swallowed by shadow, shown from chest up and slightly off-center to the right. His hands are visible in the lower-right area, calmly holding a string of dark wooden prayer beads, suggesting power, danger, and ritual. The background is a dim urban alley or old city street at night, layered with grunge textures, wet pavement reflections, decayed walls, and faint architectural silhouettes. In the lower center, place 1 small back-facing seated figure in a chair under a harsh spotlight, surrounded by 9 standing human silhouettes in the darkness, creating a tense interrogation or underworld confrontation scene. Use an almost monochrome palette of black, charcoal, and dirty gray, with deep blood-red accents and distressed white typography. On the left side, add 1 huge vertical column of expressive red Chinese brush-calligraphy title text, painted with rough splashes and dry-brush texture, dominating nearly the full height of the poster. Along the far left edge, add 2 vertical lines of smaller Chinese text in white and red: "我叫高启强，" and "风浪越大，鱼越贵". On the right side, add 1 vertical cast credit line in white Chinese text with a red circular separator: "张颂文 饰 高启强". In the lower-right quadrant, add 1 bold white brushstroke Chinese subtitle/title mark reading "狂飙", with the small English subtitle "THE KNOCKOUT" in red serif capitals beneath it. Add tiny faint Chinese release or tagline text along the bottom edge. The overall feeling should be oppressive, violent, prestigious, and highly designed, like a premium streaming-platform crime drama key art poster, with layered depth, dramatic shadows, textured smoke and grime, and realistic photographic detail.

items.title: Dark Fantasy Orc Warchief TCG Card
items.titleZh: Create a single high-detail fantasy trading card in a dark Warhammer-inspired style, full portrait orientation, with an ornate aged metal-and-red leather frame, distressed gold trim, and readable printed card text. The card title at the top reads {argument name="character name" default="GROKTHAR"} in large serif capitals, with the subtitle "Orc Warchief" centered below it. The main artwork shows a massive green-skinned orc war chief charging forward through a fiery battlefield, wearing brutal blackened spiked armor with skull motifs, leather straps, tusks, and blood-red war paint, one arm thrust forward as if commanding the attack and the other gripping a huge jagged battle axe. His physique is extremely muscular, with a savage snarling expression, long dark hair tied back, and a war-torn red-black color palette. The background is filled with smoke, embers, banners, silhouettes of warriors, and orange firelight. In the top left corner place a circular skull faction emblem. In the top right corner place a red vertical banner tab with a black tribal insignia. Along the left edge, stack exactly 4 circular stat icons in separate panels with values: sword attack 4, shield defense 3, heart health 5, boot movement 2. At the bottom, include a large parchment-colored text box with exactly 2 named abilities and 1 flavor quote. Ability 1 title: {argument name="ability one" default="BRUTAL STRIKE"}, with body text: "When Grokthar attacks, he deals +2 damage." Ability 2 title: {argument name="ability two" default="RALLY THE HORDE"}, with body text: "Once per turn, when another friendly Orc enters the battlefield, Grokthar gains +1 attack until end of turn." Beneath them, add the italic flavor quote: {argument name="flavor quote" default="Strength is law. Blood is proof. The weak serve. The strong rule."} In the bottom left corner place a red gem-like cost badge with the number 5. In the bottom right corner place a round crossed-weapons icon. items.title: Pixar-Style AI Web Design Sprint Poster
items.titleZh: A stylized cinematic poster for a creative coding event, designed like a Disney-Pixar-inspired animated movie one-sheet. Vertical composition, warm cozy interior at night with a large loft window on the left showing a city skyline at sunset, exposed brick walls, and a neon-lit creative studio atmosphere. At the top center, big glossy dimensional typography reads "Disney•PIXAR" above the main title "The AI Web Design Sprint" in huge bold white 3D letters. Directly underneath, smaller bright text reads "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD." In the center foreground, 2 adult men sit side by side at a wooden table with a laptop between them, casual startup-founder vibe, one in a dark hoodie and one in a light sweatshirt and baseball cap, both facing camera in a friendly promotional pose. Their faces should be generic and unobtrusive, with the emphasis on the event-poster composition rather than portrait realism. The laptop lid has 3 visible stickers: a purple code-brackets sticker, a black sticker with a white burst symbol, and a rectangular slogan sticker reading "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD." Around the scene, include 4 whimsical animated mascot elements: a small hovering robot drone lamp in the upper left with glowing blue eyes and a cone of warm light shining downward; a smiling cartoon sun icon in the upper right; a tiny red pixel character floating nearby; and a glowing blue cat-like digital mascot standing on the table in front of the laptop. On the right side, a vertical monitor displays a dark coding interface with readable text including "// Welcome back, Julian!", "Opus 4.6", "Minimal Playground", "Agency 976", "Cyberpunk Cafe", "Surfers (late set)", and a checklist titled "Sprint Plan" with 4 items: "DISCOVER", "IDEATE", "BUILD", "SHIP". On the left side, a hand-lettered paper signboard contains 4 notices pinned together: "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE", "DOORS 7PM", "SHOW 8PM", and "$10 ADV / $12 DOS". In the lower left foreground, a white coffee mug reads "THE SOUTH SIDE DIY 218 W. 31ST ST. CHICAGO, IL" with a small skull icon. In the lower right foreground, a terracotta plant pot with green leaves reads "CREATIVE COLLISION". At the bottom center, large bold text reads "APRIL 27–30" and below it "LIVE. ONLY ON THE WEB." Add a tiny line of faux credits along the bottom edge in classic movie-poster style, referencing names like Julian Lopez and Harvey Specter, projects such as Minimal Playground, Agency 976, Cyberpunk Cafe, and Surfers, and a playful production credit. Use dramatic warm-orange and cool-blue lighting, polished animated-film rendering, soft depth of field, glossy surfaces, rich contrast, highly detailed poster design, charming tech startup energy, and a premium event-advertisement finish.
items.promptZh: 创意编码活动的风格化电影海报，设计类似于迪士尼-皮克斯风格的单页动画电影。垂直构图，夜间温暖舒适的室内装饰，左侧的大阁楼窗户展示了日落时的城市天际线，裸露的砖墙和霓虹灯照亮的创意工作室氛围。在顶部中心，大的光滑立体排版在主标题“人工智能网页设计冲刺”上方以巨大的粗体白色 3D 字母写着“Disney•PIXAR”。正下方，较小的明亮文字写着“快速构建。打破规则。大声分享。”在中心前景中，两名成年男子并排坐在一张木桌旁，中间放着一台笔记本电脑，一派休闲的初创公司创始人氛围，其中一人穿着深色连帽衫，另一人穿着浅色运动衫，戴着棒球帽，两人都面向镜头摆出友好的促销姿势。他们的面孔应该是通用的、不引人注目的，重点是活动海报的构图而不是肖像现实主义。笔记本电脑盖上有 3 个可见贴纸：紫色代码括号贴纸、带有白色爆裂符号的黑色贴纸以及写有“快速构建。打破规则。大声分享”的矩形标语贴纸。场景周围包括 4 个异想天开的动画吉祥物元素：左上角有一个小型悬停机器人无人机灯，有发光的蓝眼睛和向下照射的锥形温暖光；右上角有一个微笑的卡通太阳图标；附近漂浮着一个微小的红色像素字符；笔记本电脑前的桌子上立着一个发光的蓝色猫状数字吉祥物。在右侧，垂直显示器显示一个深色编码界面，其中包含可读文本，包括“//欢迎回来，朱利安！”、“Opus 4.6”、“Minimal Playground”、“Agency 976”、“Cyber​​punk Cafe”、“Surfers (late set)”，以及标题为“Sprint Plan”的清单，其中包含 4 个项目：“DISCOVER”、“IDEATE”、“BUILD”、“SHIP”。左侧有一个手写纸质招牌，上面钉着 4 个告示：“4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE”、“DOORS 7PM”、“SHOW 8PM”和“$10 ADV / $12 DOS”。在左下方的前景中，一个白色咖啡杯上写着“THE SOUTH SIDE DIY 218 W. 31ST ST. CHICAGO, IL”，上面有一个小骷髅图标。在右下方的前景中，一个带有绿叶的陶土花盆上写着“创意碰撞”。在底部中心，大粗体文字写着“4 月 27-30 日”，下方写着“直播。仅在网络上”。以经典电影海报风格在底部边缘添加一小行人造字幕，引用 Julian Lopez 和 Harvey Spectre 等名字，Minimal Playground、Agency 976、Cyber​​punk Cafe 和 Surfers 等项目，以及有趣的制作字幕。使用引人注目的暖橙色和冷蓝色灯光、精美的动画电影渲染、柔和的景深、光滑的表面、丰富的对比度、高度详细的海报设计、迷人的科技初创公司能量以及优质的活动广告效果。

items.title: Swiss Poster for AI Web Design Sprint
items.titleZh: Create a bold Swiss-modernist event poster for a live AI and web design sprint, portrait orientation, with a warm off-white paper background, stark black typography, and vivid red accent blocks. The composition is asymmetrical and editorial, with a strong grid and generous negative space. In the top left, place a small red uppercase line of text reading {argument name="date text" default="LIVE APRIL 27–30"}, followed by a thin horizontal black rule stretching toward the right. Below it, set an oversized stacked headline in ultra-bold black sans serif, left aligned, reading {argument name="headline text" default="The AI Web Design Sprint"}, broken across 4 lines with dramatic scale so the words dominate the left half of the poster. In the upper right quadrant, add 1 large solid red rectangle as a graphic block. Beneath that red block, place a compact black uppercase subhead in 3 lines: {argument name="tagline text" default="4 DAYS. REAL PROJECTS. SHIP TOGETHER."}. In the lower middle, include 2 cropped grayscale portrait photos of men from the chest up, side by side, documentary style, slightly overlapping the typography area; the left man has dark slicked-back hair and a short beard, the right man wears a dark baseball cap with embroidered lettering and has facial hair. Obscure both faces with 2 vertical soft-edged gray censor rectangles centered over each face. Along the right side, create a vertical feature column with 4 black square icons, each separated by thin horizontal divider lines and paired with uppercase labels. The 4 items are: a starburst icon with the label "CREATIVE COLLISION", a connected-nodes icon with the label "AI-POWERED WORKFLOWS", a code brackets icon with the label "CODE IN MOTION", and a terminal prompt icon with the label "REAL-TIME DESIGN". Near the bottom, add a full-width footer separated by a thin horizontal black rule. Inside the footer, create 4 text blocks divided by slim vertical lines: block 1 says "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD.", block 2 lists "MINIMAL PLAYGROUND & AGENCY 976" with a small red line beneath reading "LIVE ON THE WEB", block 3 lists "CYBERPUNK CAFE SURFERS (LATE SET)" and below it "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE" and then "THE SOUTH SIDE DIY", block 4 lists ticket info as "TICKETS $10 ADV $12 DOS". On the far lower right edge, add vertical red text reading {argument name="location text" default="CHICAGO, IL"}. Use a clean neo-grotesk typeface similar to Helvetica or Akzidenz-Grotesk, heavy weight for the headline, condensed uppercase for supporting text, crisp alignment, subtle paper texture, and a high-contrast black-red-cream palette. The overall look should feel like a contemporary design-conference poster mixed with punk tech culture and brutalist editorial branding.
items.promptZh: 为实时人工智能和网页设计冲刺创建一张大胆的瑞士现代主义活动海报，纵向，具有温暖的灰白色纸张背景、纯黑色版式和鲜艳的红色强调块。构图是不对称的和编辑性的，具有强大的网格和宽敞的负空间。在左上角，放置一条小的红色大写文本行：{argument name="date text" default="LIVE APRIL 27–30"}，后面是一条向右延伸的细水平黑色线。在其下方，设置一个超大的堆叠标题，采用超粗体黑色无衬线字体，左对齐，内容为{argument name="headline text" default="The AI Web Design Sprint"}，以戏剧性的比例分成 4 行，这样文字就占据了海报的左半部分。在右上象限中，添加 1 个大的红色实心矩形作为图形块。在该红色块下方，放置一个紧凑的黑色大写副标题，分为 3 行：{argument name="tagline text" default="4 DAYS. items.title: Punk AI Sprint Flyer
items.titleZh: Create a raw, high-contrast punk rock gig poster collage for an event called {argument name="event title" default="THE AI WEB DESIGN SPRINT"}. The design should feel like a xeroxed underground flyer pasted on a city wall: rough torn paper edges, photocopy grain, ink smudges, distressed black-and-white textures, hot magenta paint splashes, DIY zine aesthetics, and chaotic layered paper scraps taped and pinned together. Use a vertical poster composition with a black background and a central oversized torn white rectangle set at a slight angle, filled with huge condensed black distressed lettering for the main title. At the very top, add a smaller black torn strip with handwritten brush lettering in neon magenta reading {argument name="top slogan" default="LIVE PUNK!"}. On the left side, place a hot pink torn paper block with hand-drawn black text listing the date {argument name="event dates" default="April 27-30"}, then smaller stacked lines reading "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE", "DOORS 7PM", "SHOW 8PM", "$10 ADV", and "$12 DOS". On the right side, add an off-white torn note with magenta "WITH:" at the top and four supporting acts listed in black handwritten text: "Minimal Playground", "Agency 976", "Cyberpunk Cafe", and "Surfers (Late Set)". In the center-lower area, show exactly 2 black-and-white photocopied punk band members from the chest up, standing shoulder to shoulder, both wearing leather jackets with patches and pins; the left one has round glasses, the right one wears a baseball cap. Their faces should be generic and partially obscured by the collage styling so the poster focus remains typographic and graphic rather than portrait-specific. Add a hot pink spiky starburst on the mid-right containing a black circle with a simple white radial symbol. Near the bottom right, place a beige masking-tape-like paper scrap with bold handwritten black text reading "Build Fast. Break Rules. Share Loud.". Near the bottom left, add a black rectangular venue block with magenta hand lettering for {argument name="venue name" default="THE SOUTH SIDE DIY"} and smaller white address text "218 W. 31st Street" and "Chicago, IL", plus a small white skull icon nearby. Include exactly 2 silver safety pins, one near the upper left corner and one near the lower left area, and exactly 1 strip of dark duct tape on the left edge of the main title paper. Finish the bottom edge with a black-and-white checkerboard strip spanning the full width. Overall mood: rebellious, loud, youthful, anarchic, street-pasted punk flyer meets tech event promo, with intense contrast, gritty halftone noise, screen-print imperfections, and hand-made collage energy.
items.promptZh: 为名为 {argument name="event title" default="THE AI WEB DESIGN SPRINT"} 的活动创建原始、高对比度的朋克摇滚演出海报拼贴画。设计应该感觉像是一张粘贴在城墙上的复印地下传单：粗糙的撕破纸边、复印颗粒、墨水污迹、仿旧的黑白纹理、热洋红色油漆泼溅、DIY 杂志美学以及用胶带粘在一起并钉在一起的混乱的分层纸屑。使用垂直海报构图，黑色背景和中央超大的撕裂白色矩形，以小角度设置，主标题填充巨大的浓缩黑色仿旧字体。在最顶部，添加一条较小的黑色撕裂条，上面有霓虹灯洋红色的手写毛笔字样：{argument name="top slogan" default="LIVE PUNK!"}。在左侧放置一块亮粉色撕纸，上面有手绘黑色文本，列出日期 {argument name="event days" default="April 27-30"}，然后是较小的堆叠线，上面写着“4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE”、“DOORS 7PM”、“SHOW 8PM”、“$10 ADV”和“$12 DOS”。在右侧添加一张灰白色撕破纸条，顶部带有洋红色“WITH：”，并以黑色手写文字列出四位支持者：“Minimal Playground”、“Agency 976”、“Cyber​​punk Cafe”和“Surfers (Late Set)”。在中下区域，恰好展示了两名朋克乐队成员从胸部以上的黑白影印版，肩并肩站立，两人都穿着带有补丁和别针的皮夹克；左边戴着圆框眼镜，右边戴着棒球帽。他们的脸应该是通用的，并被拼贴风格部分遮挡，因此海报的焦点仍然是印刷和图形，而不是特定的肖像。在右中添加一个亮粉色尖刺星爆，其中包含一个黑色圆圈和一个简单的白色放射状符号。在右下角附近，放置一张米色遮蔽胶带状的纸片，上面写着粗体手写黑色文字，上面写着“快速构建。打破规则。大声分享。”。在左下角附近，添加一个带有洋红色手写字样的黑色矩形场地块 {argument name="venue name" default="THE SOUTH SIDE DIY"} 和较小的白色地址文本“218 W. 31st Street”和“Chicago, IL”，以及附近的一个白色小骷髅图标。包括 2 个银色安全别针，一个靠近左上角，一个靠近左下区域，以及主标题纸左边缘上的 1 条深色胶带。用横跨整个宽度的黑白棋盘条完成底部边缘。整体氛围：叛逆、大声、年轻、无政府主义、街头粘贴的朋克传单与科技活动宣传片的结合，具有强烈的对比、坚韧的半色调噪音、丝网印刷的缺陷和手工拼贴的能量。

items.title: Premium Beverage Commercial Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a bold, high-end commercial poster for a premium {argument name="product" default="orange juice"} brand, shot in a hyper-realistic studio environment with a strong emphasis on freshness, precision, and striking visual appeal.
Hero Composition:
A sleek transparent bottle filled with rich, vibrant {argument name="liquid" default="orange juice"} stands at the center. The label is minimal, modern, and premium, featuring a clean orange graphic with refined typography. The bottle is topped with a matte black cap, enhanced by subtle highlights and realistic reflections.
Action & Story:
Two hands wearing matte black gloves interact with the product:
One hand firmly grips the bottle from the top
The other slices through a thick, juicy orange using a sharp stainless steel knife
The cut is captured mid-action, showcasing the juicy pulp and fresh citrus texture. A few orange slices are placed at the base, slightly scattered to create a natural yet styled composition.
Lighting & Mood:
Background: deep, rich green gradient with cinematic falloff
Surface: dark matte table with soft, controlled reflections
Lighting: dramatic studio setup
Strong key light from one side for depth
Soft fill light for balance
Crisp highlights on the bottle and knife
Deep, clean shadows for contrast
Typography Layout:

Top corner:
Clean, modern brand name (e.g., “VITRA”, “FRESCO”, or “NATURO”) in white
Bottom section:
Small line: “Not your average juice”

Large bold headline: “{argument name="headline" default="PURE ORANGE. NO COMPROMISE."}”
Typography should feel modern, bold, and premium with a strong visual hierarchy. Use a rich orange tone for the headline to complement the juice.

Visual Style:

High-end food advertising aesthetic

Cinematic, bold, and contrast-driven

Ultra-sharp details and textures

Premium editorial look (like a global campaign)

Clean yet powerful composition

Output Requirements:

4K resolution

Photorealistic, advertisement-grade quality

Sharp focus, rich contrast, high dynamic range
items.promptZh:
为优质{argument name="product" default="orange Juice"}品牌制作一张大胆的高端商业海报，在超现实的工作室环境中拍摄，重点强调新鲜度、精确性和引人注目的视觉吸引力。
英雄构成：
一个光滑的透明瓶子位于中心，里面装满了丰富、充满活力的{argument name="liquid" default="orange Juice"}。该标签简约、现代、优质，采用干净的橙色图形和精致的排版。瓶子顶部配有哑光黑色瓶盖，微妙的高光和逼真的反射增强了瓶身的质感。
动作与故事：
两只戴着哑光黑色手套的手与产品互动：

另一个用锋利的不锈钢刀切开厚厚多汁的橙子

items.title: Weathered Custom Cub Concept Bike
items.titleZh: A highly detailed concept illustration of a customized vintage step-through motorcycle inspired by a Honda Super Cub, shown in a clean studio-like three-quarter left side view on a plain light gray background. The bike has a rugged post-apocalyptic street-build aesthetic with a black, white, and muted gray color scheme accented by small pink stickers and decals. Emphasize heavy weathering: chipped paint, scratches, oil stains, grime, rust flecks, ink splatter, worn edges, and layered sticker residue across the entire body. The front has 1 square headlight with an X-shaped light pattern and 2 smaller stacked auxiliary lights beneath it. Use spoked wheels, thick all-terrain tires, visible front suspension, exposed mechanical detail, chain drive, and a sturdy center stand touching the ground. The leg shield and side panels are covered in graphic decals, Japanese-style warning labels, numbers, symbols, and distressed typography, including a bold large kanji mark on the front fairing. Add 2 hard side cargo boxes on the rear, one larger box on the far side and 1 nearer black box with extra stickers, plus 1 hanging vertical tag charm attached near the rear case. Include 1 long black ribbed seat, rear rack framing, exposed wiring, metal brackets, bolts, and compact utility accessories that make it feel hand-modified and functional. Render it like an industrial design sketch mixed with polished anime mech concept art: precise linework, watercolor wash shadows, soft gray ground shadow, high-detail mechanical realism, slightly messy inked edges, and a collectible custom-bike illustration feel.
items.promptZh: 受本田 Super Cub 启发的定制老式步进摩托车的高度详细的概念插图，以纯浅灰色背景上干净的工作室式四分之三左侧视图显示。这款自行车具有粗犷的后世界末日街头建筑美学，采用黑色、白色和柔和的灰色配色方案，并配有粉红色小贴纸和贴花。强调严重风化：油漆剥落、划痕、油渍、污垢、锈斑、墨水飞溅、边缘磨损以及整个车身的分层贴纸残留。前部有 1 个带有 X 形光图案的方形头灯，其下方有 2 个较小的堆叠式辅助灯。使用辐条轮、厚实的全地形轮胎、可见的前悬架、暴露的机械细节、链条传动装置和接触地面的坚固中心支架。腿罩和侧板上覆盖着图形贴花、日式警告标签、数字、符号和仿旧版式，包括前整流罩上的粗体大汉字标记。在后部添加 2 个硬侧货箱，在远端添加 1 个较大的箱子，在较近的一侧添加 1 个带有额外贴纸的黑色箱子，再加上后箱附近附有 1 个悬挂式垂直标签饰物。包括 1 个黑色长肋状座椅、后架框架、外露接线、金属支架、螺栓和紧凑的实用配件，使其具有手工改装和实用的感觉。将其渲染为工业设计草图，与精美的动漫机甲概念艺术混合在一起：精确的线条、水彩水洗阴影、柔和的灰色地面阴影、高细节的机械现实主义、略显凌乱的墨迹边缘以及具有收藏价值的定制自行车插画感觉。

items.title: Luxury Germany Travel Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a luxurious vintage-style travel poster for {argument name="country name" default="Germany"}, designed like a premium tourism campaign advertisement. Use a grand, symmetrical composition with elegant editorial typography and a refined gold border frame with tiny ornamental corner details. At the top center, place a small gold national emblem above the word “DISCOVER”, then a very large serif title reading {argument name="headline country" default="GERMANY"} in deep navy blue. Under it, add the slogan “LAND OF HISTORY. CULTURE. INSPIRATION.” in gold uppercase, followed by a smaller classic serif tagline reading “Timeless Traditions. Unforgettable Journeys.” with a tiny horizontal accent in the colors black, red, and gold.

Show a majestic panoramic montage of iconic German scenery at golden hour under a softly glowing blue sky with scattered clouds. On the left, feature a fairy-tale white hilltop castle resembling Neuschwanstein, perched above autumn trees. In the center distance, place dramatic alpine mountains. On the right, show a historic European riverside city with dense red-roofed houses, an arched stone bridge crossing the water, a domed cathedral, and a towering Gothic cathedral with twin spires. Add calm river reflections and a small white sightseeing boat at the lower right. The image should feel nostalgic, romantic, and aspirational, with warm sunlight, crisp architectural detail, and rich cinematic color grading.

Along the lower middle, include exactly 5 gold line-art cultural icons with labels beneath them, evenly spaced in a horizontal row: “ICONIC LANDMARKS”, “RICH HERITAGE”, “VIBRANT CULTURE”, “AUTHENTIC TRADITIONS”, and “BREATHTAKING LANDSCAPES”.

At the bottom, create a dark horizontal food showcase strip with the centered heading “SAVOR THE TASTE OF GERMANY” in gold. Inside the strip, include exactly 5 framed food panels, each labeled in white uppercase beneath the image: “BREZEL”, “BRATWURST”, “KARTOFFELSALAT”, “SCHWARZWÄLDER KIRSCHTORTE”, and “GERMAN BEER”. Show each item as an appetizing close-up: a glossy pretzel on a plate, grilled sausages with sauerkraut, creamy potato salad, a slice of Black Forest cake topped with cream and cherry, and a frothy beer mug. Keep the overall design polished, high-end, poster-like, and suitable for a luxury destination campaign.
items.promptZh:
为{argument name="country name" default="Germany"}制作一张豪华复古风格的旅行海报，其设计类似于优质旅游活动广告。使用宏伟、对称的构图、优雅的编辑排版和精致的金色边框，并带有微小的装饰角细节。在顶部中心，在“DISCOVER”一词上方放置一个小的金色国徽，然后放置一个非常大的衬线标题，其为深海军蓝色的{argument name="headlinecountry"default="GERMANY"}。在其下方添加口号“历史之地。文化。灵感。”金色大写字母，后面是较小的经典衬线标语：“永恒的传统。难忘的旅程。”带有黑色、红色和金色的微小水平装饰。

在柔和的蓝天和零散的云彩下，展示黄金时段德国标志性风景的壮丽全景蒙太奇。左边是一座童话般的白色山顶城堡，类似新天鹅堡，坐落在秋天的树木上方。中心距离是引人注目的高山山脉。右侧展示的是一座历史悠久的欧洲河畔城市，有密集的红顶房屋、横跨水面的拱形石桥、圆顶大教堂和高耸的双尖塔哥特式大教堂。在右下角添加平静的河流倒影和一艘白色的小观光船。图像应该给人怀旧、浪漫和渴望的感觉，有温暖的阳光、清晰的建筑细节和丰富的电影色彩分级。

沿着中下方，正好包含 5 个金色线条艺术文化图标，其下方带有标签，水平排列均匀分布：“标志性地标”、“丰富的遗产”、“活力文化”、“真实的传统”和“令人惊叹的景观”。

在底部，创建一个深色水平食品展示条，中间带有金色标题“品尝德国的味道”。条带内包含 5 个带框食品面板，每个面板在图像下方均以白色大写字母标记：“BREZEL”、“BRATWURST”、“KARTOFFELSALAT”、“SCHWARZWäLDER KIRSCHTORTE”和“GERMAN BEER”。将每件物品都以令人胃口大开的特写镜头展示：盘子里有光泽的椒盐卷饼、酸菜烤香肠、奶油土豆沙拉、一片淋有奶油和樱桃的黑森林蛋糕，以及一个泡沫啤酒杯。保持整体设计精致、高端、海报般，适合豪华目的地活动。

items.title: Romantic Paris Travel Poster
items.titleZh:
A luxurious vintage-travel-poster style illustration of {argument name="country name" default="FRANCE"} with {argument name="city name" default="PARIS"} as the destination, designed like an elegant tourism advertisement. Use a grand, romantic Paris cityscape at golden-hour sunset with a glowing pastel sky in peach, pink, lavender, and soft gold. Make the Eiffel Tower the dominant central landmark, tall and detailed, rising above the city. Include 4 additional iconic Paris landmarks: the Louvre Pyramid on the left, the Arc de Triomphe near the center background, Notre-Dame Cathedral to the right of the Eiffel Tower, and Sacré-Cœur Basilica on the far upper-right hillside. In the foreground, fill the scene with dense blooming {argument name="flower field" default="lavender"} in vivid purple, creating a dreamy, painterly foreground leading into the city. Add a river and elegant stone bridges beneath the Eiffel Tower with warm reflected sunset light. The composition should feel idealized, cinematic, and slightly fantastical, combining multiple landmarks into one harmonious panoramic view.

Overlay refined editorial typography in the upper-left to upper-center area: a very large serif title reading {argument name="headline text" default="FRANCE"}, with a smaller spaced serif subtitle reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="PARIS"}. Above the subtitle, place a small gold fleur-de-lis ornament; below it, add a tiny horizontal French tricolor accent. Under the main heading, include the two lines of promotional copy exactly: "TIMELESS BEAUTY. ENDLESS INSPIRATION." and "Where Every Moment Becomes a Memory" in elegant small caps and italic script. Add a thin decorative gold border around the whole poster with delicate ornamental corner details.

At the bottom, create a soft cream misted panel blending into the image, with the phrase "THE FRENCH ART OF LIVING" centered above a row of 3 food-and-drink items: 1 buttery croissant on a plate, 1 glass of red wine with 1 wine bottle, and 1 crème brûlée in a ramekin topped with berries. Label them "CROISSANT", "FINE WINE", and "CRÈME BRÛLÉE". To the right, add 4 small gold line icons with labels beneath them: "ICONIC LANDMARKS", "RICH HERITAGE", "AUTHENTIC CUISINE", and "UNFORGETTABLE EXPERIENCES". Overall style: ultra-detailed, polished travel poster, romantic European tourism ad, painterly realism, warm luminous atmosphere, premium print design, balanced composition, high-end magazine aesthetic.

奢华的复古旅行海报风格插图，以{argument name="country name" default="FRANCE"}为目的地，{argument name="city name" default="PARIS"}，设计得像一则优雅的旅游广告。在黄金时段的日落时分，欣赏宏伟、浪漫的巴黎城市景观，以及桃红色、粉红色、薰衣草色和淡金色的柔和天空。让埃菲尔铁塔成为占据主导地位的中心地标，高大而精致，矗立在城市之上。包括另外 4 个巴黎标志性地标：左侧的卢浮宫金字塔、中心背景附近的凯旋门、埃菲尔铁塔右侧的巴黎圣母院以及最右上山坡上的圣心大教堂。在前景中，用鲜艳的紫色茂密盛开的{argument name="flower field" default="lavender"}填充场景，营造出通往城市的梦幻般的绘画前景。在埃菲尔铁塔下方添加一条河流和优雅的石桥，反射温暖的日落光。构图应该给人一种理想化、电影般的感觉，并且略带幻想，将多个地标结合成一个和谐的全景视图。

在左上角到中上区域覆盖精致的编辑排版：一个非常大的衬线标题，阅读{argument name =“headline text”default =“FRANCE”}，带有较小间距的衬线副标题阅读{argument name =“subheadline text”default =“PARIS”}。在副标题上方放置一个金色的百合花小装饰品；在它的下面，添加一个微小的水平法国三色口音。在主标题下，准确地包含两行促销文案：“永恒的美丽。无尽的灵感。”以及优雅的小写字母和斜体字体的“Where Every Moment Been a Memory”。在整个海报周围添加细细的装饰性金色边框，并带有精致的装饰角细节。

在底部，创建一个与图像融为一体的软奶油雾面板，将短语“法国生活艺术”置于一排 3 个食品和饮料的上方：1 个放在盘子上的黄油羊角面包、1 杯红酒和 1 个酒瓶，以及 1 个放在模子里的焦糖布丁，上面有浆果。将它们标记为“羊角面包”、“美酒”和“焦糖布丁”。在右侧添加 4 个小金线图标，其下方带有标签：“标志性地标”、“丰富的遗产”、“正宗美食”和“难忘的体验”。整体风格：超细致、精美的旅游海报，浪漫的欧洲旅游广告，绘画写实，温暖的发光氛围，优质的印刷设计，平衡的构图，高端的杂志审美。

items.title: Luxury Northern Europe Travel Poster
items.titleZh: Create an elegant luxury travel poster for {argument name="region name" default="NORTHERN EUROPE"}, designed like a premium tourism campaign brochure cover. Use a wide symmetrical layout with a thin gold decorative border and refined editorial typography. At the top center, place a small compass-star icon above the word DISCOVER, then a very large serif headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="NORTHERN EUROPE"} in deep navy blue. Below it, add a gold uppercase tagline: {argument name="tagline" default="BREATHTAKING NATURE. RICH CULTURE. TIMELESS EXPERIENCES."} and beneath that a smaller elegant italic line: {argument name="subheading" default="Four Countries. Countless Memories."}. The main image area is divided into 4 equal vertical scenic panels showing iconic destinations at golden hour with soft glowing skies and cinematic realism. Panel 1: Denmark, Copenhagen, a colorful harbor waterfront with historic buildings, boats, calm reflective water, and a domed landmark in the background; include a small Danish flag above the labels DENMARK and COPENHAGEN. Panel 2: Sweden, Stockholm, a waterfront old-town skyline with church spires and warm sunset light reflected in the water; include a small Swedish flag above the labels SWEDEN and STOCKHOLM. Panel 3: Finland, Helsinki, a small stone castle-like island fortress in blue water under a bright sky; include a small Finnish flag above the labels FINLAND and HELSINKI. Panel 4: Norway, dramatic fjords with steep jagged mountains, a waterfall, and a tiny red-roof coastal village at the water’s edge; include a small Norwegian flag above the labels NORWAY and FJORDS OF NORWAY. Beneath the 4 country panels, add a row of 4 gold line icons with captions, evenly spaced: mountain icon with ICONIC LANDSCAPES, Viking ship icon with RICH HERITAGE, moose icon with WILD NATURE, camera icon with UNFORGETTABLE JOURNEYS. Near the bottom center, place a gold divider and the title A TASTE OF THE NORTH. items.titleZh: Create a dramatic Japanese anime-style promotional thumbnail poster for an event, vertical 4:5 composition, ultra-detailed, cinematic, neon-lit, high contrast, designed like a social media announcement image. The main subject is a beautiful anime girl centered slightly right, shown from the waist up, with long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="deep blue"} hair blowing in the wind, decorated with small star hairpins, wearing a dark hoodie and large studio headphones around her neck, against a glowing sunset-to-night city skyline filled with sparkling lights, music-energy particles, lens flares, and flying glowing petals. Her face area is obscured by a soft rectangular blur block. Use a vivid palette of electric blue, violet, magenta, gold, and sunset orange.
