items.title: Luxury Magazine Cover With Featured Book
items.titleZh: A photorealistic premium magazine cover in the style of an international design and business publication, shot as a sophisticated editorial still life. The cover features a dark, moody interior with shallow depth of field and warm ambient lighting. Center-right, standing upright on a glossy black marble table, is a cream-colored paperback book titled {argument name="book title" default="The Pathless Path"} by {argument name="author name" default="Paul Millerd"}. The book is angled slightly to the left so both the front cover and spine are visible. The cover illustration is minimalist navy-blue line art showing an office interior with an open door leading into a winding outdoor path, framed pictures on the wall, a water cooler, a desk with stacked papers, and a person slumped in an office chair. The author’s name appears near the lower left of the front cover, and the title also runs vertically on the spine. To the left of the book on the marble surface is a small stack of 4 books, softly out of focus, and in the lower-left foreground sits 1 dark coffee cup on a saucer. Behind them is a dim, elegant room with blurred shelving and a soft green plant shape in the background. The magazine masthead dominates the top: {argument name="magazine title" default="MONOCLE"} in very large white serif letters across the width, with small white issue text at top left reading {argument name="issue text" default="MAY 2024 • ISSUE 167"} and small white tagline text at top right reading “THE ENTREPRENEURS’ MAGAZINE”. Beneath the masthead is a thin rule and a category line in small gold serif text with 6 categories separated by dots: “AFFAIRS • BUSINESS • CULTURE • DESIGN • ENTERTAINING • FASHION”. On the left side, large white serif cover headline text reads “Rethinking Success”. Below it is a white serif subheadline about leaving the default path behind and building a life and work that matters, followed by a small gold page number. Further down the left column are 4 editorial teaser blocks, each with a gold circular icon and gold uppercase heading, white descriptive text, and a gold page number. The 4 headings are “ESCAPE THE DEFAULT”, “WORK WITH PURPOSE”, “A NEW STORY”, and a boxed teaser “DESIGN SPECIAL”. At the bottom right is a realistic barcode block with small pricing text above it and a small issue number beside it. The overall layout should feel like a real luxury magazine cover mockup: crisp typography, elegant serif fonts, black, white, cream, and gold palette, glossy reflections on the marble, cinematic shadows, subtle product reflection beneath the book, and high-end editorial photography styling.
items.promptZh: 逼真的高级杂志封面，采用国际设计和商业出版物的风格，以精致的社论静物形式拍摄。封面的特点是黑暗、喜怒无常的内部、浅景深和温暖的环境照明。中间偏右，直立在光滑的黑色大理石桌子上，是一本米色平装书，书名是{argument name="book title" default="The Pathless Path"}，作者是{argument name="author name" default="Paul Millerd"}。这本书稍微向左倾斜，因此封面和书脊都可见。封面插图是极简主义的海军蓝色线条艺术，展示了办公室内部，有一扇开着的门通向一条蜿蜒的户外小路，墙上挂着相框，有一个饮水机、一张堆满文件的桌子，以及一个瘫坐在办公椅上的人。作者姓名出现在封面左下角附近，标题也在书脊上垂直排列。大理石表面上的书的左侧是一小堆 4 本书，焦点模糊，左下前景的碟子上放着 1 个深色咖啡杯。他们身后是一间昏暗、优雅的房间，架子模糊，背景是柔和的绿色植物形状。杂志标头占据顶部：{argument name="magazine title" default="MONOCLE"}，宽度非常大的白色衬线字母，左上角有小的白色期刊文本，内容为{argument name="issue text" default="MAY 2024 • ISSUE 167"}，右上角有小的白色标语文本，内容为“THE ENTREPRENEURS’ MAGAZINE”。报头下方是一条细尺和一条金色小衬线文字的类别线，其中有 6 个类别，用点分隔：“事务•商业•文化•设计•娱乐•时尚”。左侧，大号白色衬线封面标题文字为“重新思考成功”。下面是一个白色衬线副标题，内容是关于抛弃默认路径并建立重要的生活和工作，后面是一个金色的小页码。左栏下方有 4 个编辑预告块，每个块都有一个金色圆形图标和金色大写标题、白色描述性文本和金色页码。四个标题分别是“摆脱默认”、“有目的工作”、“新故事”和盒装预告片“特别设计”。右下角是一个真实的条形码块，上面有小的定价文本，旁边有一个小的发行编号。整体布局应该感觉像一个真正的豪华杂志封面模型：清晰的排版、优雅的衬线字体、黑色、白色、奶油色和金色调色板、大理石上的光泽反射、电影阴影、书本下方微妙的产品反射以及高端编辑摄影风格。

items.title: Funny DIY Disaster Cat Comic
items.titleZh: Create a colorful humorous comic-style poster in Spanish, vertical format, with a retro cartoon look, thick black outlines, warm orange and yellow palette, halftone texture, and exaggerated expressive characters. The layout has 4 distinct panels: 1 large title panel across the top and 3 equal vertical panels along the bottom row. In the top panel, show a smug orange tabby cat handyman standing upright like a person in a cozy living room workshop, holding a screwdriver in one paw and the other paw on the hip, wearing a utility belt with visible tools. The cat has narrowed confident eyes and a sly grin. On the left side of this top panel, place a large jagged comic burst with the Spanish headline in bold distressed lettering: "3 PASOS PARA ARRUINAR ALGO FÁCIL", with "ARRUINAR" in red and the rest in black. Below it, add a taped paper strip that says "edición casera". In the background of the top panel, include a framed sign on the wall that reads "YO PUEDO SOLO" with a small paw print, a small potted plant, shelves, and dynamic radial lines behind the cat. In the bottom row, create 3 labeled step panels, each with a yellow header box and bold black text. Panel 1 header: "PASO 1". Show the same orange cat sitting calmly on the floor beside a standing lamp, eyes closed with overconfidence, casually holding a screwdriver. Add a speech bubble that says "Tranqui, esto lo arreglo en 2 minutos." Include a small open toolbox and a few screws on the floor. Panel 2 header: "PASO 2". Show the cat mid-repair, now alarmed with wide eyes, awkwardly unscrewing the wrong part of the lamp while pieces and screws fly through the air. Add a speech bubble that says "Ups..." and a sticky note near the bottom that says "tocar lo que no era". Include visual motion lines, scattered debris, and a toppled plant pot. Panel 3 header: "PASO 3". Show the aftermath: the lamp is broken and smoking with exposed wires and sparks, the room is messy with shattered parts everywhere, and the cat sits stunned holding the screwdriver. A brown dog stands to the right, looking disappointed, asking in a speech bubble "¿Qué hiciste?" The cat replies in another speech bubble "No sé... se complicó solo." Add a taped label at the bottom that says "resultado final". Make the entire image playful, chaotic, and meme-like, with polished digital illustration, expressive faces, comic lettering, and a DIY disaster tone.
items.promptZh: 用西班牙竖版格式创建丰富多彩的幽默漫画风格海报，具有复古卡通外观、粗黑轮廓、温暖的橙色和黄色调色板、半色调纹理以及夸张的表现力人物。该布局有 4 个不同的面板：顶部有 1 个大标题面板，底部行有 3 个相等的垂直面板。在顶部面板中，展示了一只自鸣得意的橙色虎斑猫勤杂工，像舒适的客厅车间中的人一样笔直站立，一只爪子拿着一把螺丝刀，另一只爪子放在臀部，戴着一条带有可见工具的实用腰带。猫眯起自信的眼睛，露出狡猾的笑容。在此顶部面板的左侧，放置一个巨大的锯齿状漫画连环画，标题为西班牙粗体仿旧字体：“3 PASOS PARA ARRUINAR ALGO FÁCIL”，其中“ARRUINAR”为红色，其余部分为黑色。在其下方添加一条胶带纸条，上面写着“edición casera”。在顶部面板的背景中，在墙上放置一个带框的标牌，上面写着“YO PUEDO SOLO”，上面有一个小爪子图案、一个小盆栽、架子和猫身后的动态放射线。在底行中，创建 3 个带标签的步骤面板，每个面板都有一个黄色标题框和粗体黑色文本。面板 1 标题：“PASO 1”。同样的橙色猫平静地坐在落地灯旁边的地板上，自信地闭着眼睛，随意地拿着一把螺丝刀。添加一个对话气泡，上面写着“Tranqui, esto lo arreglo en 2 minutos”。包括一个小型开放式工具箱和地板上的一些螺丝。面板 2 标题：“PASO 2”。展示正在修理中的猫，现在睁大了眼睛，笨拙地拧开了灯的错误部件，而碎片和螺丝在空中飞舞。添加一个对话气泡，上面写着“Ups...”，并在底部附近添加一个便签，上面写着“tocar lo que noera”。包括视觉运动线、散落的碎片和倒塌的花盆。面板 3 标题：“PASO 3”。展示后果：灯坏了，冒着烟，电线和火花裸露在外，房间里一片狼藉，碎片到处都是，猫拿着螺丝刀呆呆地坐着。一只棕色的狗站在右边，看上去很失望，在对话气泡中问道“¿Qué hiciste？”猫在另一个对话气泡中回复“No sé...se complicó alone”。在底部添加一个胶带标签，上面写着“最终结果”。通过精美的数字插图、富有表现力的面孔、漫画字体和 DIY 灾难色调，使整个图像变得有趣、混乱和模因。

Render a 6-row month view with exactly 42 date cells including adjacent-month dates. The visible dates should be: first row 29, 30, 31, 1, 2, 3, 4; second row 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11; third row 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18; fourth row 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25; fifth row 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 1, 2; sixth row 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. Each day cell includes a large Gregorian date and a smaller Chinese lunar date or note underneath. Include colored holiday and solar-term tags across specific cells, with exactly 10 highlighted labels visible: “休十七” on the 4th, “清明节” on the 5th, “休十九” on the 6th, “谷雨” on the 20th in green, “劳动节” on the next-month 1st, “休十六” on the next-month 2nd, “休十七” on the last-row 3rd, “青年节” on the last-row 4th, “休立夏” on the last-row 5th, and “天后诞” on the last-row 9th in orange. Add small lunar phase markers on a few days, including yellow crescent or dot icons around the 2nd, 10th, 17th, 24th, and next-month 2nd. Make the {argument name="selected date" default="24"} cell in the Friday column stand out with a rounded blue gradient tile and soft shadow, with smaller text “初八” inside. Beneath the calendar, show a detailed daily information panel separated by whitespace. The left side features a very large date title “4月24日”; the right side stacks “星期五 2026” and “农历三月初八”. Below that, include smaller gray metadata lines such as “第114天 · 第17周 金尊月” and a traditional sexagenary/date string like “丙午 · 马年 壬辰月 戊辰日”. At the far right of this metadata area, place a rounded outline pill button labeled “今日”. Underneath, present a large white rounded card with almanac guidance. The card contains two major sections with exactly 2 headings: a green “宜” section and a red “忌” section, separated by fine dotted dividers. In the “宜” section, include the directional fortune line “喜神 东南 福神 正北 财神 正北” and three activity items: “祭祀”, “修饰垣墙”, “余事勿取”. In the “忌” section, include the conflict line “冲煞 冲狗 煞南”. At the bottom, show a 5-item iOS-style tab bar with labels exactly “今日”, “MONTH”, “YEAR”, “EVENTS”, “MORE”; the first tab is active and includes the small sublabel “4月24日”. Overall style: premium app design concept, calm scholarly Chinese calendar aesthetic, high-fidelity mobile product shot, realistic yet idealized interface, perfectly aligned typography, subtle shadows, soft contrast, and polished startup-quality UI.

items.title: Retro Mince and Tatties Action Poster
items.titleZh: A bold retro propaganda-style poster illustration with a limited palette of red, black, and warm cream on a lightly aged paper texture. The composition features a dynamic anime-inspired action scene in the center: a martial artist in a white gi with a black belt carries a long-haired woman over one shoulder in a fireman's carry or wrestling throw pose. The fighter is shown from the knees up in a powerful wide stance, facing left, with the woman draped horizontally across the shoulders, her bare legs lifted and bent, her long dark hair flowing downward, and a black wide-brim cowboy hat still on her head. Render both figures in high-contrast inked line art with thick black shadows and sharp graphic contours, mixing manga character design with vintage screen-printed poster energy. Behind them, fill the background with aggressive geometric rays and wedges: 6 major red and black angular shapes radiating outward across the cream backdrop, creating a sense of impact and motion. In the top right corner, add 1 circular emblem containing a fierce gorilla or ape head icon with red accents. Across the lower third, place large bold condensed block typography integrated into the composition: the smaller line reads “SCOTTISH RECIPE:” and the huge main title reads “MINCE AND TATTIES”. Make the text red on cream and cream on black in layered diagonal banner panels, with the words occupying 3 text groupings total: “SCOTTISH RECIPE:”, “MINCE AND”, and “TATTIES”. Emphasize dramatic diagonal layout, posterized shadows, distressed print texture, and the feeling of a vintage Soviet constructivist or pulp exploitation food poster fused with martial arts manga aesthetics.
items.promptZh: 大胆的复古宣传风格海报插图，在轻微老化的纸张纹理上使用有限的红色、黑色和暖奶油色调色板。该构图的中心是一个动态的动漫风格的动作场景：一位身着白色道服、系着黑腰带的武术家，肩上扛着一位长发女子，摆出消防员的抬举或摔跤姿势。图中的斗士从膝盖向上，以一种强有力的宽站姿，面向左侧，女人水平地披在肩上，裸露的双腿抬起并弯曲，长长的黑发向下垂落，头上仍然戴着一顶黑色宽边牛仔帽。以高对比度墨水线条艺术渲染两个人物，具有厚重的黑色阴影和清晰的图形轮廓，将漫画角色设计与复古丝网印刷海报能量相结合。在它们后面，用激进的几何射线和楔形填充背景：6 个主要的红色和黑色角形在奶油色背景上向外辐射，营造出冲击感和运动感。在右上角添加 1 个圆形标志，其中包含带有红色点缀的凶猛大猩猩或猿头图标。在下三分之一处，将大型粗体压缩版式融入到构图中：较小的行写着“苏格兰食谱：”，巨大的主标题写着“MINCE AND TATTIES”。在分层对角横幅面板中，将文本设置为奶油色红色和黑色奶油色，单词总共占据 3 个文本组：“苏格兰食谱：”、“MINCE AND”和“TATTIES”。强调戏剧性的对角线布局、海报化的阴影、仿旧的印刷纹理，以及复古苏联建构主义或纸浆剥削食品海报与武术漫画美学融合的感觉。

items.title: Anime Fashion Magazine Cover
items.titleZh: A stylized Japanese fashion magazine cover titled MODE TOKYO, designed like a glossy contemporary women's style publication. The composition is a high-angle, dynamic street-fashion anime illustration of 2 girls looking up toward the viewer from beside a brick wall with colorful graffiti and dramatic sunlight. The girl on the right has {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair in a lively messy ponytail with loose bangs, bright green eyes, a wide cheerful grin, and a sporty-feminine outfit: a light blue lace-trim camisole or slip-style top, short bottoms, chunky white sneakers, and a black choker. She is posed energetically, leaning forward with one knee bent, giving a confident summer-fashion editorial feel. The girl on the left has long vivid teal-green hair with straight heavy bangs, large blue eyes, and a calm, cool expression. She wears a casual layered street outfit in dark tones with a sleeveless top and sits lower in the frame, angled toward the right girl while gazing upward. Use bold cel-shaded anime rendering with crisp linework, glossy highlights in the hair and eyes, soft skin shading, and a polished commercial illustration finish. The background should combine sunlit urban texture, blurred mural colors in pink, purple, orange, and black, and deep shadows to create contrast. The overall palette mixes hot pink typography, summer sunlight, teal, blonde, and saturated street-art hues. Include dense magazine-cover typography in a premium editorial layout: a giant pink serif masthead reading {argument name="magazine title" default="MODE"} across the top with TOKYO vertically on the left; on the upper right a dark circular or rounded block containing {argument name="issue number" default="06"}, JUNE 2024, vol.218, and cover lines in Japanese; on the left side several smaller Japanese and English fashion blurbs including NEO BASIC STYLE and SPORTY × FEMININE; a pink circular badge on the right with Japanese text and Trend 7; a large hot-pink Japanese headline across the lower left and center reading 私らしく、もっと輝く季節。; elegant white handwritten script diagonally across the lower right reading Shine in my Style; small footer cover lines and hashtags in Japanese; and a small BEAUTY label at bottom right. Make it look exactly like a real high-end Japanese fashion magazine cover, vertical format, full bleed, vibrant, youthful, feminine, sporty, and trendy.

items.title: Japanese Roman Typeface Specimen Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a refined vintage-modern type specimen poster for a fictional typeface named {argument name="typeface name" default="KASEI"}, designed as an elegant fusion of Roman and Japanese typography. Use a tall portrait layout on warm ivory textured paper with thin gray divider lines, black letterforms, and muted vermilion accent text and seals. Center the composition around a large serif Latin wordmark "{argument name="typeface name" default="KASEI"}" above 2 oversized Japanese kanji, "華世", set in a matching high-contrast classical style. Above the title, place the small heading "INTRODUCING" with a tiny ornamental diamond. To the right of the title area, add a vertical Japanese tagline reading "古典の美、未来の書体。". Under the main kanji, add the subtitle "A ROMAN × JAPANESE TYPEFACE" and below it a Japanese line in vermilion: "ローマの精神、日本の美。". On the far left, create a narrow sidebar with the stacked English text "A TYPEFACE HARMONIZING ROME AND JAPAN", a small circular crest, the Japanese text "製作 — MMXXIV", and "CREATED IN KYOTO, JAPAN".

Build the lower two-thirds as a meticulous type specimen sheet with exact labeled sections. In a left column, include 2 sections: "WEIGHTS" with 5 items — Light, Regular, Medium, Semibold, Bold — and "POINT SIZES" with 9 items — 8pt, 10pt, 12pt, 14pt, 18pt, 24pt, 36pt, 48pt, 72pt. In the main area, include a section titled "ROMAN CHARACTERS" showing 4 specimen lines: uppercase alphabet A through Z, lowercase alphabet a through z, numerals 0 through 9, and a punctuation/symbol line with slashes, commas, semicolons, exclamation mark, question marks, apostrophes, quotation marks, em dash, parentheses, brackets, braces, ampersand, at sign, dollar sign, asterisk, dagger, and double dagger. Below that, include a section titled "JAPANESE CHARACTERS" with 4 lines: 19 kanji "日 月 山 川 花 鳥 風 林 火 水 土 金 木 道 心 時 空 光 夢 永", 23 hiragana "あ い う え お か き く け こ さ し す せ そ た ち つ て と な に ぬ ね の", 21 katakana "ア イ ウ エ オ カ キ ク ケ コ サ シ ス セ ソ ン タ チ ツ テ ト ナ ニ ヌ ネ ノ", and a symbols line including Japanese punctuation, corner brackets, wave dash, middle dot, parentheses, angle brackets, double angle brackets, black lenticular brackets, postal mark, reference marks, and iteration mark.

Along the next row, add 4 compact specimen panels: "LIGATURES" with 10 items — Æ, AE, AJ, Œ, KA, KE, KI, KO, KU, and "st ct fi fl ft fb"; "STYLISTIC ALTERNATES" with 12 items — A, A, A, R, R, K, K, a, a, g, g, y, y, J, J, Q, Q, t, t — arranged as a neat sampling grid; "SPACING STUDY" showing the word "KASEI" with wide tracking above the kanji string "華世永美"; and "NUMERAL STYLES" with 4 lines — lining figures 0123456789, oldstyle figures 0123456789, and small caps combinations "H 0123" and "H 0123". Add tiny red Japanese captions beneath some of these sample boxes.

At the bottom, create 3 feature panels. Left panel titled "WORDS" with 3 entries: "HARMONIA" with the red Japanese and English gloss "調和  HARMONY", "VERITAS" with "真実  TRUTH", and "FORTITUDO" with "勇気  COURAGE". Center panel with a large Japanese quote "時を越え、美は残る。" above the English statement "BEAUTY ENDURES\nBEYOND TIME." and a small signature line "— KASEI" in red. Right panel titled "DETAILS" with a large kanji "永" over faint construction circles and guide lines, plus 4 right-aligned Japanese annotation callouts connected by fine dotted leader lines.

Finish with a footer containing 4 blocks: a small crest and "KASEI TYPE FOUNDRY" with "WWW.KASEIFOUNDRY.JP"; a centered language support note "SUPPORTING 200+ LANGUAGES" and "LATIN / GREEK / CYRILLIC / JAPANESE / SYMBOLS"; a right-side statement "DESIGNED WITH RESPECT\nCRAFTED FOR THE FUTURE"; and a square vermilion seal bearing "華世". Overall style should feel like a premium Japanese foundry specimen sheet, balancing editorial Swiss-grid precision, classical book typography, subtle Japanese branding, generous margins, restrained luxury, and museum-poster elegance.

items.title: Red Vinyl Soundtrack Ad
items.titleZh: A cinematic luxury product advertisement shot of a vintage wooden turntable playing a translucent bright red vinyl record in a warm, dimly lit living room. Behind the turntable, an upright album cover dominates the frame with a bold distressed red background and large condensed cream-white block lettering reading {argument name="album title" default="BELLA CIAO"} at the upper left, with smaller black text beneath reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="SOUNDTRACK OF THE RESISTANCE"}. The cover art shows a dark black silhouette of a hooded figure centered against the red field, with a row of small marching figures along the bottom edge and faint architectural line art on the lower left, evoking political resistance and dramatic soundtrack imagery. The turntable is shown in three-quarter view on a wooden table, with a brushed metal platter rim, black tonearm resting on the record at the right, and a small metallic control knob visible at front left. Use a shallow depth of field, premium editorial lighting, rich amber highlights, soft candle glow in the background on the right, shelves and home interior details blurred in the background, and a high-end fashion-campaign-meets-music-product aesthetic. At the bottom of the image, add a bold promotional banner overlay with large white condensed all-caps text reading {argument name="bottom headline" default="SOUNDTRACK OF THE RESISTANCE"} and a centered red rectangular button underneath with white all-caps text reading {argument name="button text" default="SHOP NOW"}. Include a small white {argument name="brand watermark" default="Pollo.ai"} watermark in the top-right corner. Ultra-realistic photography, sharp focus on the vinyl and cover, moody luxurious atmosphere, social-media ad composition, vertical 2:3 format.

items.title: Doomscrolling Editorial Poster
items.titleZh: A stark black-and-white editorial anti-tech poster on an off-white background, designed like a modern brutalist magazine cover about digital addiction. The composition is vertical and highly typographic, with one central surreal image and multiple blocks of small text. At the top center, huge bold condensed sans-serif text reads DOOM on one line and SCROLLING below it, with the word SCROLLING stretched across the page and partially motion-blurred or smeared horizontally. In the upper left corner, a tiny text block reads “SCROLL. SWIPE. NOTHING CHANGES.” with a short horizontal line above it. In the upper right corner, small text reads “24 / 7 / 365” above “THE FEED NEVER ENDS” with a horizontal divider line below. On the left side under the title, add a definition paragraph in small editorial text: “the act of spending an excessive amount of time scrolling through negative or distressing content online, often leading to feelings of anxiety, helplessness, and fatigue.” Beneath that, include 2 short horizontal divider lines, then a large statistic reading “67%” followed by smaller text: “OF PEOPLE AGED 18–24 SAY THEY SCROLL MORE THAN THEY INTEND TO. — PEW RESEARCH, 2023”. Below that, another statement reads “MORE SCROLLING. LESS LIVING.” with a divider line beneath. The center of the poster features a glossy black smartphone standing vertically at the bottom center, seen front-on, with the bottom speaker holes and charging port visible. Emerging from the phone screen is a long impossible staircase receding upward into a narrow tunnel made of repeated translucent vertical panels, creating a claustrophobic corridor. Within the tunnel, a giant grayscale human eye appears in the upper half, partially obscured by haze, vertical slicing, and ghosted repetitions, as if trapped inside the feed. The central image should feel eerie, dreamlike, oppressive, and cinematic, with soft fog, high contrast, photocopy grain, subtle motion smear, and layered transparency. Along the right side of the central image, add a narrow vertical numbered index with exactly 24 visible entries: 001, 002, 003, 004, 005, 007, 008, 009, 010, 011, 012, 013, 014, 015, 017, 018, 019, 020, 021, 022, 024, 025, 026, and an ellipsis, plus a thin downward arrow underneath. In the right column, add a text block titled “DESIGNED TO KEEP YOU HOOKED.” followed by 4 short lines: “Infinite feeds. Unpredicted rewards. Endless comparison. It’s not a glitch— it’s the business model.” Below that place a simple eye/globe icon, then a black rectangular box containing the message: “AWARENESS IS THE FIRST STEP: PUT THE PHONE DOWN. LOOK UP. RECLAIM YOUR TIME.” On the lower left, place a massive cropped black word fragment reading END near the bottom edge, with another stacked statement beside it: “THE MORE YOU SCROLL, THE LESS YOU LIVE.” Add tiny vertical microtext near the left margin for editorial flavor. Across the bottom footer, place 4 icon/text groups: a globe icon, an eye icon, a small warning text block reading “WARNING: EXCESSIVE SCREEN TIME CAN IMPACT YOUR MENTAL HEALTH, SLEEP, AND PRODUCTIVITY.”, an expand-corners icon, a barcode, and a final statement on the far right reading “STAY PRESENT. LIVE IN REAL LIFE.” Use minimalist Swiss-grid alignment, generous negative space, sharp black typography, subtle distressed print texture, and a high-fashion poster aesthetic.
items.promptZh: 灰白色背景的鲜明黑白社论反科技海报，设计得像一本关于数字成瘾的现代野兽派杂志封面。该构图是垂直的，高度印刷，有一个中心超现实图像和多个小文本块。在顶部中心，巨大的粗体压缩无衬线文本在一行上写着“DOOM”，下面是“SCROLLING”，“SCROLLING”一词在整个页面上延伸，部分运动模糊或水平涂抹。左上角有一个小文本块，上面写着“滚动。滑动。没有任何变化。”其上方有一条短水平线。在右上角，小文字写着“24 / 7 / 365”，上面写着“THE FEED NEVER ENDS”，下面有一条水平分隔线。在标题下方的左侧，用小的编辑文字添加定义段落：“花费过多时间在网上滚动浏览负面或令人痛苦的内容的行为，通常会导致焦虑、无助和疲劳的感觉。”在其下方，包括两条短水平分隔线，然后是一个大的统计数据“67%”，后面是较小的文本：“18-24 岁的人们说他们滚动的内容比他们想要的要多。——皮尤研究中心，2023 年”。下面是另一条声明：“更多滚动。更少生活。”下面有一条分隔线。海报的中心是一部光滑的黑色智能手机，垂直放置在底部中心，从正面看，底部扬声器孔和充电端口可见。从电话屏幕中出现的是一条长长的、不可能的楼梯，向上退入一条由重复的半透明垂直面板组成的狭窄隧道，形成了一条幽闭恐怖的走廊。在隧道内，一只巨大的灰度人眼出现在上半部分，部分被雾霾、垂直切片和幻影重复遮挡，就好像被困在饲料中一样。中心图像应该感觉怪异、梦幻、压抑和电影化，具有柔和的雾气、高对比度、复印颗粒、微妙的运动涂抹和分层透明度。沿着中心图像的右侧，添加一个狭窄的垂直编号索引，其中包含 24 个可见条目：001、002、003、004、005、007、008、009、010、011、012、013、014、015、017、018、019、020、 021、022、024、025、026 和省略号，以及下方的细向下箭头。在右栏中，添加一个标题为“旨在让您着迷”的文本块。接下来是 4 句简短的台词：“无限的反馈。不可预测的奖励。无休止的比较。这不是一个小故障，而是商业模式。”在其下方放置一个简单的眼睛/地球图标，然后是一个黑色矩形框，其中包含以下消息：“意识是第一步：放下手机。向上看。收回你的时间。”在左下角，在底部边缘附近放置一个巨大的黑色文字片段，上面写着“END”，旁边还有另一个堆叠的语句：“你滚动得越多，你活得越少。”在左边距附近添加微小的垂直缩微文本，以增加编辑风格。在底部页脚上，放置 4 个图标/文本组：一个地球图标、一个眼睛图标、一个小警告文本块，上面写着“警告：过多的屏幕时间会影响您的心理健康、睡眠和生产力。”、一个展开角图标、一个条形码，以及最右侧的最终声明，上面写着“保持在场。活在现实生活中。”使用极简的瑞士网格对齐、宽大的负空间、锐利的黑色排版、微妙的仿旧印刷纹理和高级时尚海报美学。

Across the bottom footer, place 4 icon/text groups: a globe icon, an eye icon, a small warning text block reading “WARNING: EXCESSIVE SCREEN TIME CAN IMPACT YOUR MENTAL HEALTH, SLEEP, AND PRODUCTIVITY.”, an expand-corners icon, a barcode, and a final statement on the far right reading “STAY PRESENT. LIVE IN REAL LIFE.” Use minimalist Swiss-grid alignment, generous negative space, sharp black typography, subtle distressed print texture, and a high-fashion poster aesthetic.

Each thumbnail should be a cinematic nighttime outdoor billboard mockup with dramatic lighting, glossy reflections, and a person wearing a VR headset. items.title: Pastel Anime Blueberry Cake Movie Poster
items.titleZh: A dreamy pastel anime movie-poster illustration set in a narrow outdoor alley completely covered in dense floral mosaic wall art, rendered with glittering sparkles, soft haze, and romantic shoujo color grading in lavender, pink, periwinkle, and cream. In the foreground, show a cute teenage girl from a rear three-quarter view, her face mostly hidden, with short silvery-lavender bob hair and a large mauve bow hair accessory decorated with tiny flowers. She wears an oversized translucent lavender hoodie with embroidered floral appliqués on the sleeves, a layered pastel skirt, and carries a shiny lilac backpack covered with charms, ribbons, plush pom-poms, pins, and star details. She is holding a plate with a blueberry pound cake loaf that has been sliced open, and the center is dramatically overflowing with glossy dark-purple blueberry filling that pours out in thick syrupy streams down the cake and plate. Scatter whole blueberries around the cake and lower foreground. Make the scene whimsical, delicate, and slightly comedic despite the beautiful presentation. Design the image as a Japanese film poster with many decorative text overlays and laurels. Across the top, include 3 small award lines with laurel wreaths. Add a huge hand-lettered Japanese title in layered pink, white, and purple lettering with glow and sticker-like outlines reading: 「冷凍したブルーベリー使ってパウンドケーキ焼いたら中身溢れて失敗した件。」 Below it, add a smaller subtitle line: 「〜甘くて、ちょっぴり切ない青春のレシピ〜」. On the right side, place 1 vertical white quote box with Japanese text: 「うまくいかない日だって、人生のスパイスになるんだ。」 In the lower left, add 1 pinned pink note card that says “Sweet but clumsy.” and 1 torn recipe memo sheet with handwritten Japanese checklist items. Add a small speech bubble near the cake that says “Oops!”. Include a circular stamp-style seal near the lower right that reads “Blueberry disaster”. At the bottom, add film-credit style text in white, including “A FILM BY YUMEIRO PASTEL”, and a large release line in pink and white: “{argument name="release date" default="2024.6.30(SUN)"} ROADSHOW”. Under that, add the Japanese tagline: 「失敗は、最高の思い出になる。だから、また挑戦しよう。」 Frame the whole poster with lace, stickers, scraps of paper, and scrapbook-style decorations. Make it ultra-detailed, glossy, sentimental, kawaii, cinematic, and intentionally over-the-top like a fake coming-of-age movie poster about a baking failure.

items.title: Epic French Dystopian Book Cover
items.titleZh: A cinematic French dystopian science-fantasy book cover in vertical poster format, dark and epic, with a cold desaturated palette of charcoal blue, steel gray, ash white, and muted silver. In the foreground, show 1 solitary young traveler seen from behind, standing on a snow-dusted rocky cliff at lower left, small against the environment, wearing a weathered winter jacket, rugged pants, boots, and a large worn backpack, with messy light brown hair visible, posture still and contemplative as he looks out over a vast ruined city. In the middle distance, depict 1 immense circular or sprawling fortified city in a frozen valley, dense with countless dark gothic-industrial buildings and spires, surrounded by icy water channels and connected by several narrow bridges. Rising from the exact center of the city, place 1 colossal needle-like black tower that dominates the skyline, dramatically taller than everything else. Surround the city with jagged snow-covered mountain ranges on both sides and in the far distance. Above, create a stormy sky filled with heavy textured clouds, faint snowfall or drifting ice particles, and a pale backlit glow breaking through behind the central tower, giving a mythic apocalyptic atmosphere. Composition should emphasize scale, isolation, and awe, with the traveler occupying only a small portion of the image and the city and tower centered. Add distressed serif typography integrated as a cover design: at the very top in small uppercase French text, "DANS L’UNIVERS DE APRÈS L’EFFONDREMENT"; below it, a huge title in cracked weathered off-white serif capitals, "{argument name="title text" default="ELON"}", spanning nearly the full width; beneath the title place 1 small compass-star ornament centered with thin horizontal lines. At the bottom center, add the author name in refined serif capitals, "{argument name="author name" default="MARTINOLLI"}". Make the overall image look like premium dark fantasy / post-apocalyptic cover art, ultra-detailed, atmospheric perspective, realistic textures, dramatic lighting, moody, monumental, polished publishing design.
items.promptZh: 电影般的法国反乌托邦科学奇幻书籍封面，采用垂直海报格式，黑暗而史诗般，采用炭蓝色、钢灰色、灰白色和柔和银色的冷色不饱和调色板。前景中，一位孤独的年轻旅行者从后面看到，他站在左下角积雪覆盖的岩石悬崖上，在环境中显得很小，穿着一件饱经风霜的冬季夹克、粗糙的裤子、靴子和一个破旧的大背包，凌乱的浅棕色头发清晰可见，他的姿势静止而沉思，俯瞰着一座巨大的废墟城市。在中距离，描绘了一座位于冰冻山谷中的巨大圆形或蔓延的防御城市，密集地分布着无数黑暗的哥特式工业建筑和尖塔，周围环绕着冰冷的水道，并由几座狭窄的桥梁连接起来。一座巨大的针状黑色塔从城市的正中心升起，主宰着天际线，比其他一切都高得多。城市的周围和远处都是锯齿状的雪山。上方，创造出一个暴风雨般的天空，充满了厚重的纹理云、微弱的降雪或漂浮的冰粒，以及在中央塔后面突破的苍白背光光芒，营造出一种神话般的世界末日氛围。构图应强调规模、孤立和敬畏，旅行者只占据图像的一小部分，城市和塔楼居中。添加仿旧衬线字体作为封面设计：在最顶部用小写法文“DANS L’UNIVERS DE APRÈS L’EFFONDRMENT”；在它的下面，有一个巨大的标题，用破裂的、风化的灰白色衬线大写字母“{argument name =“title text”default =“ELON”}”，几乎覆盖了整个宽度；在标题下方放置 1 个小罗盘星形装饰物，以细水平线为中心。在底部中心，以精致的衬线大写字母添加作者姓名，“{argument name="author name" default="MARTINOLLI"}”。使整体图像看起来像高级黑暗幻想/后世界末日封面艺术，超详细，大气透视，逼真的纹理，戏剧性的灯光，喜怒无常，不朽，抛光的出版设计。

items.title: Gritty Córdoba Music Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic vertical poster-style mixed-media portrait with a gritty urban editorial aesthetic, designed like a concert or personal brand poster. Center a middle-aged man from the waist up, wearing a black T-shirt, standing slightly turned and raising one arm upward with his index finger pointing toward the top of the frame. His face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur block. Use a dark black and sepia color palette with distressed cream and gold accents, heavy grunge textures, ink splatters, scratched overlays, torn-paper brush marks, dust, and weathered print effects. Place a large muted gold circular halo behind his head and upper torso. In the background, create a collage of Córdoba city landmarks: a cathedral facade on the right side, a river with bridge and low skyline on the left side, all blended into the textured poster composition. Add oversized bold condensed serif typography at the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="EDU PEREYRA"}, with “EDU” in large distressed off-white letters and “PEREYRA” below in gold. Add 5 smaller text groups around the composition in uppercase handwritten or condensed styles: top left “MÚSICA PASIÓN VERDAD”, top right “DESDE ADENTRO HACIA AFUERA”, mid-right “LO QUE SE SIENTE NO NECESITA EXPLICARSE”, mid-left “AGRADECER SEGUIR CREAR”, and bottom center “TIERRA DE HISTORIA, CORAZÓN DE GENTE.” Across the lower foreground, add a huge expressive brush-script word {argument name="city name" default="cordoba"} in off-white, slightly diagonal, with a gold underline swoosh. Include 3 small symbolic graphic accents: a tiny crown icon near the upper right, a small starburst ornament near the bottom center, and a handwritten signature mark at the lower right. items.title: Japanese Visual Novel Promo Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a Japanese bishoujo game promotional poster in the style of a premium visual novel box cover and store page composite. The image is split into three vertical areas. The left two-thirds is a dramatic illustrated key visual at sunset: a dreamy spring sky filled with pink and violet clouds, glowing rim light, drifting petals, and a reflective wet road or riverside path. Show 4 anime girls in school uniforms, all with soft emotional expressions and highly detailed hair moving in the wind. The largest girl is centered upper-left, shown from the chest up in profile or three-quarter view, with long dark hair and a small flower hair ornament, looking wistful. A second girl stands at lower-left with very light silver hair and a ribbon accessory, turned slightly away. A third girl is at lower center, smaller, with mauve or reddish-brown hair and a bowed, melancholy pose. A fourth girl is at mid-right, blonde or light brown-haired, facing upward with a hopeful expression. At the very bottom center of the key art, show 2 tiny full-body silhouettes of a boy and girl holding hands in the glowing distance, reflected in the wet ground. Add a white feather near the upper-left and scattered cherry blossom petals throughout. Overlay elegant Japanese title typography in large white brush-like serif lettering near the bottom-left to center: 「{argument name="title text" default="さよならの向こう側で"}」, with a smaller subtitle line beneath it. Along the far left edge, place 3 vertical lines of small Japanese catchphrase text in white. In the bottom-left corner, add 2 stacked black product labels with white text like a PC game package badge, one reading Windows compatible and one reading all ages.

The center is a narrow dark indigo vertical band separating the art from the info panel. On this band, place the game title again vertically in large white Japanese characters, with a smaller vertical tagline beneath it. Keep this band clean and elegant, like the spine of a game box.

The right third is a soft cream-colored information panel with a gentle paper texture. At top-left of this panel, add a bold Japanese heading in brackets: 「【あらすじ】」 followed by several lines of Japanese synopsis text laid out like a visual novel description page. Below that, add a dotted or dashed divider line. Then add a second bracketed heading: 「【特徴】」 with 4 feature bullets, each preceded by a simple icon. The 4 features are: branching choices, full voice support, tearjerking emotional story, and many beautiful CGs. Use small dark blue-gray icons and text. Add another divider line, then a third bracketed heading: 「【プレイヤーへ】」 followed by 2 short lines of Japanese message text.

On the far right side of the cream panel, stack 4 rounded-rectangle screenshot thumbnails vertically, each with thin white borders. Thumbnail 1: the dark-haired heroine by a seaside railing at sunset. Thumbnail 2: a pale-haired heroine with windblown hair against a bright blue ocean. Thumbnail 3: a girl indoors by a sunlit classroom or café window, warm and contemplative. Thumbnail 4: a girl surrounded by cherry blossoms in soft pink light. At the bottom of the cream panel, place a wide rounded lavender feature bar containing 4 large icons with short Japanese labels beneath or beside them: an open book, a microphone, an image/photo symbol, and a branching path/share-like icon. The overall mood should be nostalgic, romantic, cinematic, and emotionally overwhelming, like a high-budget Japanese gal game advertisement from the 2000s to 2010s. Use polished anime illustration, luminous backlighting, rich pastel sunset colors, glossy reflections, detailed typography, and authentic visual novel promo design.

items.title: Tweet Screenshot With Handwriting Match
items.titleZh:
A realistic dark-mode social media post screenshot styled like X/Twitter on a black interface. At the top left is a small blurred circular profile photo beside the display name {argument name="profile name" default="Pratham"} with a blue verification badge, and the handle {argument name="handle" default="@Prathkum"} underneath. At the top right is a rounded white Subscribe button plus two small interface icons. The tweet text in large white sans-serif type reads: {argument name="tweet text" default="ChatGPT Images 2.0 can match your handwriting."} Below it is a side-by-side comparison image made of 2 notebook photos separated by a narrow black vertical gap. Both photos show an open lined notebook page shot from above under dim indoor lighting with soft shadows near the bottom edge. The left notebook page is mostly blank except for 2 handwritten lines in neat blue cursive at the top that say: {argument name="handwriting prompt text" default="match my hanawriting ana write a poem for me.."} Keep the misspellings and punctuation exactly as written. The right notebook page shows the same first 2 handwritten lines at the top, followed by a handwritten poem in matching blue cursive handwriting filling the page in 4 stanzas. The poem text reads exactly: {argument name="poem text" default="between the pages, quiet dreams, where ink becomes the stars, i write what my heart means, and let it heal the scars.

the world may move so fast, but here, time slows its pace. in every line i’ve made to last, i find a softer space.

some days are clouds, some days are sun, but i keep showing up. with every word, i’m not alone— my pen is my cup.

so here’s to thoughts, both big and small, to hopes, to fears, to me. i’ll keep on writing through it all, and set my spirit free."} The handwriting should look natural, slightly uneven, and convincingly human, with blue ballpoint pen texture. At the bottom left of the post, include a small sparkle icon and the words “Made with AI”. Preserve the look of a genuine mobile app screenshot with realistic spacing, rounded image corners, crisp UI typography, and subtle screen-capture softness.

逼真的暗模式社交媒体帖子屏幕截图，风格类似于黑色界面上的 X/Twitter。左上角是一张模糊的圆形个人资料照片，旁边是显示名称 {argument name="profile name" default="Pratham"}，上面有蓝色验证徽章，下面是句柄 {argument name="handle" default="@Prathkum"}。右上角是一个圆形的白色订阅按钮和两个小界面图标。大号白色无衬线字体的推文文本如下：{argument name="tweet text" default="ChatGPT Images 2.0 can match your handwriting."} 下面是一张并排比较图像，由 2 张笔记本照片组成，中间有一个狭窄的黑色垂直间隙。这两张照片都显示了在昏暗的室内灯光下从上方拍摄的开放式笔记本页面，底部边缘附近有柔和的阴影。左边的笔记本页面大部分是空白的，除了顶部有 2 行整齐的蓝色草书手写行，上面写着：{argument name="handwriting prompt text" default="match my hanawriting ana write a script for me.."} 保持拼写错误和标点符号与书面完全一致。右边的笔记本页面顶部显示了相同的前 2 行手写行，后面是一首手写诗，以匹配的蓝色草书手写体填充了 4 节页面。诗文准确地写着：{argument name="诗文" default="书页间，静梦，墨成星辰，我写下我的心意，让它治愈伤痕。

世界的脚步也许如此之快，但在这里，时间却放慢了脚步。在我所做的每一行中，我都找到了一个更柔和的空间。

有些日子是阴天，有些日子是阳光明媚，但我一直在出现。对于每一个字，我并不孤单——我的笔就是我的杯子。

所以这是我的大大小小的想法，希望，恐惧。我会继续写下去，让我的精神自由。”} 笔迹应该看起来自然，稍微不均匀，并且具有令人信服的人性化，带有蓝色圆珠笔纹理。在帖子的左下角，包括一个闪闪发光的小图标和“Made with AI”字样。保留真实移动应用程序屏幕截图的外观，具有真实的间距、圆角的图像角、清晰的 UI 排版和微妙的屏幕捕获柔和度。

items.title: Vintage Japanese Crime Film Poster
items.titleZh: A vintage late-1970s Japanese crime film poster in the style of a Nikkatsu theatrical one-sheet, vertically composed on aged beige paper with visible grain, faint stains, and slightly faded ink. The main image is a large, moody half-body portrait of {argument name="lead actor name" default="原田芳雄"} occupying the upper right and center, turned partly away from camera, with thick curly dark hair, a serious expression, and a wrinkled light gray suit jacket over an open-collar white shirt; his face is mostly in shadow. Behind him is a bleak industrial waterfront with cranes, low factory structures, and heavy gray smoke rising into a washed-out sky. Across the lower middle, place a huge hand-brushed red Japanese title reading {argument name="title text" default="影の街"}, painted diagonally and aggressively, partially overlapping the portrait and the lower scene. In the lower half, add a second scene: a rainy urban street at dusk or night with wet reflective pavement, a dark police car at left with a glowing red roof light, and 6 men in suits and trench coats walking forward, with 1 central detective figure in a beige trench coat and loosened tie leading the group. On the far right, include a vertical strip of 5 stacked inset cast portraits framed in thin borders, each a dark cinematic still with different characters. Add vertical Japanese typography: on the upper right, the actor credit “原田芳雄 主演”; on the upper left, a 2-line tagline column reading “その男、刑事。 正義より、真実を追う。”; and near the lower right of the main image, another vertical blurb reading “誰が敵で、誰が味方か。闇に消えた事件の中で、ただひとつの真実を掴むまで—”. At the bottom, include dense small Japanese credits spanning the width, plus a large release date on the lower right reading {argument name="release date" default="11.23"} with “日活ロードショー” beneath it and a small studio mark. Use muted charcoal, sepia, smoky blue-gray, and off-white tones, with the red title as the only vivid color. The overall feeling is hard-boiled, melancholic, gritty, and cinematic, like a lost 1970s Japanese detective movie poster.

items.title: Vintage Red Propaganda Fight Poster
items.titleZh: A bold vintage propaganda-style poster with a limited red, black, and cream palette, printed on slightly textured aged paper. The composition shows 2 women in a dramatic action scene across the center: on the left, a woman with long wavy red hair in a white martial arts gi performs a very high side kick; on the right, a curvy woman in a black cowboy hat and a black lace bodysuit recoils and raises her arms defensively as the kick strikes her face. Use heavy black shadows, sharp angular shapes, screenprint-like ink coverage, and a graphic mid-century pulp poster aesthetic. Behind them, place a large diagonal red geometric banner spanning from upper left to lower right, plus 2 black speed lines on the left and 3 white speed lines on the right to emphasize motion. In the upper right corner, include a circular emblem with a stylized black-and-white screaming monkey or ape face inside a red disk. At the bottom, add oversized condensed block typography in an aggressive poster layout: the first line reads {argument name="headline text" default="SCOTTISH RECIPE:"} in red and black, and the second line reads {argument name="main title" default="MINCE AND TATTIES"} in very large red, white, and black letters over a black diagonal banner. Keep the overall look satirical, confrontational, retro, and highly graphic, like a fake exploitation movie poster or anarchic punk zine cover.

items.titleZh: A luxury futuristic skincare advertisement in a vertical 4K poster format, centered on a sleek matte-white spray bottle floating diagonally in the middle of the frame, slightly tilted to the right, with a soft cylindrical cap and fine condensation droplets across the upper body. The bottle label reads "{argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"}" in clean navy sans-serif text, and below it: "{argument name="product name" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}" with smaller subtext "for risk-free connections" and "pour des connexions sans risque," plus tiny footer text "75 mL / 2.5 fl. oz. - Data Stream Purifier." Behind the bottle, enormous translucent serif typography fills most of the background, reading "{argument name="headline text" default="ULTRA-SECURE"}", split across two lines and partially obscured by the product. The environment is deep midnight blue with glowing translucent fabric-like liquid ribbons curling around the bottle from top left to bottom right and from the lower foreground upward, mixed with 2 prominent glassy tubular arcs and multiple floating crystal-like droplets or bubbles. Lighting is cold, cinematic, glossy, and high-end, with luminous icy blue highlights, soft bloom, refractive reflections, and a pristine premium beauty-campaign look. At the bottom center, elegant spaced-out small caps text reads "{argument name="tagline" default="ENCRYPTED BARRIER FORMULA"}". Beneath that is a row of 4 ingredient callouts separated evenly across the width: 1) "CERAMIDE IP-07" with two lines "Strengthens" and "Lipid Defence"; 2) "SQUALANE ENCAPSULES" with "Reinforces" and "Moisture Lock"; 3) "NIACINAMIDE 5%" with "Calms Visible" and "Stress Signals"; 4) "HYALURONIC STACK" with "Multi-Layer" and "Hydration Matrix". At the very bottom center, add a small shield icon and the words "DEFEND. PURIFY. PROTECT." The overall style should blend luxury skincare product photography with cyber-security branding, ultra-polished commercial lighting, shallow depth of field, premium editorial composition, and production-ready ad design.

items.titleZh: A photorealistic top-down product-style photograph of a single luxury tasting menu printed on bright white textured paper and placed on a dark walnut wooden tabletop, with soft warm ambient lighting and gentle natural shadows. The sheet is portrait orientation, slightly rotated clockwise, occupying most of the frame with clean margins around it. The design is an ultra-minimal fine-dining menu with elegant editorial typography, lots of negative space, precise alignment, and a refined black-and-dark-gray ink palette. At the upper left, the restaurant identity appears in 3 stacked lines: a large serif word {argument name="restaurant name" default="Silence"}, below it 2 Chinese characters "沈默", and below that a large serif French line "Le Silence". Under the title is a small location line reading "Ginza, Tokyo B3F". At the upper right is a small date line in French followed by Japanese date text: {argument name="date text" default="22 Avril 2026 • 令和八年四月二十二日"}. The main body is organized into 3 vertical content zones: a left numbered course list, a middle translated course list, and a far-right icon column. The left list contains exactly 9 numbered courses labeled 1 through 9, each with French title and Japanese subtitle and an English ingredient line beneath; the 9 visible course titles are: "Huître de Bretagne, eau de mer", "Daurade de Kyoto, pétale de sakura", "Oursin d’Hokkaidō, consommé d’algue", "Asperge de Nemuro, sauce mousseline", "Homard de Miyako, bisque légère", "Canard de Challans, figue et balsamique", "Boeuf de Kagoshima, truffe noire", "Fromage de chèvre, miel du Japon", and "Agrume, thé vert et gin". The middle list repeats the 9 dishes in a second compact column with French titles and Japanese descriptions. The far-right column contains exactly 9 horizontal icon rows aligned to the courses, each row showing small monochrome hand-drawn ingredient or allergen pictograms; some rows have 2 icons and some 3, for a total of 19 icons overall. Near the lower left is a section titled "Le mot du chef" followed by a short French paragraph in small serif text. items.title: Surreal Wind, Sand and Stars Book World
items.titleZh: A poetic, cinematic macro illustration of the cover of {argument name="book title" default="Wind, Sand and Stars"} by {argument name="author name" default="Antoine de Saint-Exupéry"}, rendered as a surreal desert world emerging directly from the textured paper page. A large human hand holds a glossy black and gold fountain pen near the top right, the engraved gold nib touching the paper and releasing a dark stream of ink that becomes a winding path across a miniature Sahara landscape. The composition is vertical, warmly lit in amber and sepia tones, with dramatic side lighting, deep shadows, and ultra-detailed paper grain, skin texture, dust, and metallic reflections. On the upper left, the printed title text appears in elegant serif typography, with the author name below it and a short italic quote in smaller script beneath. The page transforms into a detailed map-like desert tableau with exactly 16 tiny human figures scattered across the scene: 1 lone standing figure balanced beside the pen nib, 3 figures near a small campfire, 2 central robed men in conversation, 3 figures gathered beside the biplane, 1 solitary figure walking near the lower middle, 2 riders on camels at the lower left, 3 standing figures near the truck at the lower right, and 1 tiny seated figure near the wreckage at the lower left. Include exactly 1 vintage biplane parked on the right with visible markings, exactly 1 old expedition truck at the bottom right, exactly 1 windsock near the center-right, exactly 1 desert oasis town with palm trees on the right, exactly 1 ruined sandcastle-like mound on the left, exactly 1 dark tent encampment on the left-center, exactly 1 wrecked engine or fuselage fragment in the lower left corner, and exactly 1 compass rose printed at the bottom left. items.title: Luxury Publishing Branding Editorial Spread
items.titleZh: Create a luxurious Japanese magazine-style PR editorial spread for a publishing and branding service, designed as a two-page brochure layout. The left half is a dark, cinematic portrait scene in a sophisticated office lounge: a seated Japanese businessman in a navy bespoke suit, white shirt, dark tie, white pocket square, and wristwatch sits in a leather chair with one hand near his chin, posed thoughtfully beside a glossy wooden table. His face is intentionally obscured with a soft rectangular blur. The lighting is moody and warm, with reflections from tall windows and a premium executive atmosphere. On this dark left page, place large elegant serif headline text in English reading {argument name="headline text" default="PUBLISHING BRANDING"}, stacked in two lines near the upper left in muted gold. Below it, add multiple lines of Japanese copy in white, including a larger subheadline and several short body paragraphs arranged vertically. Near the lower left, include a bordered dark box containing exactly 4 checklist items, each preceded by a check mark, with Japanese text. Put a small page number "02" in the bottom-left corner. The right half is a clean white editorial information page with refined minimalist typography and generous spacing. At the top, place a large Japanese headline in black, aligned upper center-right, with two short Japanese body text blocks beneath it; on the upper far right include a small photo of exactly 4 stacked hardcover books and a glass vase near a bright window with greenery. Across the middle, add a centered section title in Japanese for five benefits, followed by exactly 5 numbered columns labeled 1 through 5, each with a short Japanese heading and several lines of smaller explanatory Japanese text. Beneath that, add another centered Japanese section title for workflow, followed by exactly 4 step blocks laid out horizontally: STEP 01 with a speech bubble icon, STEP 02 with a pencil icon, STEP 03 with an open book icon, STEP 04 with a megaphone icon. Each step includes the English word STEP plus a two-digit number, a short Japanese subtitle, and a few lines of smaller Japanese description, with small chevrons between steps. Along the bottom of the right page, place exactly 3 rectangular photos side by side: a city-view office meeting table scene, a close-up of a hand writing with a pen, and a stack of books near an open book. Under these images, add a prominent Japanese closing statement in a serif style on the lower left, and a smaller Japanese paragraph on the lower right. Put page number "03" in the bottom-right corner. Use a premium palette of deep navy, black, warm brown, ivory, and muted gold, with a balance of editorial luxury, corporate trust, and high-end publishing aesthetics. The overall composition should feel like a real magazine advertisement or consulting brochure, polished, photorealistic, elegant, and credible.
items.promptZh: 为出版和品牌服务创建豪华的日本杂志风格的公关编辑跨页，设计为两页小册子布局。左半部分是一个在精致的办公室休息室里的黑暗的电影肖像场景：一位坐着的日本商人穿着海军定制西装、白衬衫、深色领带、白色口袋巾和手表，坐在皮椅上，一只手靠近下巴，在一张光滑的木桌旁边若有所思地摆着姿势。他的脸被故意用柔和的矩形模糊遮挡。灯光柔和而温暖，高大的窗户反射着光线，营造出高级的行政氛围。在这个深色的左侧页面上，放置大型优雅的衬线英文标题文本：{argument name="headline text" default="PUBLISHING BRANDING"}，在左上方附近以柔和的金色堆叠成两行。在其下方，添加多行白色日文文案，包括一个较大的副标题和几个垂直排列的短正文段落。在左下角附近，有一个带边框的黑框，其中正好包含 4 个清单项目，每个项目前面都有一个复选标记，并带有日语文本。在左下角放置一个小页码“02”。右半部分是一个干净的白色编辑信息页面，具有精致的简约排版和宽敞的间距。在顶部，放置一个黑色的日文大标题，右上方对齐，下面有两个简短的日文正文文本块；最右上方有一张小照片，上面有四本堆放的精装书和一个玻璃花瓶，靠近一扇绿树成荫的明亮窗户。在中间，添加一个居中的日语部分标题，以表示五个好处，然后是 5 个编号的列，标记为 1 到 5，每个列都有一个简短的日语标题和几行较小的解释性日语文本。在其下方，为工作流程添加另一个居中的日语部分标题，然后是水平布局的 4 个步骤块：带有语音气泡图标的步骤 01、带有铅笔图标的步骤 02、带有打开的书本图标的步骤 03、带有扩音器图标的步骤 04。每个步骤都包含英文单词 STEP 加上一个两位数的数字、一个简短的日语字幕和几行较小的日语描述，步骤之间有小 V 形符号。沿着右页底部，并排放置 3 张长方形照片：城市景观办公室会议桌场景、用笔写字的手部特写以及一本打开的书旁边的一摞书。在这些图像下，在左下角添加一个突出的日语衬线风格结束语，并在右下角添加一个较小的日语段落。将页码“03”放在右下角。使用深海军蓝、黑色、暖棕色、象牙色和柔和的金色等高级调色板，在编辑奢华、企业信任和高端出版美学之间取得平衡。整体构图应该感觉像真正的杂志广告或咨询手册，精美、逼真、优雅且可信。

Around it, build a torn-paper photomontage from 4 visible collage zones: on the left, a red paper field with a black-and-white cutout of a person in a dark coat seen from behind or in profile, next to fragments of French poster text; at the top behind the central rectangle, a partial black-and-white face or head fragment peeking out; on the right, a blue paper field with a black-and-white Paris-like street scene including 1 tall ornate lamppost, old buildings, 1 car, and 1 walking man; at the bottom center, a yellow torn-paper field with a cropped black-and-white figure holding a newspaper, wearing a striped shirt. items.title: Seaside Cafe Event Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a lively Chinese event poster with a warm, trendy coffee-shop aesthetic, photographed from inside a seaside cafe looking out through large floor-to-ceiling windows at palm trees, a bright blue sky, outdoor seating, and a Ferris wheel in the distance. The composition should feel like a candid lifestyle scene combined with energetic graphic design. In the foreground, place a dark wooden table with 1 open laptop centered near the bottom, 1 takeaway coffee cup with a black lid on the right side of the table, 1 black bag on the left, and 1 short stack of books near the left edge. Use a sunlit, slightly golden afternoon atmosphere with reflections on the glass and a relaxed vacation vibe.

items.title: Anime Mecha Pilot Poster
items.titleZh: Create a dramatic anime sci-fi poster of {argument name="character name" default="Puru Two"}, inspired by a cyber-newtype pilot from a mecha war setting. The composition is a vertically oriented character key visual with one central full-body female figure in a sleek red and black pilot bodysuit, shown standing confidently in a slightly low-angle pose. She has short layered orange hair with long side bangs, pale skin, and a serious, emotionally distant expression. Her suit is glossy crimson with black side panels, a high collar, fitted seams, a front zipper line, dark gloves, a utility belt, and military insignia on the shoulders and chest. The background is a dark, space-like abstract field with black, crimson, magenta, and scattered star-like textures, splattered energy effects, and a gritty futuristic propaganda-poster mood. Surround the central figure with 3 inset panels: a top-right close-up of her eyes and upper face reflected through a transparent cockpit or HUD glass with red interface lights and small technical readouts, a mid-right soft pale portrait of a ghostly young girl in a loose white gown against a luminous misty white-gray background, and a bottom-right close-up of 1 gloved hand gripping a mechanical control lever with illuminated cockpit instrumentation. Add dense graphic design elements and typography throughout the left and right edges, combining elegant serif English text, Japanese vertical title text, compact technical labels, and mecha specification blocks. Include visible text such as the large title "PURU TWO", "NEO ZEON", "CYBER-NEWTYPE", "MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM ZZ", "PSYCHO GUNDAM MK-II", percentage/status readouts like "99.8%", and other small control-panel annotations. Use a high-detail painted anime illustration style, cinematic red lighting, glossy fabric highlights, sharp linework, subtle screen reflections, layered UI overlays, and a premium poster layout reminiscent of a luxury sci-fi character dossier.
items.promptZh: 创作一张戏剧性的动漫科幻海报 {argument name="character name" default="Puru Two"}，灵感来自于机甲战争场景中的网络新型飞行员。该构图是一个垂直方向的角色关键视觉，其中一个中央全身女性人物穿着时尚的红黑飞行员连体衣，以略低角度的姿势自信地站立。她有一头橙色的分层短发，侧边的刘海很长，皮肤苍白，表情严肃，情感上疏远。她的套装是有光泽的深红色，侧幅为黑色，高领，合身接缝，前拉链，深色手套，实用腰带，肩膀和胸部有军事徽章。背景是一个黑暗的、类似太空的抽象场，有黑色、深红色、洋红色和分散的星状纹理，飞溅的能量效果，以及坚韧的未来派宣传海报情绪。中心人物周围有 3 个镶嵌面板：右上特写是她的眼睛和上脸，通过透明驾驶舱或 HUD 玻璃反射，带有红色界面灯和小型技术读数；中右是一个幽灵般的年轻女孩的柔和苍白肖像，穿着宽松的白色长袍，背景是发光的雾蒙蒙的白灰色背景；右下特写是一只戴着手套的手握着机械控制杆，驾驶舱仪表带有发光装置。在左右边缘添加密集的图形设计元素和版式，结合优雅的衬线英文文本、日文垂直标题文本、紧凑的技术标签和机甲规格块。包括可见文本，例如大标题“PURU TWO”、“NEO ZEON”、“CYBER-NEWTYPE”、“MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM ZZ”、“PSYCHO GUNDAM MK-II”、百分比/状态读数（例如“99.8%”）以及其他小型控制面板注释。使用高细节的动画插画风格、电影般的红色灯光、光泽的织物亮点、清晰的线条、微妙的屏幕反射、分层的 UI 覆盖以及让人想起豪华科幻人物档案的高级海报布局。

items.title: Cute Japanese Romcom Movie Poster
items.titleZh: A flashy Japanese romantic comedy movie poster in a cute-but-dramatic pop anime mascot style, designed like a theatrical film teaser. Center the composition on a full-body cartoon bunny girl mascot named {argument name="character name" default="パン子"}, with a large white face, black body and one black ear, one bright red ear, thick black outline, half-lidded glamorous eyes with long lashes, pink blush circles on her cheeks, a tiny red nose, a small tongue peeking out, and a pink bow with white polka dots on top of her head. She wears a sleeveless pink dress with white polka dots and a black scarf-like neck detail, posing with one hand near her cheek in a confident, slightly flirty stance. The background is a dreamy sunset waterfront city skyline with golden reflections on the water, pastel pink-orange-blue sky, sparkles, soft bokeh, and a ferris wheel on the left. Place 2 male silhouette figures in the midground, one on the left standing casually and one on the right in a suit-like pose, suggesting potential love interests. Add lush tropical flowers and leaves around the borders, especially pink hibiscus blossoms in the corners, plus floating hearts and glitter effects throughout. Use a bold, layered Japanese poster layout packed with decorative typography and stickers. At the top, handwritten-style Japanese text reads: 「笑って、泣いて、恋をして。アラサーの私、まだまだ諦めない！」 with pink emphasis and doodled heart lines. On the upper left, include a bright pink scalloped badge that says 「2026年 夏公開」. Along the right side, place vertical Japanese text: 「私の幸せ、探しにいきます。」. Near the lower left, add a pink ribbon label reading 「劇場版！」. Across the bottom center, create the large main title in bold decorative Japanese lettering: 「アラサー パン子の 婚活奮闘記」 with pink and dark navy text, white outlines, and a cute heart accent. Beneath it, add a pink slogan banner with yellow-highlighted text: 「恋に迷って、人生はもっとキラキラする♥」. Include small faux credits at the bottom in Japanese film-poster style. Around the lower area, place 4 small polaroid-style inset snapshots of the bunny character: 2 on the lower left and 2 on the lower right, each showing different cute situations such as a close-up pose, sitting at a cafe table, wearing sunglasses, or posing outdoors. Add a small notebook page labeled "Today's Mission" with checklist hearts in the lower left, and a plastic iced drink cup with straw plus sunglasses in the lower right. Overall feeling: feminine, comedic, inspirational, sparkly, over-the-top, and nostalgic, like a parody of a live-action romance film poster starring a mascot heroine. Use vivid pinks, peach sunset tones, sky blue, white, and navy, with glossy highlights and a polished promotional-poster finish.

items.title: Tweet Screenshot of QR Code Dice Demo
items.titleZh: A realistic dark-mode social media screenshot of a tweet viewed on a desktop interface. At the top left is a circular profile photo and the display name Riley Goodside with a blue verification badge, followed by the handle @goodside and the timestamp 10h. The tweet text reads: "ChatGPT Images 2.0 generates a game die but instead of numbers it has working QR codes for each of their Wikipedia articles". Beneath the tweet is a large embedded image with 2 side-by-side panels inside a rounded rectangle. The left panel shows a glossy white six-sided die resting on a warm brown wooden tabletop, photographed at a slight angle, with 3 visible faces, and each visible face contains a different black QR code instead of pips; the lighting is soft and realistic with subtle reflections on the die’s rounded edges. Above the die image is a dark UI header area with a small line of text reading "Thought for 1m 43s" and a cropped speech-bubble-like overlay near the top that says "for the corresponding Wikipedia article for its number." The right panel is a mobile-style Wikipedia page screenshot for the number 1, with a white background and thin gray borders, showing the tabs "Article" and "Talk" at the top, small interface icons, and article text beginning with "This article is about the number. For the year AD 1, and other uses, see One (disambiguation) and Number One (disambiguation)" followed by a boxed notice about special characters and the bold opening line "1 (one, unit, unity) is a number, numeral, and grapheme." The social media interface around the embedded image uses a nearly black background with standard reply, repost, like, analytics, bookmark, and share icons along the bottom, with visible counts of 45 replies, 157 reposts, 3.5K likes, and 191K views. Crisp UI typography, authentic desktop X/Twitter layout, realistic screenshot style, high legibility, subtle compression and screen-capture appearance.
items.promptZh: 在桌面界面上查看的推文的真实暗模式社交媒体屏幕截图。左上角是一张圆形个人资料照片和带有蓝色验证徽章的显示名称 Riley Goodside，后面是句柄 @goodside 和时间戳 10h。推文中写道：“ChatGPT Images 2.0 生成了一个游戏骰子，但它没有为每个维基百科文章提供有效的二维码，而不是数字”。推文下方是一个大的嵌入式图像，圆角矩形内有 2 个并排的面板。左图显示了一个光滑的白色六面骰子放在暖棕色的木质桌面上，以微小的角度拍摄，有 3 个可见的面，每个可见的面都包含一个不同的黑色 QR 码而不是点；灯光柔和而真实，在模具的圆形边缘上有微妙的反射。骰子图像上方是一个黑色的 UI 标题区域，其中有一小行文本，上面写着“Thought for 1m 43s”，顶部附近有一个裁剪后的类似语音气泡的覆盖层，上面写着“对应的维基百科文章的编号”。右侧面板是数字 1 的移动式维基百科页面屏幕截图，具有白色背景和细灰色边框，顶部显示“文章”和“讨论”选项卡、小界面图标以及以“本文是关于数字的。对于公元 1 年和其他用途，请参阅“一（消歧义）”和“数字一（消歧义）”开头的文章文本，后面是有关特殊字符的盒装通知和粗体开头行“1（一、单位、统一）是数字、数词和字素。”嵌入图像周围的社交媒体界面使用近乎黑色的背景，底部带有标准回复、转发、点赞、分析、书签和共享图标，可见计数为 45 条回复、157 次转发、3.5K 点赞和 191K 次浏览。清晰的 UI 排版、真实的桌面 X/Twitter 布局、逼真的屏幕截图风格、高易读性、微妙的压缩和屏幕捕获外观。

items.title: Celestial Dynasty World Bible Board
items.titleZh: Using REFERENCE_0 as the visual foundation, expand the single sky-palace scene into a complete cinematic world-building presentation for a fantasy civilization. Preserve the same East Asian celestial imperial design language, floating architecture above clouds, gilded ornamentation, warm sunset lighting, and ultra-detailed realistic concept-art look, then turn it into a polished multi-panel lore board on a dark background with elegant editorial typography. Include 8 labeled sections: 1 large hero overview panel for the civilization, 1 architecture section with 9 images, 1 characters section with 7 full-body character designs, 1 clothing and armor section with 6 outfit variations, 1 vehicles and transport section with 4 vehicle designs, 1 world map section with 1 illustrated map, 1 environments section with 6 environment images, and 1 culture and details section with 6 close-up detail images. Add a refined fantasy title and short lore paragraph for the civilization, using the name {argument name="civilization name" default="Celestial Dynasty"}. The architecture section should show 9 distinct items: palace, temple, gate, pillar, bridge, throne hall, garden, library, and observatory. The characters section should show 7 archetypes: emperor, empress, high priest, general, royal guard, scholar, and artisan. The clothing and armor section should show 6 designs: ceremonial robe, battle armor, noble attire, priest robes, artisan garments, and dancer costume. The vehicles and transport section should show 4 designs: an airship, a flying beast mount, a sky chariot, and a ceremonial palanquin. The environments section should show 6 scenes: one wide banner panorama plus 5 smaller locations, including forest, mountain peaks, lotus valley, golden fields, and a celestial port. The culture and details section should show 6 images: dragon motif, lantern or artifact, palace interior, scholarly scene, mechanical instruments, and decorative symbols. Keep all panels visually unified as if from one official franchise world bible, with extremely rich detail, believable material design, and cinematic realism.

items.title: Sunlit Streetwear Jacket Portrait
items.titleZh: A realistic lifestyle fashion photo of a woman standing indoors in a warm, sunlit modern loft living room, framed from mid-thigh up, facing the camera with her hands tucked into the pockets of an oversized black satin varsity-style bomber jacket. The jacket is the clear focus: glossy black fabric, ribbed collar and hem, snap-button front, slightly puffed sleeves, and large collegiate lettering across the chest that reads {argument name="front text" default="NEW YORK"} in bold orange letters with white outlines. Add a smaller orange-and-white sports patch on the upper sleeve and white block text on the opposite sleeve for an authentic team-jacket feel. Style the model with long, loose, softly wavy balayage hair in {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown with caramel highlights"}, minimal jewelry including layered gold necklaces, and light gray sweatpants visible at the bottom of frame. Keep the face intentionally obscured with a centered rectangular blur block for privacy. The setting is a minimalist beige interior with tall industrial windows on the left casting strong morning sunlight and geometric shadows, a cream sofa with a pillow, a low coffee table with 3 stacked books and a dark bowl, pale walls, and a simple wooden side table in the background. Shoot in a high-end editorial e-commerce style with natural golden light, soft shadows, sharp jacket detail, shallow depth of field, neutral warm tones, and a clean premium streetwear aesthetic.
items.promptZh: 一张逼真的生活方式时尚照片，照片中一位女士站在温暖、阳光明媚的现代阁楼客厅里，从大腿中部向上取景，面对镜头，双手插在一件超大黑色缎面大学风格飞行员夹克的口袋里。这件夹克是明显的焦点：光滑的黑色面料，罗纹衣​​领和下摆，按扣前襟，略微蓬松的袖子，胸前有大号大学字母，上面写着{argument name="front text" default="NEW YORK"}，用粗体橙色字母和白色轮廓。在上袖上添加较小的橙白色运动贴片，并在另一袖上添加白色块文字，营造真正的团队夹克感觉。为模特设计一头长长的、宽松的、柔软的波浪状平衡发，头发颜色为{argument name="hair color" default="dark Brown with caramelhighlight"}，佩戴简约的珠宝，包括分层的金项链，以及在框架底部可见的浅灰色运动裤。为了保护隐私，用居中的矩形模糊块故意遮挡脸部。环境是简约的米色内饰，左边高大的工业窗户投射出强烈的早晨阳光和几何阴影，一张带枕头的奶油色沙发，一张低矮的咖啡桌，上面放着三本书和一个深色的碗，苍白的墙壁，背景是一张简单的木制边桌。以高端编辑电子商务风格拍摄，具有自然的金色光线、柔和的阴影、锐利的夹克细节、浅景深、中性暖色调和干净的高级街头服饰美学。

items.title: Absurd Purple Mofumofu Pachinko Machine
items.titleZh: A hyper-detailed Japanese pachinko machine front view designed as a surreal contemporary-art parody, glossy black and metallic purple body with intense magenta-violet LED illumination, sparkling chrome trim, jewel-like plastic molding, and multiple pink paw-print emblems embedded throughout the frame. The central display features a dramatic middle-aged Japanese woman with short curly auburn-brown hair, wearing a dark kimono, pointing directly toward the viewer in a confrontational heroic pose against a cosmic purple lightning-and-nebula background. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur, and 3 additional smaller portraits of the same woman also appear around the machine with the same blurred-face treatment, for a total of 4 blurred human portraits. Include 3 plush panda heads tucked into the machine layout along the left and right sides. At the very top, large glittering title text reads "CR 岡安モフモフ" with a smaller subtitle beneath it reading "もふもふは、正義。" On the left of the center screen, add the phrase "今日もモフって生きていく。" Across the woman’s chest area, place a black brushstroke label with gold lettering reading "岡安モフセフ". On the right side, create a bright bonus panel with a paw icon and the words "モフモフ RUSH". Near the lower center, add a circular button-like emblem reading "モフモフ CHANCE". At the bottom center, create a large glowing control button labeled "モフモフ" with a pink paw icon. In the lower right display area, add a smaller inset image of the same pointing woman and handwritten-style text reading "もふるか もふられるか…" The overall mood should feel absurd, gaudy, overdesigned, kitschy, and funny, like a fake pachinko machine celebrating fluffy animals and melodramatic spectacle, rendered as a high-resolution product-style front-facing photograph with sharp reflections, saturated purple highlights, and dense decorative detail.

items.title: Japanese Law & Tax Services LP Hero
items.titleZh: Create a polished Japanese landing-page hero banner for a fictional combined law firm and tax accountant office, with a clean corporate style, high trust, soft daylight, and a white background with faint modern city buildings on the far right. Use a wide horizontal web header layout. At the very top, place a large navy Japanese headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="あなたの『不安』に、確かな専門力で寄り添います。"}, and beneath it a smaller gold-accented Japanese subheadline reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="法律 × 税務のワンストップサポートで、最善の解決へ"}. Below the headline, arrange 4 equal vertical service cards side by side across the center. Card 1 is for criminal defense, with a circular icon showing handcuffs at the top, a cool blue color scheme, the large title "刑事事件", supporting copy "迅速な対応で、あなたの未来を守ります", a photo of a suited male professional seated with hands clasped across a desk, and a dark blue bottom band listing exactly 2 bullet lines with checkmarks: "逮捕・勾留対応" and "示談交渉・不起訴の獲得". Card 2 is for traffic accidents, with a circular icon showing a car crash at the top, a green color scheme, the title "交通事故", supporting copy "適正な補償を受けられるよう、全力でサポートします", a bright desk scene with 2 miniature cars colliding on documents, and a dark green bottom band listing exactly 2 bullet lines: "後遺障害・慰謝料の増額" and "保険会社との交渉代行". Card 3 is for inheritance tax, with a circular icon showing a house at the top, a warm gold color scheme, the title "相続税", supporting copy "円満な相続と、最適な税務対策をサポート", a tabletop scene with a model house, papers, and a calculator, and a mustard-gold bottom band listing exactly 2 bullet lines: "相続税の申告・節税対策" and "生前対策・事業承継支援". Card 4 is for divorce, with a circular icon showing a broken heart at the top, a rose-pink color scheme, the title "離婚", supporting copy "あなたの未来のために、納得できる解決を目指します", a soft professional consultation scene with a woman in a white blouse resting her hand near her chin while speaking across a desk, and a dusty-rose bottom band listing exactly 2 bullet lines: "親権・養育費・財産分与" and "離婚協議・調停・裁判対応". In the bottom area, add the firm identity on the left in Japanese: a small line "法律事務所・税理士事務所", a large firm name {argument name="firm name" default="架空総合法律税務事務所"}, and a smaller line "弁護士・税理士が連携するワンストップサービス". In the lower center, place 3 compact white feature boxes with navy line icons and short Japanese text: box 1 shows a group-of-people icon and says "各分野の専門家が対応", box 2 shows a handshake icon and says "相談者様に寄り添う親身なサポート", box 3 shows a document icon and says "初回相談60分無料". Add a small disclaimer beneath them: "※ご相談の内容によっては有料となる場合がございます。" On the lower right, create a prominent navy call-to-action panel with rounded corners. Include a small Japanese line "まずはお気軽にご相談ください", a large white phone number with phone icon {argument name="phone number" default="03-1234-5678"}, and a gold pill-shaped strip at the bottom reading {argument name="business hours" default="平日 9:00〜18:00（土日祝は事前予約で対応可）"}. Use refined Japanese Mincho-style typography for major headings, crisp spacing, balanced margins, subtle shadows, and premium legal-professional branding.

items.title: Japanese Legal Presentation Cover Slide
items.titleZh: Create a clean, modern Japanese presentation cover slide in a minimalist editorial style, landscape 16:9. Use a very light gray background with bold black typography and vivid yellow accent bars. The layout is asymmetrical and high contrast, with lots of negative space. Place a small black square near the upper left containing the white text "01" in italic bold sans serif. Across the center, set a large Japanese title in heavy black type on 2 lines: "司法書士等による" on the first line and "特別委任方式" on the second line, with the second line much larger and sitting on a rough hand-painted yellow highlight stroke. Below it, add a smaller Japanese subtitle in black: "登記原因証明情報の新しい取扱い". Under the subtitle, place a thin horizontal black line centered. Along the far right edge, add a tall vertical yellow sidebar with black vertical text reading "01 表紙". Near the top right, place 1 small black square as a decorative element. In the lower right quadrant, place a decorative 5 by 5 dotted grid made of 25 small black dots. On the far left edge, crop in oversized black Japanese characters so they are only partially visible, creating a strong graphic border effect. At the bottom left, place a single line of small black Japanese text: "令和7年12月9日　法務省民二第1578号　依命通知". At the bottom right, place 2 lines of small black Japanese text, right aligned: first line "司法書士事務所アンドロー・デザインワークショップ", second line "司法書士　浅野勇貴". Add a thin diagonal black line entering from the top left corner as another graphic accent. Overall feel: premium business presentation, legal seminar title slide, Swiss-inspired grid composition, bold Japanese typography, sharp and print-like.

On the far left edge, crop in oversized black Japanese characters so they are only partially visible, creating a strong graphic border effect. At the bottom left, place a single line of small black Japanese text: "令和7年12月9日　法務省民二第1578号　依命通知". In the center, a small doll-like girl is shown from behind, with long silky blonde hair and a white bow headband, wearing a pastel blue pinafore dress over a pink puff-sleeve blouse with white trim. She gently reaches up to touch the mouth of a large white rabbit character standing in front of her. The rabbit has oversized upright ears, glossy black eyes, rosy cheeks, and a cute plush-like face, and wears a light blue uniform-style jacket with a tiny gold badge over a white body. Surround them with dense greenery, daisies, and abundant pink blossoms in the foreground and background. items.title: Epic FC Barcelona Heritage Poster
items.titleZh: Create a dramatic vertical football tribute poster in a dark cinematic mixed-media style, combining fine-art portraiture, sports branding, textured grunge painting, and premium editorial typography. The central subject is a waist-up portrait of {argument name="historical figure" default="Rabindranath Tagore"} reimagined as an FC Barcelona icon, facing slightly to the right, with long wavy silver-gray hair, a long flowing beard, aged features, and a calm legendary presence. Dress him in a classic FC Barcelona home jersey with deep red and navy vertical stripes, visible Nike swoosh on the left side, and the FCB crest on the chest. Use moody rim lighting and painterly highlights around the hair and shoulders so the figure feels monumental and almost divine. Set the background as an abstract brush-texture composition in Barcelona colors, dark indigo, crimson, burgundy, and muted gold, with 3 major graphic elements behind the portrait: a large faded FC Barcelona crest near the top center, a vertical block of handwritten Bengali manuscript text on the left side, and a large gold handwritten signature-style script running vertically on the right. At the top left, place 5 lines of elegant serif text: the first line reads "RABINDRANATH", the second much larger line reads "TAGORE", the third line reads "1861-1941", the fourth line is the quote "Where the mind is without fear and the head is held high...", and the fifth line is a cursive signature reading "Rabindranath Tagore". In the middle-lower area, add 5 centered text lines in a refined poster layout: "MORE THAN A POET.", then a large gold handwritten line reading "A timeless spirit.", then "A {argument name="club nickname" default="CULER"} FOREVER.", then a thin horizontal red-and-blue accent line, and then a small centered FCB crest beneath it. At the bottom, show a wide view of Camp Nou at dusk with glowing stadium lights and a dramatic sunset horizon, packed stands, and a giant crowd mosaic reading exactly {argument name="stadium slogan" default="MES QUE UN CLUB"}. In the foreground place 1 football centered on the wet reflective pitch with the Barcelona crest visible on the ball. The entire image should feel like a luxury fan-made heritage poster, ultra-detailed, painterly, emotional, reverential, high contrast, textured, epic, and suitable for a premium social media football graphic or wall poster. Use a tall 2:3 poster composition with layered depth, subtle sparks, paint streaks, and gold accents. Optionally replace the visible club identity with {argument name="football club" default="FC Barcelona"} while preserving the same elite tribute-poster aesthetic.
items.promptZh: 以黑暗电影混合媒体风格创作引人注目的垂直足球致敬海报，结合美术肖像、体育品牌、纹理垃圾绘画和高级编辑排版。中心主题是一幅{argument name="historicalfigure"default="Rabindranath Tagore"}的腰部肖像，被重新想象为巴塞罗那足球俱乐部的标志，脸稍稍偏右，银灰色长发，飘逸的长胡子，苍老的面容，以及平静的传奇气质。为他穿上经典的巴塞罗那足球俱乐部主场球衣，球衣带有深红色和海军蓝垂直条纹，左侧可见耐克标志，胸前有 FCB 徽章。在头发和肩膀周围使用喜怒无常的边缘照明和绘画高光，让人物感觉不朽，几乎神圣。将背景设置为巴塞罗那颜色、深靛蓝、深红色、酒红色和柔和金色的抽象画笔纹理构图，肖像后面有 3 个主要图形元素：靠近顶部中心的大型褪色巴塞罗那足球俱乐部徽章，左侧垂直的手写孟加拉手写文本块，以及右侧垂直运行的大型金色手写签名风格脚本。在左上角，放置 5 行优雅的衬线文本：第一行写着“RABINDRANATH”，第二行写着“TAGORE”，第三行写着“1861-1941”，第四行是引言“心无恐惧，昂首挺胸……”，第五行是草书签名，写着“Rabindranath Tagore”。在中下区域，在精致的海报布局中添加 5 条居中文本行：“MORE THAN A POET.”，然后是一条金色手写大行，上面写着“A timelessspirit.”，然后是“A {argument name="clubnickname"default="CULER"}FOREVER.”，然后是一条细的水平红蓝强调线，然后是下方居中的小 FCB 徽章。在底部，展示了黄昏时诺坎普的广阔视野，体育场灯光闪烁，日落地平线令人惊叹，看台上挤满了人，巨大的人群马赛克上写着{argument name="stadium slogan" default="MES QUE UN CLUB"}。在前景中，1 个足球以潮湿的反光球场为中心，球上可见巴塞罗那队徽。整个图像应该感觉像一张由粉丝制作的豪华传统海报，超详细、绘画性、情感、虔诚、高对比度、纹理、史诗，并且适合优质社交媒体足球图形或墙壁海报。使用高 2:3 的海报构图，具有分层深度、微妙的火花、油漆条纹和金色点缀。您可以选择将可见的俱乐部标识替换为 {argument name="footballclub"default="FCBarcelona"}，同时保留相同的精英致敬海报美感。

items.title: Luxury Perfume Splash Ad
items.titleZh: Create a luxury cinematic fragrance advertisement for a dark glass men's perfume bottle labeled {argument name="brand name" default="DIOR"} and {argument name="product name" default="SAUVAGE"}. The composition is a widescreen premium product shot with the bottle placed slightly right of center, standing upright on a glossy wet black surface, angled subtly toward the viewer. The bottle is deep smoky navy-black transparent glass with a reflective metallic cap featuring circular ridges, elegant serif lettering on the front, and warm amber light glowing through the base. Surround the bottle with one dramatic splash of liquid frozen in motion, with countless sparkling golden droplets and streaks exploding upward and outward around the lower half of the bottle. Use a dark, moody, high-contrast background with a blurred rocky or citylike silhouette and glowing sunset light in the distance, dominated by black, bronze, amber, and gold tones. On the left side, add refined luxury ad typography in a spacious layout: a large serif headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="SAUVAGE"}, a smaller serif brand line below reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="DIOR"}, one thin horizontal divider line beneath, and a small uppercase sans-serif tagline reading {argument name="tagline" default="THE POWER OF INSTINCT"}.
